notes.title: Allhallows Rises Again
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/44f10383c0cdf63604ac407b2f2e7bace0cfe5c3.jpeg[/img]

As [b]Allhallows[/b] looms, whispers echo from the void. An ominous shiver runs down your spine as you hear a terrifying creature clawing its way out of the ground... but wait, it's just [b]Bob[/b]. Yes, that pumpkin-headed nuisance is back, crawling from his grave to wreak more havoc.

This Allhallows, enter the [b]Hallowed Ground [/b]dungeon to face Bob and his twisted minions – but don't let his silly grin fool you. He's deadly serious about keeping his loot!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e1dfbd28eb379fdca736e3e8e1271d670e7e5249.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Spook your Way to Rare Rewards[/h3]
The Hallowed Ground dungeon can appear randomly in [b]T4-T8 regions[/b] in the open world, and can be recognized by the special [b]pumpkin-decorated portals[/b] that will lead you to Bob's lair. Defeat him to unlock a special chest, with a chance of getting the elusive[b] Jack o' Donkey[/b] or [b]Horse Macabre[/b] mount skins. Along the way you can collect [b]Allhallows Treats[/b], eerie candy that temporarily [b]boosts your Fame[/b] for non-PvP activities. But beware – these creepy treats won't last forever, so eat them before they spoil, like Bob probably should have!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cd5233e6903c1a885fc5c982d8008bfd2dbfa8a1.jpeg[/img]

Here’s when Allhallows will take over each server:
[list]	[*][b]Albion Asia[/b]: 00:00 UTC on October 25 to 00:00 UTC on November 14[/*]	[*][b]Albion Americas [/b]and [b]Albion Europe[/b]: 10:00 UTC on October 25 to 10:00 UTC on November 14[/*][/list]Prepare to head down into the depths and wipe that grin off Bob’s face!

notes.title: Season 25 Is Around the Corner
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cce8b5e9ab7439b9ba58a0be0f6be676744087ce.jpeg[/img]

New horizons, new battles! Guilds across Albion are gearing up as [b]Season 25[/b] kicks off just days after the release of the [b]Horizons[/b] update on October 28.

So mark your calendars: Season 25 begins on [b]November 2[/b], with [b]Albion Asia[/b] starting at [b]00:00 UTC[/b], followed by [b]Albion Americas and Albion Europe[/b] at [b]11:00 UTC[/b].

[h3]Season Rewards[/h3]
Rewards such as [b]Avatar Sets[/b], [b]Fame[/b] buffs, and more await members of successful guilds, along with Artifacts to craft the next batch of powerful [b]Crystal Weapons[/b], revealed at the end of the season.
These rewards can be found in [b]Conqueror’s Chests[/b], unlocked by earning [b]Might[/b] through activities in lethal zones as a guild member.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8f3026da394dba42efdf4c4e7e89f7a28f8c8cc0.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Season Schedule Highlights:[/h3][list]	[*][b]November 2[/b]: Season start and Invasion Day[/*]	[*][b]November 30[/b]: Second Invasion Day[/*]	[*][b]December 28[/b]: Third Invasion Day, Season Points doubled[/*]	[*][b]January 25[/b]: Final Invasion Day[/*]	[*][b]January 27[/b]: Season ends[/*][/list]For the full schedule and a detailed list of rewards, visit the [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/203539-Season-25-Schedules/][b]official forum post[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ba6757ec1816af3d2b34bf1f018869ab9ac247ab.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Live Stream from Albion HQ![/h3]
For the [b]Season 25 launch[/b], we’ve got something special in store: the [b]AlbionTV[/b] team will be streaming from the[b] Sandbox Interactive[/b] studio live! Stay tuned for more information so you don’t miss this exciting event.

After that, be sure to watch [url=http://twitch.tv/AlbionOnline][b]twitch.tv/AlbionOnline[/b][/url] throughout the season for live coverage of the major events and territory battles.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f657f99c373c18f31d8b8ad287817d34856baa57.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Season Changes[/h3][list]	[*][b]Territory Raids[/b]: The energy destruction rate has been increased from 5% to 10%[/*]	[*][b]Fortifications[/b]: Dropped Banners no longer reduce protection[/*]	[*][b]Crystal Creatures[/b]: The Crystal Spiders category is now Crystal Creatures, including the new Crystal Beetle and Crystal Cobra	[list]		[*]These creatures spawn much more frequently[/*]		[*]To balance their increased frequency, their Might and loot rewards have been reduced[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*][b]Corrupted Dungeon: [/b]Requirements have been reduced[/*]	[*][b]Hellgates: [/b]Offer more Season Points per level, with reduced Might requirements[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/52eded474456536c1eb91fffa9eea4ebc4eb368d.png[/img]

[h3]New to Guild Seasons? Here's What You Need to Know![/h3]
[b]Guild Seasons[/b] are a key part of Albion's competitive landscape, where guilds battle over several months to claim territories, earn Season Points, and rise up the rankings. Participating in a Guild Season allows you to contribute to your guild's success through various activities – even if you’re not focused on PvP, you can still help your guild gather Season Points and unlock valuable rewards!

Ready to get started? Use the [b]Guild Finder[/b] to connect with a guild and start your journey to guild glory, and don’t forget to check out our [url=https://albiononline.com/news/guide-guild-seasons][b]Guild Season Guide[/b][/url] to get all the necessary information.

notes.title: Learning Points and How To Use Them
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b714336bc22a27e16e0522a6fb1be02f0d7312a2.png[/img]

Developing your character in Albion Online is a journey with many possibilities, and Learning Points can help you progress essentially [b]five times as quickly[/b]. This guide shows how Learning Points work, how to earn them, and how to use them wisely to advance in the areas that matter to you.

[h3]What are Learning Points?[/h3]
Learning points, ([b]LP[/b] for short) allow your character to [b]accelerate progress[/b] considerably on the [b]Destiny Board[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fad636fec00c66899ecc7453261602b70654943f.jpeg[/img]

Once you’ve reached [b]at least 20% of progress[/b] in a given node (a mastery level of a specific skill), you’ll unlock the option to immediately complete that level by spending Learning Points. This is indicated by a line in the progress bar of a given node.
[list]	[*]Open the Destiny Board (Hotkey: B)[/*]	[*]Select the node you wish to learn[/*]	[*]Click “[b]Learn[/b]” to spend the necessary Learning Points and complete that level[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3475725d699bf2161820a6ca83112717d0c03036.jpeg[/img]

The amount of Learning Points needed to complete a node depends on the [b]amount of Fame [/b]that would otherwise be required to complete it. It also[b] scales with the type and level of the node [/b]you wish to complete. Each Learning Point counts for more Fame at higher levels on the Destiny Board.

To automatically learn a node without having to go through this process every time, you can activate [b]Auto-Learn[/b]. This will use Learning Points in the selected nodes once the 20% threshold has been reached. For this to work, you need to have Auto-Learn selected in both the node you wish to progress, as well as the main Auto-Learn option located at the [b]top-right of the Destiny Board[/b]. Here you can also see your current amount of Learning Points.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d27bf11e9a75978706deaa032e98403a6e055a94.jpeg[/img]

[h3]How do I get Learning Points?[/h3]
Learning Points can be obtained in several ways:
[list]	[*]You [b]automatically earn 30 LP every day[/b] by having active [b]Premium [/b]status	[list]		[*]With Premium you receive 1 point every 48 minutes, whether you’re online or not[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]You will also receive [b]500 Learning Points[/b] the first time you purchase [b]7 days Premium or more[/b] for a character[/*]	[*][url=https://albiononline.com/mastery-packs?utm_source=lpguide][b]Mastery Packs[/b][/url] contain different amounts of Learning Points, depending on the tier you purchase[/*]	[*]Non-Premium characters can earn [b]10 Learning Points[/b] by completing the [b]daily Adventurer’s Challenge[/b][/*]	[*]You can obtain [b]Tomes of Learning[/b] by completing certain [b]Albion Journal missions[/b].	[list]		[*]These reward a certain amount of Learning Points when used, depending on their tier[/*]	[/list][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4b02ca55e22f4f1fddb5b31a35505c933b6f7e20.jpeg[/img]

There is [b]no limit[/b] to how many Learning Points you can accumulate, so you might want to save them for the right opportunity.

[h3]How can I use Learning Points?[/h3]
Learning Points can be used to progress in most areas of your Destiny Board.

[b]Combat[/b]

You can spend Learning Points on Weapon/Armor mastery to [b]unlock[/b] the ability to use [b]higher-tier items[/b]. If used on the specialization nodes on the outside of the Destiny Board, you can boost your [b]Item Power[/b] of each item.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1003c272131e2dc76d99190765043133a677a8b0.jpeg[/img]

[b]Tip: [/b]Since combat Fame is comparatively easy to come by in Albion, you may want to consider using your Learning Points on other areas that you wish to progress first.

[b]Crafting[/b]

Similarly to combat, crafting mastery allows you to [b]craft higher-tier items[/b], while specialization reduces [b]Focus[/b] costs and increases the chances of crafting [b]higher quality[/b] items.

[b]Tip: [/b]It is often recommended to use Learning Points to progress through lower-level crafting specializations, allowing you to unlock more valuable, higher-level crafting easily.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5345a716790028356c45546e10584f301c84bd85.jpeg[/img]

[b]Refining[/b]

When it comes to [b]refining,[/b] the first level within a node unlocks the ability to refine a new tier of materials. After that, additional levels [b]increase your Focus efficiency[/b].

[b]Tip: [/b]If you’re interested in refining, it’s often recommended to use Learning Points to increase your specialization and become a master refiner.

[b]Gathering[/b]

[b]Gathering nodes[/b] work like refining. Reaching the first level of a node will [b]unlock a new tier of gathering tools and gathering armor,[/b] while further levels within a node increase the gathering speed and yield of resources within that tier.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a6f3a4eb107930eb1e71945e4f941feaa9fdd22b.jpeg[/img]

[b]Tip:[/b] Gathering is a great place to use Learning Points early on. It is often recommended to use Learning Points [b]to unlock the first level[/b] of a new gathering tier, so that you can use better tools and gathering armor while starting to progress towards the next tier.

Learning Points [b]can not[/b] be used to boost progress through the [b]Adventurer and Reaver[/b] nodes, nor on [b]cooking, alchemy, and farming[/b].

How you spend your Learning Points is ultimately up to you, and really depends on the activities you want to do in Albion. And remember, if at any point you’re unsure, you can always hold onto your Learning Points for now and use them later. Happy learning!

notes.title: Albion’s Horizons are Expanding!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6d6512b0d8a42cfd90374f633a7e10ab01235d0a.jpeg[/img]

On [b]October 28[/b], the [b]Horizons[/b] update brings new depth and excitement to Albion's open world. [b]Dynamic Encampments[/b] introduce a shifting landscape, along with [b]Dynamic Resource Hotspots[/b], new Coffers, and lair maps. Risk and reward scales by region quality in the [b]Outlands[/b], and new [b]S.A.F.E. Portals[/b] take solo players deeper within. Groups can enjoy revamped [b]Randomized Dungeons[/b] and some frightening new [b]Crystal Creatures[/b] to take down. And long-awaited quality-of-life enhancements such as the [b]HUD Editor[/b] and [b]Quick Settings Presets[/b] make your game experience smoother than ever. With two new [b]Albion Journal [/b]categories, Albion’s Horizons are expanding in many ways.

[h3]A Dynamic World[/h3]

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8e1dd62cc6802f61d88836a8cf1e2933ee8372bc.png[/img]

[b]Dynamic Encampments[/b] are new mob camps which spawn in unpredictable locations in the open world for a limited time, offering personal rewards for those who complete them. At the same time, [b]Dynamic Resource Hotspots[/b] are springing up with abundant gathering possibilities. [b]Coffers[/b] in the open world offer rewards to those who uncover them, and new maps can sometimes be found within mob camps, which open up a special dungeon to those who are able to grab them.

[h3]Beyond the Horizon[/h3]

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/babcf7c1f788dda3839b65882d235312b8fc7ab6.png[/img]

In the [b]Outlands[/b], difficulty and rewards now scale by region quality, offering more challenging but more lucrative options as you get closer to the center. For solo players, [b]S.A.F.E. Portals[/b] provide instant travel from Portal Towns deeper into the Outlands – transporting players unpredictably into these less-trodden areas. And the [b]Crystal Beetle[/b] and [b]Crystal Cobra[/b] provide new, fearsome targets for groups. At the same time, [b]Group Randomized Dungeons[/b] have been revamped, offering greater rewards for larger teams, and on the Royal Continent [b]Tier 5 Blue Zones[/b] and [b]Tier 6 Yellow Zones[/b] offer more advanced content early in the game.

[h3]Customize Your Experience[/h3]

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7d8c8ad95c5cd72f6f491d7f635f6c5d1c4680bd.png[/img]

The [b]HUD Editor[/b] gives you unprecedented control over your interface, allowing you to customize, save, and share layouts. Pair it with [b]Quick Settings Presets[/b] to shift between graphics, audio, controls, and gameplay settings at the touch of a button. [b]Managing your inventory[/b] is easier than ever with collapsible sections, customizable item slots, and advanced sorting options. [b]Banks [/b]also get a boost with Move All, Repair All, and more intuitive sorting features. And the [b]Albion Journal[/b] has two new categories – Social & Guild and Island – with brand-new, themed rewards.

With all this and more, Horizons opens up new opportunities in Albion’s ever-evolving world, expanding the possibilities of your experience further than ever. For more information, see this [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-open-world-improvements][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url] on the open-world changes, and check out the official update page [url=https://albiononline.com/update/horizons][b]here[/b][/url].

tags.feature: Dynamic Encampments introduce a shifting landscape, along with Dynamic Resource Hotspots, new Coffers, and lair maps.
Risk and reward scales by region quality in the Outlands, and new S.A.F.E. Portals take solo players deeper within.
Groups can enjoy revamped Randomized Dungeons and some frightening new Crystal Creatures to take down.
And long-awaited quality-of-life enhancements such as the HUD Editor and Quick Settings Presets make your game experience smoother than ever.
With two new Albion Journal categories, Albion’s Horizons are expanding in many ways.
Dynamic Encampments are new mob camps which spawn in unpredictable locations in the open world for a limited time, offering personal rewards for those who complete them.
At the same time, Dynamic Resource Hotspots are springing up with abundant gathering possibilities.
Coffers in the open world offer rewards to those who uncover them, and new maps can sometimes be found within mob camps, which open up a special dungeon to those who are able to grab them.
In the Outlands, difficulty and rewards now scale by region quality, offering more challenging but more lucrative options as you get closer to the center.
For solo players, S.A.F.E. Portals provide instant travel from Portal Towns deeper into the Outlands – transporting players unpredictably into these less-trodden areas.
And the Crystal Beetle and Crystal Cobra provide new, fearsome targets for groups.

At the same time, Group Randomized Dungeons have been revamped, offering greater rewards for larger teams, and on the Royal Continent Tier 5 Blue Zones and Tier 6 Yellow Zones offer more advanced content early in the game.
The HUD Editor gives you unprecedented control over your interface, allowing you to customize, save, and share layouts.
Pair it with Quick Settings Presets to shift between graphics, audio, controls, and gameplay settings at the touch of a button.
Managing your inventory is easier than ever with collapsible sections, customizable item slots, and advanced sorting options.
Banks also get a boost with Move All, Repair All, and more intuitive sorting features.
And the Albion Journal has two new categories – Social & Guild and Island – with brand-new, themed rewards.

notes.title: Dev Talk: Open World Improvements
notes.content:
In this Dev Talk, [b]Game Director Robin Henkys[/b] introduces [b]Horizons[/b], Albion’s next major update. This update brings new features to the Outlands, introduces more challenging PvE, and brings long-awaited quality-of-life improvements. Today, we focus on the key changes coming to the[b] open world[/b].

[previewyoutube=iCEZk_q54A0?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Outlands Changes[/h3]
[b]Horizons[/b] makes the [b]Outlands[/b] more accessible and rewarding for solo and small group players, while keeping them worthy of guild conquest.

[b]S.A.F.E. Portal:[/b] [list]	[*]New [b]solo teleport system[/b] located in Portal Towns, offering instant access to random Outlands regions within a certain range[/*]	[*]The portal charges a [b]Silver fee[/b] based on weight[/*]	[*]The player can return through the portal for a limited time	[list]		[*]Certain actions, like collecting items from containers or performing trades, will cause the return portal to close[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]With their introduction, the inner-Outlands will become[b] more active and accessible[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7cab8d322c4cabc2eda63a9a30359ccd622c10d6.jpeg[/img][/b]

[b]Crystal Creatures:[/b][list]	[*]New creatures: [b]Crystal Beetle[/b] and [b]Crystal Cobra[/b][/*]	[*][b]Higher spawn rates[/b] for all Crystal Creatures[/*]	[*]Now [b]marked only in proximity[/b] to players[/*]	[*]Their rewards have been adjusted, but increased availability makes them a [b]reliable income option for groups[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1d330680ad77c1715449bafbc22391c2b55e1f5e.jpeg[/img][/b]

[b]Other Outlands Changes:[/b][list]	[*][b]Region Quality Scaling [/b]will [b]increase[/b] the rewards and difficulty of Outlands regions as you get closer to the center[/*]	[*]A new[b] Player Count Indicator[/b] shows [b]a range of active players [/b]in a particular region to help players assess PvP risk and [b]find fights[/b] of their desired scale[/*][/list]
[h3]PvE Changes and New Challenges[/h3]

[b]Dynamic Solo & Veteran Mob Camps:[/b][list]	[*][b]Camps shift location[/b] periodically and are only available for a limited time[/*]	[*]Players must earn Fame by killing mobs protecting the camp to unlock a personal [b]chest[/b][/*]	[*]They can only be cleared once, [b]encouraging open world exploration[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a8804422c2fdecc24532f0f61a83c91f5f9c94d4.jpeg[/img][/b]

[b]Mob Power Rebalancing:[/b][list]	[*]Mob [b]power has been adjusted,[/b] with damage and health increases from T5 (+9%) to T8 (+42%)	[list]		[*]These adjustments [b]don’t apply[/b] to:		[list]			[*]Elite enemies[/*]			[*]Avalonians[/*]			[*]Corrupted Dungeons[/*]			[*]Hellgates[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*] Rewards have also been[b] increased proportionally[/b] for these mobs and chests[/*][/list][b]Veteran Dungeon Rework:[/b][list]	[*]Veteran Dungeons rewards have been rebalanced to suit their [b]intended group size[/b][/*]	[*]Completing these dungeons in a group [b]grants bonus[/b] [b]rewards[/b][/*]	[*]Dungeon [b]entrances will close[/b] shortly after entry, allowing players to focus on PvE[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a0058ab624d8368b8e6690f615385c01c2e64328.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3]

[b]Royal Continent Changes:[/b][list]	[*]Some T5 [b]Yellow Zones[/b] have been upgraded to [b]T6[/b], and some T4 [b]Blue Zones[/b] to [b]T5[/b][/*]	[*]T5 and T6 resource output from these regions will remain negligible in comparison to more dangerous zones[/*]	[*]This expands the content available in safe zones, without diminishing the appeal of full-loot PvP zones[/*][/list][b]Resource Hotspots:[/b][list]	[*][b]Resource Hotspots [/b]offer large amounts of resources for a limited time in random locations[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/18ccbc9724a4ab5d469a7d7cf1f44e1712d70de6.jpeg[/img]

Stay tuned for more Dev Talks soon, where we'll dive into the new [b]Journal categories[/b] and groundbreaking [b]QoL features[/b] coming with the [b]Horizons[/b] update!

notes.title: This Referral Season, Bring the Fun Back with the Jester Horse!
notes.content:
This October, while everyone else is riding their spooky mounts, bring some fun back to Albion with the [b]Jester Horse[/b]! Refer a friend and you'll unlock this goofy[b] Riding Horse skin[/b], complete with jingling bells and a cap fit for a fool. Just be careful your horse doesn't slip on a banana peel – or worse, trip over its own punchline. Once unlocked, this joyous skin can be used by all characters on your account on that server.

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/61f0260ee625c_720.mp4[/video]

But this silly steed is just the beginning. By inviting more friends to horse around with you, you can also rack up some serious[b] Fame[/b] and [b]Gold[/b]. Here’s what you can get:
[list]	[*]Refer [b]1 Friend[/b]: Jester Horse mount skin[/*]	[*]Refer [b]3 Friends[/b]: A T7 Pile of Tomes worth 100,000 Fame[/*]	[*]Refer [b]5 Friends[/b]: A T8 Pile of Tomes worth 200,000 Fame[/*]	[*]Bonus for your [b]first-ever referral[/b]: A T8 Pile of Tomes worth 200,000 Fame[/*]	[*]Additionally, for [b]each friend[/b] you refer, you'll receive [b]500 Gold[/b]![/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/566265ea67322a7731e05b30984829f1d2036419.png[/img]

Getting your friends in on the action is as simple as following these steps:
[list]	[*][b]Step 1[/b]: Share your referral link with a friend, which you can find [url=https://albiononline.com/profile/referral/overview][b]here[/b][/url] when logged into the website with your game account.[/*]	[*][b]Step 2[/b]: Your friend signs up to Albion Online.[/*]	[*][b]Step 3[/b]: Your friend purchases at least 30 days of Premium status, unlocking your rewards.[/*][/list]Don't miss out on the chance to clown around with your pals and claim these fantastic rewards. The referral season ends on [b]October 31 at 23꞉59꞉59 UTC[/b], so get your friends on board before the curtain drops!

notes.title: The Harvest Challenge Awaits
notes.content:
The[b] Harvest Challenge[/b] is here, casting long shadows over Albion as Allhallows approaches. In the darkness, the elusive [b]Spectral Bat[/b] awaits. If you’re brave enough to seek it, you can [b]unlock this ghastly mount[/b] and other haunting rewards by earning [b]Challenge Points[/b] through activities in the open world. Will you be in time to reap the harvest of shadows before the season fades into darkness?

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/66fa9977f3104_720.mp4[/video]

[h3][b]Reap What You Sow[/b][/h3]
[b][img]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/5a9e734d7a37c596bd8f341dbc3a91df18612d68.png[/img]

SPECTRAL BAT:[/b] This month's Challenge offers another chance to claim the amazing [b]Spectral Bat[/b]. In addition to its spooky appearance, this winged menace comes with a powerful [b]Flicker[/b] spell that allows you to jump to a target location in the blink of an eye. (Note: like all mounts, the Spectral Bat cannot fly over obstacles or gaps.)

[b][img]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/19075c42b2f6083a97620356e3a682f66f0a4774.png[/img]

AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Harvest Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], featuring a pair of eerie, grinning skeletons. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Vanity Token.

[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2c7ba7c8b9fff4083306b993696b33ec95415878.png[/img]

SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly point totals to unlock [b]Harvest Challenge Chests[/b]. Along with valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver, resources, and other loot, you'll also have a chance to unlock six seasonal furniture items: the [b]Scary Pumpkin Lantern, Friendly Pumpkin Lantern, Halloween Lantern, Halloween Cauldron, Halloween Scarecrow,[/b] and [b]Halloween Pyre[/b].

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!

The tension is building as we approach the [b]third Invasion Day[/b] of [b]Season 24[/b]! New alliances and old rivalries are reshaping the landscape on every server, and no guild seems to have a lock on retaining its top spot from last season. This is where we left off:
[list]	[*]On [b]Albion Europe[/b], title holders [i]Sex and Flex[/i] have been locked in a fierce contest with [i]Polska Gurom[/i], who are ramping up their attacks with the help of the [i]BOBER[/i] alliance. By raiding the reigning champions’ territories, [i]Polska Gurom[/i] now has a real shot at taking the throne.[/*]	[*]Over on [b]Albion Asia[/b], [i]One Gin[/i], as part of the season debutant [i]Arthur's Rest[/i] coalition, has crushed [i]Peony Flower[/i]'s push for the top spot and secured a record-breaking lead that may be too much for anyone to overcome.[/*]	[*]In the [b]Americas[/b], allies [i]IFures[/i] and [i]D R U Y D S[/i] have held on to the top two spots, but [i]The Lonely Men[/i] are closing the gap, making this final stretch critical for determining who comes out on top.[/*][/list]The ante is about to be raised with Season Points doubled from this weekend on, making this a crucial moment for guilds looking to claim the top spot.

[list]	[*][b]Albion Asia[/b]: September 21, 14:00 UTC[/*]	[*][b]Albion Europe[/b]: September 21, 18:00 UTC[/*]	[*][b]Albion Americas[/b]: September 22, 01:00 UTC[/*][/list]

Invasion Day brings a [b]full reset[/b] of all territories, giving guilds large and small a chance to claim lands and earn valuable [b]Season Points[/b]. Check out the full [b]Guild[/b] [b]Season 24 schedule[/b] on our [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/199541-Season-24-Schedules/][b]forums[/b][/url].

notes.title: Invite a Friend to Unlock the Armored Bonehorse Skin
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/774b7f17b2a019827b59c2e168a678b55d63baa1.png[/img]

This September, transform your [b]Armored Horse[/b] into an [b]Armored Bonehorse [/b]by simply [b]referring a friend[/b] to Albion. This spectral skin is an equine skeleton shrouded in a ghostly ectoplasm, the perfect addition to any creepy collection. And with its death-defying nature, it's sure to make your enemies think twice about trying to take you down!

But there's more up for grabs than spine-tingling style, there’s massive amounts of Fame too. For your third referral, you'll receive a [b]T7 Pile of Tomes[/b], and for your fifth, you'll get [b]another T8 Pile of Tomes[/b]. And if this is your first ever referral, you’ll earn an additional T8 Pile of Tomes!

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/66ab6cec66a59_720.mp4[/video]

[h3]How to Earn Seasonal Referral Rewards[/h3][list]	[*]Send your referral link, which you can find [url=https://albiononline.com/profile/referral/overview][b]here[/b][/url], to a friend. (You must be logged into your account on the website to view this page.)[/*]	[*]Your friend registers an account and starts playing Albion Online (preferably along with you!).[/*]	[*]The first time your friend purchases at least 30 days of Premium, they will trigger a reward for you.[/*]	[*]On top of that, for your very first referral ever, you'll receive a [b]T8 Recruiter's Pile of Tomes[/b], worth a massive [b]200,000 Fame[/b].[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c82fcf573741aa78ced0042be44f1b9c199ed734.png[/img]

The current referral season ends [b]September 30[/b] at [b]23꞉59꞉59 UTC[/b]. So grab a friend or two, hop on your spooky steed, and ride with the moon in the dead of night!

notes.title: The Heretic Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/24ff6b74ff48225c7a263ca26c68477a665167b2.jpeg[/img]

This September, plunge into the madness of the [b]Heretic Challenge[/b]. Earn points through open-world activities, unlock chests filled with the fruits of deranged craftsmanship, and claim the [b]Heretic Combat Mule[/b] – a twisted creation with a powerful cannon shot!

[h3]Mighty Mules and Heretic Decor[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8f727a835c35856831b6572979da864effd7f0c5.png[/img]

[b]HERETIC COMBAT MULE:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back the [b]Heretic Combat Mule[/b], a war machine from the twisted minds of Heretic saddlers. The Combat Mule fires a powerful cannon shot that knocks back and slows targets, but watch out for its massive recoil!
 
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/119f51ba9c4fffc6a00b9c9f24208fc43f3b1c74.png[/img]

[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Heretic Challenge Avatar Ring[/b]. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this crazed, ramshackle avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Adventurer's Token.
 
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f100e812f7050459d2f9253296b0d5b51c54f068.png[/img]

[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock Heretic Challenge Chests. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver, and resources, you'll also have a chance to unlock special furniture items like the [b]Heretic Lantern, Heretic Junkpile [/b]and [b]Heretic Scarecrow[/b].
 
[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/66c86d0c98bee_720.mp4[/video]

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring rewards. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!

notes.title: Dev Talk: August 2024 Development Update
notes.content:
We're back with another [b]Dev Talk[/b]! While everyone is busy filling out their Journals, [b]Game Director Robin Henkys[/b] sat down to unpack the key takeaways from Paths to Glory, and give you a sneak peek at what the team is cooking up next. With work on the next update well underway, there's a lot to be excited about!
 
[previewyoutube=2YLVcswGcYI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]After [i]Paths to Glory[/i][/h3][list]	[*]Rebalancing the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b] has led to a marked increase in both PvP and PvE activity there[/*]	[*]The next update will aim to achieve a [b]similar effect for the open world[/b][/*]	[*]The goals are:	[list]		[*]Increased attractiveness to [b]solo players[/b][/*]		[*]More rewarding [b]mid-sized group content[/b][/*]		[*]Increased [b]activity in the inner-Outlands[/b][/*]		[*]More [b]challenging and rewarding PvE[/b][/*]	[/list][/*][/list][h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cde6bb5fbe0f054da69ab9f8f03c25a9e5450cb9.jpeg[/img]

[/h3]
[h3]Open World Developments[/h3][list]	[*][b]New PvE objectives[/b] for solo players[/*]	[*][b]New mechanics[/b] to help solo players journey deeper into the Outlands	[list]		[*]This will [b]reduce the risk of ganking[/b] near Portal Cities[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]PvE rewards and difficulty in the inner-Outlands which [b]scale by region quality[/b]	[list]		[*]This should draw competition away from Portal Cities and into the [b]inner-Outlands[/b][/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]Increased rewards for group [b]Randomized Dungeons[/b][/*]	[*][b]Rebalanced mobs[/b] in the open world and Randomized Dungeons	[list]		[*]Higher-tier mobs will become more challenging and [b]more rewarding[/b][/*]		[*]This should bring [b]high-end PvE[/b] back to the open world[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]Some [b]Tier 5 and Tier 6 content[/b] introduced to blue and yellow zones, respectively	[list]		[*]This will expand the content available to new players before entering full-loot PvP zones[/*]	[/list][/*][/list][h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0ff365467a1f03cccb504661fceed8eec0b56fc0.jpeg[/img]

[/h3]
[h3]Further Improvements[/h3]
At the same time, we’re working on many other features and improvements:
[list]	[*]Two new categories in the [b]Albion Journal[/b][/*]	[*]A more [b]customizable HUD[/b][/*]	[*]Savable [b]settings presets[/b] for quick hotkey adjustments[/*]	[*][b]Inventory management[/b] improvements[/*]	[*]The next batch of [b]Crystal Weapons[/b][/*]	[*]Enhanced[b] rendering performance[/b][/*]	[*]Strengthened [b]cheat protection[/b][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f84e1e63d914dd2f2647c26db7f16fcc3b9c7d99.jpeg[/img]

These developments are all part of our mission to make Albion Online the ultimate sandbox MMORPG, so stay tuned to hear more as we approach the next update. Meanwhile, if you have any questions or comments for us, check out the [b]full video[/b] and [b]leave them in the comments there[/b], and we’ll address the most popular comments in a future video!

notes.title: Changelog: Paths to Glory Patch 2
notes.content:
[h2]Paths to Glory Patch 2 - Version 26.020.1 - August 21, 2024[/h2]

[quote][i]This patch is intended to fine-tune some of the changes introduced in the Paths to Glory update, refining the overall game dynamics and addressing community feedback.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Mob Changes[/h3]

[b]Health Regeneration Adjustments:[/b][list]	[*]Avalonian Crystal Basilisk no longer regenerates health after the second phase has been triggered[/*]	[*]Reduced health regeneration amounts for all elite and high-tier veteran mobs:	[list]		[*]Tier 7 Veteran: 72 → 61[/*]		[*]Tier 8 Veteran: 109 → 76[/*]		[*]Tier 4 Elite: 111 → 83[/*]		[*]Tier 5 Elite: 137 → 103[/*]		[*]Tier 6 Elite: 167 → 125[/*]		[*]Tier 7 Elite: 241 → 154[/*]		[*]Tier 8 Elite: 363 → 190[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Mobs no longer regenerate health while invincible[/*][/list]
[b]Other Adjustments:[/b][list]	[*]Demonic Harbinger:	[list]		[*]Forceful Swing damage per tick: 350 → 250[/*]		[*]Reckless Swing damage per tick: 400 → 300[/*]		[*]Raging Onslaught cast time: 1.35s → 1.5s[/*]		[*]Unrelenting Slaughter cast time: 0.65s → 0.75s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Elite Earthkeeper Axe-Thrower:	[list]		[*]Stun duration no longers scales with mob’s ability power or player’s crowd control resistance[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Respawn chances for T6+ resources and resource mobs affected by Dynamic Spawn Rates have been increased by up to 10%[/*][/list]
[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3]

[b]Armor Abilities:[/b]

Armor items now have all their abilities unlocked from Tier 4 upwards, as has been the case with weapons since the Paths to Glory update.

[b]Albion Journal:[/b]

The following Journal missions have had their rewards updated:[list]	[*]Defeat 30 Roaming Mob Mini Bosses	[list]		[*]Elder's Bag of Silver → Master's Tome of Insight[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Gain 3 million Fame from Roaming Mobs	[list]		[*]Elder's Bag of Silver → Grandmaster's Tome of Insight[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Gain 10 million Fame from Roaming Mobs	[list]		[*]5 Elder's Bags of Silver → Elder's Tome of Insight[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Gain 30 million Fame from Roaming Mobs	[list]		[*]10 Elder's Bags of Silver → 50 Community Tokens[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Gain 100 million Fame from Roaming Mobs	[list]		[*]25 Elder's Bags of Silver → 15 Elder's Bags of Silver[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Kill 1000 Champions in Static Dungeons	[list]		[*]5 Elder's Bags of Silver → Elder's Tome of Insight[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Gain 3,000,000 fame in the Roads	[list]		[*]Elder's Bag of Silver → Grandmaster's Tome of Insight[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Gain 10,000,000 fame in the Roads	[list]		[*]5 Elder's Bags of Silver → Elder's Tome of Insight[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Gain 30,000,000 fame in the Roads	[list]		[*]10 Elder's Bags of Silver → 50 Community Tokens[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Gain 100,000,000 fame in the Roads	[list]		[*]25 Elder's Bags of Silver → 15 Elder's Bags of Silver[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Kill 1000 Champions in Static Dungeons	[list]		[*]5 Elder's Tomes of Insight → 1 Elder's Tome of Insight[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
The following Journal mission has had its objective changed:[list]	[*]'Defeat 25 T3 Roaming Mobs' → 'Defeat 12 T3 Roaming Mobs'[/*][/list]
[b]UI Changes:[/b][list]	[*]Travel Planner and Island Merchant UIs:	[list]		[*]Now grouped in a two-level dropdown menu for easier navigation of multiple personal and guild islands[/*]		[*]Icons now indicate the destination’s biome/attached city and type (city, portal, personal/guild island)[/*]		[*]Clearly distinguishes between Own Islands, Favorites, and Other Islands for quicker access[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Guild UI:	[list]		[*]Added functionality to copy guild member list as TSV[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Claiming a reward from the Albion Journal now automatically opens the Inventory[/*]	[*]Dropdowns with submenus now have arrow symbols[/*][/list]
[b]Other:[/b][list]	[*]System-generated soup, salad, and mules have been removed from Marketplaces on Albion Europe[/*]	[*]Added Guild Logos for Albion Europe Beta Season winners[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Arcane Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Enigma Blade (all Arcane Staffs)	[list]		[*]Damage: 180 → 190:[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Frazzle (all Arcane Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cast Time: 0.6s → 0.5s[/*]		[*]Range: 13m → 15m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Daggers[/b][list]	[*]Merciless Finish (Bridled Fury)	[list]		[*]0 Stack Damage: 68.3 → 75[/*]		[*]1 Stack Damage: 108.8 → 120[/*]		[*]2 Stack Damage: 163.3 → 180[/*]		[*]3 Stack Damage: 216.6 → 238[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Frost Bomb (all Frost Staffs)	[list]		[*]Initial Area Slow: 20% → 30%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Hammers[/b][list]	[*]Powerful Swing (all Hammers)	[list]		[*]Damage: 94 → 113[/*]		[*]Bonus damage to crowd-controlled enemies: 48 → 56[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Seismic Tremor (all Hammers):	[list]		[*]1st and 2nd Hit Damage: 70 → 80[/*]		[*]3rd Hit Damage: 140 → 160[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Generous Heal (all Holy Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cast Time: 0.6s → 0.5s[/*]		[*]Range: 14m → 15m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shapeshifter Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Fireflash Orb (Hellspawn Staff)	[list]		[*]Initial Damage: 150 → 120		[list]			[*]Every 0.6s the projectile travels, damage increases by 30, up to a maximum of 240[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Recast Damage: 220 → 150[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Seedling's Bloom (Rootbound Staff)	[list]		[*]Empowered Bloom Healing Received: 20% → 10%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Barbed Roots (Rootbound Staff)	[list]		[*]Shield: 150 → 175[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b][list]	[*]Blind Spot (Shoes of Tenacity)	[list]		[*]Caster is no longer invisible to mobs, but only to other players[/*]		[*]Buff duration: 1s → 1.5s[/*]		[*]Movespeed: 20% → 60%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Albion Journal fixes:[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where ‘Defeat Roaming Mobs’ missions would incorrectly count certain other mobs[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where ‘Find Hidden Treasures’ missions would not count those found by party members[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the ‘Rescue 50 Wisps in Greater Mists’ mission would not count those rescued by party members[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Defeat another player after invading their Corrupted Dungeon’ could not be completed in Hunter difficulty[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Win a 5v5 Crystal League Match’ could be completed by winning a 20v20 Crystal League Match[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Win a 20v20 Crystal League Match’ required a Level 1 match, rather than any level[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission 'Use a crafting bonus in a Hideout' could be completed by acquiring items from the Energy Manipulator in a Hideout[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where untracking a mission in the summary would cause the UI to scroll to the top[/*][/list]
[b]UI fixes:[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where using Community Tokens to craft an item at the Vanity Merchant would default to the maximum number of items[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Territory Control Cost tooltip on region map would incorrectly display zero[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Albion Journal achievement popups could be hidden by other UI elements[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where a two-handed Vanity Item could not be equipped if the off-hand slot was already occupied[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where region map would sometimes appear pink[/*][/list]
[b]Other fixes:[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where a stray Blue Zone Randomized Dungeon would appear in the Roads of Avalon[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Siege Banners could not be raised against a territory that had already been raided[/*]	[*]Various additional graphical, animation, terrain, audio, UI, and localization fixes[/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog: Paths to Glory Patch 1
notes.content:
[h2]Paths to Glory Patch 1 - Version 26.010.1 - August 7, 2024[/h2]
[quote][i]This is a small patch that primarily addresses issues introduced by the Paths to Glory update that were not critical enough to be included in previous hotfixes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[b]Albion Journal[/b]

The following mission rewards have been changed:
[list]	[*]‘Visit all six Royal Cities’	[list]		[*]Monk's Hood →  Monk's Sandals[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]‘Catch 15 different fish’	[list]		[*]Blue Bard's Hat → Blue Bard's Shoes[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]‘Finish 40 hunts’	[list]		[*]5 Tomes of Learning → 1 Tome of Learning[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]‘Own a million Silver’	[list]		[*]Innkeeper's Hat → Master's Tome of Insight[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]‘Own a billion Silver’	[list]		[*]500 Community Tokens → Expert's Tome of Learning[/*]	[/list]	[/*][*]‘Loot 5 different Baby Animals’	[list]		[*]5x Elder's Bag of Silver → Elder's Tome of Insight[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]Additionally, Scrolls of Repair earned as Journal rewards are now non-tradable. Those earned prior to this patch remain tradable.

[b]Territory Raiding[/b]

The percentage of stored energy that is destroyed when unlocking Raw Energy Cores has been increased from 1% to 5%.

[b]Other[/b]

Randomized Dungeons shown on the Minimap in the Roads of Avalon now continue to display enchantment VFX after a player has entered.
[list]	[*]This does not apply to randomly spawned dungeons in Hideout regions[/*][/list]
[h3]UI Improvements[/h3]
[list]	[*]Added pop-up notifications for the completion of individual Journal missions[/*]	[*]Entries in the drop-down list in the Island Merchant UI now display visual cues to reflect the player's ownership and Guild permission status[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Axes[/b]
[list]	[*]Relentless Assault (Crystal Reaper)	[list]		[*]Damage: 82.5 → 90[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Bows[/b]
[list]	[*]Deadly Shot (all Bows)	[list]		[*]Range: 18m → 20m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Cursed Staffs[/b]
[list]	[*]Enfeeble Blades (Lifecurse Staff)	[list]		[*]Removed: Damage debuff[/*]		[*]Damage per tick: 55 → 70[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Daggers[/b]
[list]	[*]Dash (all Daggers)	[list]		[*]Energy Cost: 5% → 8%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Fire Staffs[/b]
[list]	[*]Combustion (Infernal Staff)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 13 → 16[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Flame Pillar (Great Fire Staff)	[list]		[*]Damage: 190 → 200[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b]
[list]	[*]Arctic Volley (Arctic Staff)	[list]		[*]Range: 18m → 22m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Nature Staffs[/b]
[list]	[*]Well of Life (Wild Staff)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 1s → 0.7s[/*]		[*]Duration: 5s → 4s[/*]		[*]Total ticks: 5 → 4[/*]		[*]Healing per tick: 55.2 → 69[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Quarterstaffs[/b]
[list]	[*]Phantom Twin (Phantom Twinblade)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 33 → 36[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b]
[list]	[*]Spectral Run (Specter Shoes)	[list]		[*]Previously: auto-attacks disabled for 3 seconds after moving more than 15m (after invisibility ends)[/*]		[*]Now: damage reduced by 50% for 3 seconds after moving more than 15m (after invisibility ends)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[quote][i]A number of progression and reward issues in the Albion Journal have been addressed. These changes will take effect with this patch and will not retroactively change existing progression unless otherwise noted.[/i][/quote]
[b]Albion Journal fixes:[/b]

The display priority now functions correctly, in this order:	[list]		[*]Player's own nametag[/*]		[*]Selected nametags[/*]		[*]Nametags with an icon[/*]		[*]Spellcasting bars[/*]		[*]Speech bubbles[/*]		[*]Other nametags[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where mount healthbars and spellcasting bars could display incorrectly when other spells were cast nearby[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Journey Back ability could not be used after closing the notification pop-up with the ESC key[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where opening the Destiny Board or World Map with the Journal Tracker UI open would cause the tracker to display as empty[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where mail notifications would appear during the tutorial despite the mail menu being inaccessible[/*][/list]

notes.title: This Referral Season Brings Back the White Direboar
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f9b79788759c8364bee0c87d16a7c50a5fac1136.png[/img]

A new [b]Referral Season[/b] is here and runs from now until August 31. Invite your friends and earn the majestic [b]White Direboar[/b] mount skin!

This skin transforms your [b]Direboar[/b] into the white beast of legend, coveted by any knight looking to prove their bravery. Fortunately for you, this epic quest only requires [b]a single referral[/b], and once unlocked, it can be used by all characters on your server account forever.

Your first ever referral will also earn you a [b]T8 Pile of Tomes[/b], in addition to the monthly mount skin. And you can also earn significant amounts of fame for your third and fifth referrals. Three referrals will reward you with a [b]T7 Pile of Tomes worth 100,000 Fame[/b], while five referrals will reward you with a [b]T8 Pile of Tomes worth a massive 200,000 Fame[/b].

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/665ed6c360391_720.mp4[/video]

[h3]How to Earn Seasonal Referral Rewards[/h3][list]	[*]Send your referral link, which you can find [url=https://albiononline.com/profile/referral/overview][b]here[/b][/url], to a friend. (You must be logged into your account on the website to view this page.)[/*]	[*]Your friend registers an account and starts playing Albion Online (preferably along with you!).[/*]	[*]The first time your friend purchases at least 30 days of Premium, they will trigger a reward for you.[/*]	[*]On top of that, for your very first referral ever, you'll receive a [b]T8 Recruiter's Pile of Tomes[/b], worth a massive [b]200,000 Fame[/b].[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8cc35bcfdb34cb3cb014d5b238df2820ae7b2a47.png[/img]

This legendary creature has been the very symbol of courage and daring since time immemorial, so don’t miss out! You have until [b]23:59 :59[/b] UTC on [b]August 31[/b] to rally your friends and unlock the fabled [b]White Direboar[/b].

notes.title: The Divine Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ee8123ef823b04921923ea97e407d1ba8061b520.jpeg[/img]

Have you heard the call of the divine? This August, ascend to heavenly heights by earning points in open-world activities, unlocking sacred chests filled with celestial treasures, and harnessing the holy power of the [b]Divine Owl[/b].

[h3][b]Simply Divine[/b][/h3]

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d83bf046c0279d2ecc98aa9e2f8ace278a723242.png[/img]

[b]DIVINE OWL:[/b] 
This month's Challenge brings back this ghostly white flying mount with a brisk base move speed. This mount has a special ability, [b]Foresight[/b], which creates a shield that gives a temporary speed boost when broken. (Note: like all mounts, the Divine Owl can only move in navigable ground areas and cannot fly over obstacles.)
 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4RhCStZ.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b]
Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Divine Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], which will frame your chosen avatar in a heavenly golden aura. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Vanity Token.
 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5e8qvan.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] 
All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Divine Challenge chests[/b]. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes and Silver, you'll also have a chance to unlock mystical furniture items like the [b]Mage Statue, Magic Rune Circle[/b], and [b]Glass Sphere[/b].
 
[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/62cbee83a0a08_720.mp4[/video]

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount / avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while you can!

notes.title: Changelog: Paths to Glory Update
notes.content:
[h2]Paths to Glory Update - Version 26.000.1 - July 22, 2024[/h2]

[h3]The Albion Journal[/h3]
[b]Overview[/b]
[list]	[*]The Albion Journal is a personal logbook that will help you keep track of your adventures and to build up the chronicle of your journey through the lands of Albion[/*]	[*]This is a new achievement tracking feature designed to provide clear guidance and exciting goals for all players, whether you’re a seasoned veteran or just starting out[/*]	[*]The journal offers a mixture of missions that can be completed in a single play session, as well as longer-term goals that unlock valuable rewards and unique vanity items[/*]	[*]The Journal provides an overview of the game’s core activities and features, guiding players through Albion’s sandbox structure immediately after the tutorial[/*][/list][quote][i]We want every play session to have an achievable goal. Whether you're completing a quick task or taking on a more significant challenge, progress should always be within reach. With the introduction of the Albion Journal, we want to provide everyone with a quantifiable way to measure their progress while exploring all the different features Albion Online has to offer.[/i]
[i]With this update, the Journal has five main categories, and we plan to expand this with four further categories in the future.[/i][/quote]
[b]HUD changes[/b]
[list]	[*]The Albion Journal has its own section, the Journal Tracker, on the player HUD — just below the Destiny Board button[/*]	[*]The Journal Tracker displays up to three missions for you to follow your progress.	[list]		[*]You can choose which missions to follow here, or let it show recommended missions[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Journal Tracker is a collapsable menu, which notifies you when you have rewards available[/*][/list]
[b]Your Journal[/b]
[list]	[*]The Albion Journal starts with one revealed mission and gradually reveals more as you progress[/*]	[*]Missions can be completed even if they are not yet revealed in the Journal[/*]	[*]Missions are organized into categories and subcategories, with goals and rewards unlocking as you progress[/*]	[*]Main Categories included in the Paths to Glory update:	[list]		[*]PvE[/*]		[*]Gathering[/*]		[*]Economy[/*]		[*]Exploration[/*]		[*]PvP[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Some brand-new items are available as rewards as you progress through the Journal (see ‘Albion Journal Rewards’ below)[/*]	[*]Many existing Steam Achievements are now part of Journal Missions	[list]		[*]If these were completed prior to the launch of the Journal, their rewards will be ready to claim[/*]		[*]Steam Achievements will remain in the Achievements section separately[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Albion Journal Rewards[/h3]
[b]Mission Rewards[/b]
[list]	[*]Each completed mission grants a reward	[list]		[*]These rewards can be claimed in the Albion Journal UI[/*]		[*]Rewards for individual missions include Tomes of Insight, Silver, Focus Restoration Potions, Gathering Tomes, and many more![/*]		[*]A new reward item is available, Tome of Learning, which grants Learning Points when used[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Category Rewards[/b]
[list]	[*]As you progress through each of the main categories, you will unlock unique new vanity rewards at various stages	[list]		[*]20% completion: A unique Avatar[/*]		[*]40% completion: A matching Avatar Ring[/*]		[*]60% completion: A wardrobe item with a vanity spell[/*]		[*]80% completion: A brand-new mount skin[/*]		[*]100% completion: A very rare, elite version of the wardrobe item and spell[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]These vanity rewards follow the theme of each category[/*]	[*]All Category Rewards are non-tradable[/*][/list]
[h3]Dynamic Spawn Rates[/h3]
In order to provide more content during each server’s peak times, this update introduces a new feature to the open world and the Roads of Avalon: Dynamic Spawn Rates.
[list]	[*]Snapshots of each server’s activity levels will be taken ongoingly[/*]	[*]Some spawn and upgrade rates will be automatically adjusted based on this activity	[list]		[*]Spawn rates will dynamically increase during busy times and decrease during off-peak periods[/*]		[*]There are limits in place to ensure that low-activity periods don’t offer too little, and busy periods don’t offer too much[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]As a result, it should be easier to find content during the busiest times on each server. With this update, this feature will affect treasures, resources, and mobs, with the amount available more in line with each server's activity. The impact will be measured and adjusted as necessary and it may be expanded to other content in the future.
[h3]Roads of Avalon Improvements[/h3]
[quote][i]We've listened to your feedback and, as promised, we're working on the most popular change requested by the community. With these changes, we’re not looking to completely reshape the Roads of Avalon, but rather to rebalance their regions and rewards while adding new content in the form of Tracking. We will continue to monitor gameplay in the Roads after this update, to see what further changes and improvements can be made.[/i][/quote]
[b]Region Balancing[/b]
[list]	[*]The tier of Roads region you enter is now based on the zone type from which you enter	[list]		[*]Tier 4 Roads: Primarily found when entering from Blue and Yellow zones[/*]		[*]Tier 6 Roads: Typically found when entering from Red and Black zones[/*]		[*]Tier 8 Roads: Exclusive to Deep Roads and 20-Player Portals[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The number of 20-Player Portal Regions has been increased to provide more frequent connections to Roads Hideout Regions	[list]		[*]Some connections to 20-Player Portal Regions from non-Hideout Regions have been added too, to increase competition[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Group Portals within the Roads now have a 300 second recharge time[/*][/list]
[b]Content and Reward Balancing[/b]
[quote][i]We wanted to better balance Roads content and rewards with other activities in Albion. There will be fewer Roads regions for gathering, but those that do exist will have higher respawn rates to compensate. Additionally, the Roads will not be quite as powerful for leveling as in the past, but will instead be more attractive for loot.[/i]
[i]On average, Fame has been reduced by around 20-25%, while the total Silver output from the Roads (taking into account increased spawn rates) has been approximately doubled.[/i][/quote]
[list]	[*]Tracking is now possible in the Roads[/*]	[*]Group rewards have been significantly increased to encourage cooperative play, while solo rewards have been reviewed to ensure fairness compared to other content	[list]		[*]Avalonian Chests have had their value increased		[list]			[*]Tier 4 and Tier 6 chests have received a slight buff, and Tier 8 chests a significant buff[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]They now also upgrade in size over time if left untouched[/*]		[*]Small Avalonian Chests can never be rare or legendary, while Large Avalonian Chests can never be common[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The number of areas dedicated to gathering has been reduced	[list]		[*]Their respawn rate has been increased to maintain total resource output in the Roads[/*]		[*]The free spots will be used to introduce additional PvE areas and Solo Randomized Dungeon entrances[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Randomized Dungeons with fixed entrances have had their bonus loot reduced	[list]		[*]To compensate, they are always Enchanted now[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Randomized Dungeon entrances, Mobs, Chests, and Resources have been moved to offer greater diversity of content and remove ultra-specialized regions with only one resource type[/*][/list]
[b]Mob Adjustments[/b]
[list]	[*]Mob tiers are now standardized in each different Roads region	[list]		[*]With the exception of resource mobs, all Roads mobs will match the tier of the region[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Pathfinder Initiate, Ascetic and Monk’s knockback spell now has an AoE indicator and can be dodged[/*]	[*]Pathfinder Heavy Drones no longer use their spells off-cooldown[/*]	[*]Bosses protecting chests offer significantly less Fame	[list]		[*]Instead, opening a chest will reward Fame to the first group who open it[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]	[*]Roads Portal tooltips now show the danger type of the Roads region[/*]	[*]Avalonian Chest tooltips no longer show their rarity, regardless of your proximity to them[/*]	[*]Furniture can no longer be placed in PvE and gathering areas[/*]	[*]Some areas have updated visuals, for greater variety[/*][/list]
[h3]Guild Islands Rework[/h3]
Paths to Glory updates Guild Islands to bring them in line with Personal Islands
[list]	[*]Guilds can now also own multiple islands in every city on the Royal Continent – one each in Martlock, Bridgewatch, Fort Sterling, Lymhurst, Thetford, and Caerleon –.[/*]	[*]Guild Islands have reworked visuals which reflect the atmosphere, aesthetics, and biome of their host city[/*][/list]
[h3]New Crystal Weapons[/h3]
New update, new Crystal Weapons! This update introduces the next batch of these weapons, which will be craftable at the end of Season 24:
[list]	[*]Twin Slayers (Daggers): Ring of Death throws your daggers in a ring around you, which can then be summoned back, slicing through all enemies in their path[/*]	[*]Dreadstorm Monarch (Mace): Eye of the Storm conjures a growing storm around you that slows enemies and shreds their resistances[/*]	[*]Exalted Staff (Holy Staff): Sanctify heals allies and removes ground-based damaging, debuffing, or crowd-control areas of effect[/*][/list]
[h3]Corrupted Dungeon Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Corrupted Dungeon Maps have been added	[list]		[*]These can be crafted at the Artifact Foundry[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Bat spawn times adjusted	[list]		[*]Hunter: 5 minutes → 3 minutes[/*]		[*]Stalker: 5 minutes → 3 minutes[/*]		[*]Slayer: 3 minutes (unchanged)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[quote][i]With this update, we wanted to provide several much-requested quality of life enhancements by improving a number of important weapon functions and UI elements, along with some other frequently-requested changes and additions.[/i][/quote]
[b]Weapon Improvements[/b]
Based on your feedback, two important changes have been made to weapon functionality:
[list]	[*]Weapons now have all of their spells unlocked from Tier 4 upwards, to increase gameplay variety[/*]	[*]Items can now be overcharged twice in combat, increasing overcharge duration at a  greater risk of breaking the item	[list]		[*]This will allow for prolonged ZvZ battles beyond the 30-minute mark[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Party Ready Check[/b]
A new system allows party leaders to check on the readiness of their group members, to help in activities which require coordination.
[list]	[*]A party leader can initiate a Ready Check in two ways:	[list]		[*]From their character drop-down menu[/*]		[*]By typing /readycheck in the chat[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]All party members, regardless of location, receive a notification asking if they are ready or not[/*]	[*]Responses are displayed to all party members	[list]		[*]Green check-mark: Ready[/*]		[*]Red cross: Not ready[/*]		[*]White question mark: Pending/AFK[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]If a member does not respond in 60 seconds, they are marked as Pending/AFK[/*]	[*]Responses remain on-screen for 30 seconds after the end of the Ready Check	[list]		[*]If a new Ready Check is initiated in this time, the original responses are overwritten[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]UI Improvements[/b]
[list]	[*]The Destiny Board has improved scaling and zooming[/*]	[*]All players in a Randomized Dungeon now receive a message when the entrance closes	[list]		[*]No more counting to 90 and guessing if an entrance is gone![/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Daily Bonus Tracker in the HUD can now be collapsed[/*]	[*]Last Death Recap can now be accessed from the Player Menu at any time during the same play session[/*]	[*]Siege UI:	[list]		[*]The Siege UI is now accessible at any time when using the Siege Banner item[/*]		[*]Improved information display that better reflects the requirements necessary for Siege Banner use[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Added a market value estimation of equipment when inspecting a player	[list]		[*]The estimated value includes equipped items only, not items in inventory[/*]		[*]Displayed value is a rounded number; hovering over estimated value shows the exact amount[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Player Rankings UI:	[list]		[*]Added options to filter rankings by “Guild Members only” and “Friends List only”[/*]		[*]When a player ranks outside the top 10,000, their position along with the two players immediately above and below them are displayed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Party and guild management:	[list]		[*]Player markers are now displayed in front of other elements (such as health bars) and are easier to distinguish from the background, improving the visibility of marked players in large battles[/*]		[*]Player pings now appear as system messages in chat[/*]		[*]Added button to Guild UI to copy Guild Member list to the clipboard[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Territory Activity Chest world map overlays added, showing:	[list]		[*]Average Activity Chest Value[/*]		[*]Next Activity Chest Value[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Trade UI now displays projected character weight after a prospective trade[/*]	[*]Added confirmation popup message when using Journey Back to better inform about Silver costs[/*]	[*]Added an opacity setting for the chat box in focused mode[/*]	[*]Improved search function by allowing variation in words instead of requiring an exact match[/*]	[*]Improved target dummy DPS view to be more consistent and closer to actual damage timing[/*][/list]
[h3]Additional Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]In order to create some economic space and bring greater parity to Albion’s various features, various slight adjustments have been made to the [h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
[quote][i]Our main focus with this update was to adjust the resilience curve, which addresses the survivability of melee and ranged weapons in large scale battles. The goal is to make these fights less focused on melee brawl compositions, and give ranged damage-per-second more room to succeed.[/i][/quote]
[b]Resilience[/b]
The impact of Resilience on large-scale fights has been reduced significantly, making melees less tanky with higher numbers of attackers. This means that all players (including ranged players) deal greater damage to melees. To compensate for this, the resilience penetration for various long range melee weapons has been reduced. This is aimed at large-scale fights - for up to five attackers melee Resilience values are unchanged.

The Resilience curve has also been normalized for ranged weapons, to use the same Resilience values as melees and make both these weapon types more competitive in all group sizes.

tags.feature: The Albion Journal is a personal logbook that will help you keep track of your adventures and to build up the chronicle of your journey through the lands of Albion
This is a new achievement tracking feature designed to provide clear guidance and exciting goals for all players, whether you’re a seasoned veteran or just starting out
The journal offers a mixture of missions that can be completed in a single play session, as well as longer-term goals that unlock valuable rewards and unique vanity items
The Journal provides an overview of the game’s core activities and features, guiding players through Albion’s sandbox structure immediately after the tutorial
The Albion Journal has its own section, the Journal Tracker, on the player HUD — just below the Destiny Board button
The Journal Tracker displays up to three missions for you to follow your progress.
You can choose which missions to follow here, or let it show recommended missions
The Journal Tracker is a collapsable menu, which notifies you when you have rewards available
The Albion Journal starts with one revealed mission and gradually reveals more as you progress
Missions can be completed even if they are not yet revealed in the Journal
Missions are organized into categories and subcategories, with goals and rewards unlocking as you progress
Some brand-new items are available as rewards as you progress through the Journal (see ‘Albion Journal Rewards’ below)
Many existing Steam Achievements are now part of Journal Missions
If these were completed prior to the launch of the Journal, their rewards will be ready to claim
Steam Achievements will remain in the Achievements section separately
Each completed mission grants a reward
These rewards can be claimed in the Albion Journal UI
Rewards for individual missions include Tomes of Insight, Silver, Focus Restoration Potions, Gathering Tomes, and many more!
A new reward item is available, Tome of Learning, which grants Learning Points when used
As you progress through each of the main categories, you will unlock unique new vanity rewards at various stages
These vanity rewards follow the theme of each category
All Category Rewards are non-tradable
In order to provide more content during each server’s peak times, this update introduces a new feature to the open world and the Roads of Avalon: Dynamic Spawn Rates.
Snapshots of each server’s activity levels will be taken ongoingly
Some spawn and upgrade rates will be automatically adjusted based on this activity
Spawn rates will dynamically increase during busy times and decrease during off-peak periods
There are limits in place to ensure that low-activity periods don’t offer too little, and busy periods don’t offer too much
As a result, it should be easier to find content during the busiest times on each server.
With this update, this feature will affect treasures, resources, and mobs, with the amount available more in line with each server's activity.
The impact will be measured and adjusted as necessary and it may be expanded to other content in the future.
The tier of Roads region you enter is now based on the zone type from which you enter
The number of 20-Player Portal Regions has been increased to provide more frequent connections to Roads Hideout Regions
Some connections to 20-Player Portal Regions from non-Hideout Regions have been added too, to increase competition
Group Portals within the Roads now have a 300 second recharge time
Tracking is now possible in the Roads
Group rewards have been significantly increased to encourage cooperative play, while solo rewards have been reviewed to ensure fairness compared to other content
They now also upgrade in size over time if left untouched
Small Avalonian Chests can never be rare or legendary, while Large Avalonian Chests can never be common
The number of areas dedicated to gathering has been reduced
Their respawn rate has been increased to maintain total resource output in the Roads
The free spots will be used to introduce additional PvE areas and Solo Randomized Dungeon entrances
Randomized Dungeons with fixed entrances have had their bonus loot reduced
To compensate, they are always Enchanted now
Randomized Dungeon entrances, Mobs, Chests, and Resources have been moved to offer greater diversity of content and remove ultra-specialized regions with one resource type
Mob tiers are now standardized in each different Roads region
With the exception of resource mobs, all Roads mobs will match the tier of the region
Pathfinder Initiate, Ascetic and Monk’s knockback spell now has an AoE indicator and can be dodged
Pathfinder Heavy Drones no longer use their spells off-cooldown
Bosses protecting chests offer significantly less Fame
Instead, opening a chest will reward Fame to the first group who open it
Roads Portal tooltips now show the danger type of the Roads region
Avalonian Chest tooltips no longer show their rarity, regardless of your proximity to them
Furniture can no longer be placed in PvE and gathering areas
Some areas have updated visuals, for greater variety
Guilds can now also own multiple islands in every city on the Royal Continent – one each in Martlock, Bridgewatch, Fort Sterling, Lymhurst, Thetford, and Caerleon –.
Guild Islands have reworked visuals which reflect the atmosphere, aesthetics, and biome of their host city
New update, new Crystal Weapons! This update introduces the next batch of these weapons, which will be craftable at the end of Season 24:
Twin Slayers (Daggers): Ring of Death throws your daggers in a ring around you, which can then be summoned back, slicing through all enemies in their path
Dreadstorm Monarch (Mace): Eye of the Storm conjures a growing storm around you that slows enemies and shreds their resistances
Exalted Staff (Holy Staff): Sanctify heals allies and removes ground-based damaging, debuffing, or crowd-control areas of effect
Corrupted Dungeon Maps have been added
These can be crafted at the Artifact Foundry
Bat spawn times adjusted
Hunter: 5 minutes → 3 minutes
Stalker: 5 minutes → 3 minutes
Slayer: 3 minutes (unchanged)
Weapons now have all of their spells unlocked from Tier 4 upwards, to increase gameplay variety
Items can now be overcharged twice in combat, increasing overcharge duration at a greater risk of breaking the item
This will allow for prolonged ZvZ battles beyond the 30-minute mark
A new system allows party leaders to check on the readiness of their group members, to help in activities which require coordination.
A party leader can initiate a Ready Check in two ways:
From their character drop-down menu
By typing /readycheck in the chat
All party members, regardless of location, receive a notification asking if they are ready or not
Responses are displayed to all party members
Green check-mark: Ready
Red cross: Not ready
White question mark: Pending/AFK
If a member does not respond in 60 seconds, they are marked as Pending/AFK
Responses remain on-screen for 30 seconds after the end of the Ready Check
If a new Ready Check is initiated in this time, the original responses are overwritten
The Destiny Board has improved scaling and zooming
All players in a Randomized Dungeon now receive a message when the entrance closes
No more counting to 90 and guessing if an entrance is gone!
The Daily Bonus Tracker in the HUD can now be collapsed
Last Death Recap can now be accessed from the Player Menu at any time during the same play session
The Siege UI is now accessible at any time when using the Siege Banner item
Improved information display that better reflects the requirements necessary for Siege Banner use
Added a market value estimation of equipment when inspecting a player
The estimated value includes equipped items only, not items in inventory
Displayed value is a rounded number; hovering over estimated value shows the exact amount
Added options to filter rankings by “Guild Members only” and “Friends List only”
When a player ranks outside the top 10,000, their position along with the two players immediately above and below them are displayed
Player markers are now displayed in front of other elements (such as health bars) and are easier to distinguish from the background, improving the visibility of marked players in large battles
Player pings now appear as system messages in chat
Added button to Guild UI to copy Guild Member list to the clipboard
Territory Activity Chest world map overlays added, showing:
Average Activity Chest Value
Next Activity Chest Value
Trade UI now displays projected character weight after a prospective trade
Added confirmation popup message when using Journey Back to better inform about Silver costs
Added an opacity setting for the chat box in focused mode
Improved search function by allowing variation in words instead of requiring an exact match
Improved target dummy DPS view to be more consistent and closer to actual damage timing
In order to create some economic space and bring greater parity to Albion’s various features, various slight adjustments have been made to the Mists and Knightfall Abbey:
Boss and Shrine chest values in Knightfall Abbey reduced by approximately 10%
Duo Mists’ chests have had their bonus values adjusted to offset this change, and are unaffected
Already small loot chances from mobs removed to offset increased Silver and protect chests from further reductions
Arcane Spiderling spawn chances in the Mists reduced by 18%
Veteran and Elite mobs now regenerate health in combat, making them less profitable when engaged by fewer players
Their overall health has been reduced to maintain the time needed for a group to kill them
Mobs with very long respawn times (e.g. Ancient Resource Mobs) will spawn at more unpredictable intervals
Reworked animations and VFX for Quarterstaffs and Scythes
The following spells have also been visually redesigned:
Threatening Smash (all Maces)
Slowing Charge (two-handed Hammers)
Rending Strike (two-handed Axes)
A-key can now be used to exit islands
Dynamic Events added for the Mists, Roads of Avalon, and Tracking
Territory Activity Chests are now lootable by anyone after a Raid if the Territory has no owner
Players who are inactive during a Faction Warfare week will no longer receive a weekly report
Removed recipes that use Arcane Essences and Faded Essences from the Artifact Foundry
Arcane Essences can now be salvaged for Silver
Crystal Gladiator vanity items are no longer available from Crystal League chests
These are now only available via Albion Journal Crystal League Missions
Spawn buff prevention no longer counts down while between regions
[MOBILE] Added S, W, and E indicators to Minimap
[CONTROLLER] Moved "Emotes" to the D-pad action wheel
[CONTROLLER] Added a "Travel Mode Settings" controller button action to the Region Map
