Slow: Removed
Duration: 15s → 10s
Auto-Attack Speed Reduction: 30% → 15%
Added: Debuff now stacks up to 3 times
Stun vs Battle Mounts: 4s → 6s
Immunity to spell 7s → 10s
Now stuns flying Battle Mounts
Boss and Shrine chest values in Knightfall Abbey reduced by approximately 10%
Resolved an issue where some mobs in Knightfall Abbey gave too little Silver
This has resulted in a ~9% overall increase in Silver from mobs
Already small loot chances from mobs removed to offset increased Silver and protect chests from further reductions
Arcane Spiderling spawn chances in the Mists reduced by 18%
Veteran and Elite mobs now regenerate health in combat, making them less profitable when engaged by fewer players
Their overall health has been reduced to maintain the time needed for a group to kill them
Mobs with very long respawn times (e.g. Ancient Resource Mobs) will spawn at more unpredictable intervals
Reworked animations and VFX for Quarterstaffs and Scythes
The following spells have also been visually redesigned:
Threatening Smash (all Maces)
Slowing Charge (two-handed Hammers)
Rending Strike (two-handed Axes)
Dynamic Events added for the Mists, Roads of Avalon, and Tracking
Territory Activity Chests are now lootable by anyone after a Raid if the Territory has no owner
Players who are inactive during a Faction Warfare week will no longer receive a weekly report
Removed recipes that use Arcane Essences and Faded Essences from the Artifact Foundry
Crystal Gladiator vanity items are no longer available from Crystal League chests
These are now only available via Albion Journal Crystal League Missions
Spawn buff prevention no longer counts down while between regions
[ MOBILE] Added S, W, and E indicators to Minimap
[CONTROLLER] Moved "Emotes" to the D-pad action wheel
[CONTROLLER] Added a "Travel Mode Settings" controller button action to the Region Map

notes.title: Paths to Glory is Here!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/203005dbee4072778b096c48825b1a87a5519a59.png[/img]

It’s time to walk the [b]Paths to Glory[/b]! Albion’s latest content update has arrived, bringing the [b]Albion Journal[/b] - a new achievement system offering unique rewards - new [b]Crystal Weapons[/b], [b]Dynamic Spawn Rates[/b], and a wealth of improvements across the game. And, as always, we’ve produced a [b]brand-new trailer[/b] for the occasion. Check it out here:

[previewyoutube=1EvSkwrsGXk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Write your Journal[/h3]
This update introduces the [b]Albion Journal[/b], a brand-new achievement system with missions for every type of player, from the very beginners to the most seasoned veterans, covering the full breadth of Albion’s content. Each mission has its own prize - like bags of Silver and new [b]Tomes of Learning[/b] - while your progress through each category grants you unique, [b]themed rewards[/b]. So whether you’re an extravagant merchant tossing around your wealth, or a rugged gatherer with a barbeque-bearing boar, you’ll be able to demonstrate your expertise to all around you.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6a4653143ec3b3235eae6a27a158c42e567cd577.jpeg[/img]

For more on the Albion Journal and its rewards, check out this [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-albion-journal][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url].

[h3]A Dynamic World[/h3]
An important new feature is coming to the open world and the Roads of Avalon: [b]Dynamic Spawn Rates[/b]. This adjusts the amount of treasure, resources, and mobs which appear at a given time based on each server’s activity levels, with more available during peak hours. [b]The Roads[/b] have received some adjustments too, with rebalanced zones and content, and the introduction of [b]Tracking[/b]. And speaking of which, there’s a sinister new Rare Quarry out there to hunt down: the [b]Shadowmask[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9cec8a225e0955259ac82bda497e1e90fa6e96ce.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
Weapons now have [b]all of their spells unlocked[/b] from Tier 4, bringing greater diversity to combat and giving you more to play with early on. Items can be [b]overcharged twice[/b], too, allowing fierce, large-scale battles to rage for longer. New [b]Crystal Weapons[/b] are coming for Daggers, Maces, and Holy Staffs. Guilds can now own [b]multiple islands[/b], with beautiful new visuals that reflect the atmosphere and biome of their host city. Countless other quality-of-life changes are being introduced as well, including improvements to the [b]Destiny Board[/b] and a new [b]Party Ready Check[/b] system.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a02b7efd08184be1c13bb80b25df82c76b2606f5.jpeg[/img]

[b]Paths to Glory is live now[/b], so open up your Journal and start writing your story! Read the full patchnotes [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/paths-to-glory-update][b]here[/b][/url], and check out the official update page [url=https://albiononline.com/update/paths-to-glory][b]here[/b][/url].

notes.title: Albion Online Turns Seven!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ec6a4632c4767f4c43dfc7ba5081f1f3a7b114a7.png[/img]

And just like that, Albion turned seven! With so much going on - a new server, soaring player numbers, and several big updates - the past year has just flown by. And on the eve of the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/paths-to-glory][b]Paths to Glory[/b][/url] update, it’s time to take a moment to look back at just how far the game has come. So put on your [url=https://albiononline.com/news/seventh-anniversary-sale][b]Anniversary outfit[/b][/url][b], [/b]grab a slice of [url=https://albiononline.com/news/living-legacy-2024][b]cake[/b][/url], and make yourself comfortable as we look back at some of the biggest moments of the last twelve months.

[h3]Wild Blood[/h3]
Albion’s players got a taste of [url=https://albiononline.com/update/wild-blood][b]Wild Blood[/b][/url] in the fall, as a new content update introduced some massive features to the game.

[previewyoutube=fXc7B8_mrx8;full][/previewyoutube]
With [b]Shapeshifter Weapons[/b], [b]Tracking[/b], [b]Awakened Items[/b], [b]reworked islands[/b], and much more, Wild Blood [url=https://albiononline.com/news/wild-blood-launch-stats][b]unleashed[/b][/url] Albion’s primal side, and opened up a whole world of new possibilities.

[h3]End of Year Awards[/h3]
Winter saw end-of-year awards handed out, and Albion Online added to its growing collection with two more prestigious prizes. MassivelyOP awarded Albion [b]Best PvP MMO[/b] for the [b]third year running[/b], and MMORPG.com then named the game [b]Indie MMO of the Year[/b]. Thanks again to everyone whose continued support has made this possible!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c6450edba7c3bc773660fad1f6f7932f7aad3c32.png[/img]

The end of the year also saw the announcement of a new approach to the game’s [url=https://albiononline.com/news/2024-update-plan][b]update schedule[/b][/url], which would begin at the turn of 2024…

[h3]Crystal Raiders[/h3]
No sooner had [url=https://albiononline.com/news/uncle-frost-2023][b]Uncle Frost[/b][/url] thrown his last snowball of the season, than it was time for Albion’s first update of 2024. [url=https://albiononline.com/update/crystal-raiders][b]Crystal Raiders[/b][/url] was the first in Albion’s three-monthly update cycle, and it brought some big changes to Guild Seasons.

[previewyoutube=th9a8Mu6FWM;full][/previewyoutube]
With the introduction of[b] Territory Raiding[/b] and [b]Crystal Weapons[/b], along with other changes like a [b]reworked Conqueror’s Challenge[/b], Crystal Raiders shook up guild warfare in Albion for the seasons to come.

[h3]Albion Europe[/h3]
A year after the successful launch of the Albion Asia server came another momentous announcement: Albion Online was launching a [b]brand-new server[/b] in Europe. This would bring massively improved ping to thousands of players, old and new, along with the chance to build a completely independent gameworld from the ground up.

To celebrate this development, an all-new live action trailer was released, which might have a familiar ring to some of you…

[previewyoutube=xPyw4nZlGNA;full][/previewyoutube]
Albion Europe had a unique [url=https://albiononline.com/news/europe-beta-challenge][b]Beta[/b][/url] phase, with players flocking to the new server to earn the exclusive Duelist vanity set. A special, condensed Guild Season was won by Escalation, and then, on April 29, the new server [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-europe-live][b]opened its doors[/b][/url].

[h3]Foundations[/h3]
While all this was going on, development of the game didn’t slow down. Along with the new server, April saw the release of Albion’s second update of 2024: [url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations][b]Foundations[/b][/url].

[previewyoutube=vTj-NaMx4gs;full][/previewyoutube]
Foundations continued to add new dimensions to Guild Seasons, with the introduction of [b]Fortifications[/b], [b]Siege Banners[/b], [b]Territory Activity Chests[/b], and more. With guilds now able to construct powerful defenses for their territories, Season 23 marked the beginning of a new era of warfare in Albion.

[h3]Record Player Numbers[/h3]
2024’s updates and the launch of Albion Europe made Albion more vibrant than ever before, and this was confirmed when the game smashed its [url=https://albiononline.com/news/record-player-numbers][b]player number record[/b][/url] in May.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cfda3872353587472e2128b0613e21604db1d194.jpeg[/img]

Albion Online surpassed [b]350,000 daily active users[/b] on May 1, eclipsing the previous record set a year ago with the launch of Albion Asia. With so many new and experienced players enjoying the game, it’s a truly exciting time to be a part of the world of Albion as we look ahead to the future.

[h3]Paths to Glory[/h3]
And that future begins next week, with the release of the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/paths-to-glory][b]Paths to Glory[/b][/url] update on [b]July 22[/b].

This will bring the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-albion-journal][b]Albion Journal[/b][/url], a brand-new achievement system with some very special rewards available. It also sees some big [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b], a new [b]Dynamic Spawn Rate[/b] system, [b]new Crystal Weapons[/b], and much more. With all this, Albion has never offered so much to so many players.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/203005dbee4072778b096c48825b1a87a5519a59.png[/img]

Join us in celebrating Albion’s anniversary now with the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/living-legacy-2024][b]Living Legacy[/b][/url] event, featuring some all-new statues of Albion’s previous season winners to take down. And the special [url=https://albiononline.com/news/seventh-anniversary-sale][b]Anniversary Paladin[/b][/url] vanity bundle is available until [b]July 30 at 10 UTC[/b], so grab yours while you can! Meanwhile, we’d like to once again give our thanks to you, the community, for what’s been an incredible year. Here’s to the future!

notes.title: Dev Talk: The Albion Journal
notes.content:
Following our recent Dev Talk introducing some of the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-paths-to-glory][b]many different features[/b][/url] coming in the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/paths-to-glory][b]Paths to Glory[/b][/url] update, it’s time to take a look at the core feature of Albion’s next update: the [b]Albion Journal[/b]. Game Director Robin Henkys sat down to reveal what you can find within its pages when the update launches on [b]July 22[/b].

[previewyoutube=6CJifOQyu6c;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]What is the Albion Journal?[/h3][list]	[*]The Albion Journal is an [b]achievement system[/b] designed to challenge players to explore Albion’s many gameplay areas.[/*]	[*]For [b]new players[/b], this acts as a guide with incentives to explore the various activities available in the game[/*]	[*][b]Veterans[/b], meanwhile[b],[/b] are encouraged to complete the most difficult achievements for truly exclusive rewards[/*][/list][h3]How does it work?[/h3][list]	[*]New players will gain access to the Journal once they've completed the tutorial[/*]	[*]Existing characters will have the Journal unlocked when the update arrives[/*]	[*]It can be opened directly from the [b]HUD[/b], to view open and completed missions[/*]	[*]A [b]mission tracker[/b] in the HUD shows your current progress in selected missions[/*]	[*]The missions in the journal are sorted into [b]categories[/b], and each category is further split into [b]subcategories[/b][/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0e4c6f0312f8ba6235136dab0ca22fae00a8beb1.png[/img]
[h3]Progressing through the Journal[/h3][list]	[*][b]Initial missions[/b] in each subcategory are a simple introduction to an area of gameplay[/*]	[*]As you progress through a subcategory, missions become [b]increasingly difficult[/b][/*]	[*]Missions can be completed [b]out of order[/b], even if they have not yet been unlocked – so don't worry about doing something you don't have a mission for, [b]it will still count[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2c5505a6c10e2ae80624ed9bcc9057edd0ad706a.png[/img][/b]
[h3]Individual Mission Rewards[/h3][list]	[*]Each mission grants a[b] reward[/b] which can be claimed [b]directly from the Journal UI[/b][/*]	[*]These rewards include Silver, Tomes of Insight, Dungeon Maps, and more[/*]	[*][b]Tomes of Learning[/b] – a new, non-tradable item – are also available as a reward	[list]		[*]These grant [b]Learning Points[/b] when used[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]More difficult missions offer [b]more valuable rewards[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b3f79b45fa0f65c6c578d5734d10fda7258008c9.png[/img][/b]
[h3]Category Rewards[/h3][list]	[*]Completing a certain percentage of missions within each main category unlocks [b]unique rewards[/b][/*]	[*]Each category has a themed [b]Avatar[/b], [b]Avatar Ring[/b], [b]Wardrobe Item [/b]with a [b]Vanity Spell[/b], and [b]Mount Skin[/b][/*]	[*]Completing [b]all missions [/b]in a category will grant you a super-rare, [b]elite version[/b] of the wardrobe item[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8fc7d72696ed390b02da17ffda8899cfa91ab131.png[/img]
[h3]Main Categories[/h3]
The Journal will launch with five categories:

[b]PvE[/b]:
[list]	[*]This category challenges you to participate in Albion’s various [b]PvE activities[/b][/*]	[*]The Avatar and Avatar Ring show off your prowess in dungeon exploration[/*]	[*]The unique wardrobe item is a [b]six-sided die[/b] that you can actually roll[/*]	[*]The elite version is a [b]twenty-sided die [/b]with a critical-hit celebratory roll animation[/*]	[*]The mount skin is a themed [b]Direbear[/b][/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/49b82fcf50aac7fdf88acc55ba46358934943627.png[/img]

[b]Gathering:[/b]
[list]	[*]Includes [b]gathering and fishing[/b] missions[/*]	[*]The Avatar and Avatar Ring showcase your key role in Albion’s industry[/*]	[*]The wardrobe item is a [b]powered chopping axe[/b] with a tree-chopping vanity spell[/*]	[*]The elite version features [b]awesome visual effects[/b][/*]	[*]The mount skin is a [b]mechanical boar[/b] with an integrated barbecue[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ff47fd782c893e4dc55982c2afa4b798c7ccf137.png[/img]

[b]Economy:[/b]
[list]	[*]Focuses on the marketplace, crafting, refining and other [b]economic activities[/b][/*]	[*]The Avatar and Avatar Ring show off your wealth[/*]	[*]The wardrobe skin is a [b]very fancy coat[/b] that lets you throw some of your [b]actual Silver[/b] on the ground[/*]	[*]The elite version throws [b]even more money [/b]away – you can easily afford it[/*]	[*]This mount skin is Albion’s very first [b]Mammoth skin[/b], which lets you get carried around by Black Market guards[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/be21349a408431ec2daa81eaaab6ae809e046e7f.png[/img]

[b]Exploration:[/b]
[list]	[*]Takes you [b]far and wide[/b] through the lands of Albion[/*]	[*]The Avatar and Avatar Ring have a [b]bardic[/b] theme[/*]	[*]The wardrobe item is a [b]Lute[/b] to entertain you and your friends[/*]	[*]The elite version lets you perform [b]an additional song[/b][/*]	[*]The mount skin is a very, very cute Swiftclaw skin[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/05f9a6b7469951efae7372e823d7f7989988360a.png[/img]

[b]PvP:[/b]
[list]	[*]This category pushes you to[b] fight with other players[/b][/*]	[*]The Avatar and Avatar Ring [b]strike fear[/b] into the heart of your enemies[/*]	[*]The wardrobe item is a [b]fearsome helmet[/b] which summons a [b]deathly herald[/b][/*]	[*]The elite version gives you an [b]even more threatening[/b] aura[/*]	[*]This is complemented by a frightening new [b]Direwolf skin[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d232c46e9713df1d39d245e9b36f0fab34a3b518.png[/img][/b]

We'll be adding more categories to the journal in the future, but for now, we wish you the best of luck filling your journals when Paths to Glory releases on [b]July 22[/b]!

notes.title: The Living Legacy is Back
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8290a3b61801fc86d286d9105fac1b93ce18ceb8.png[/img]

And just like that, Albion Online is turning seven! What a year it has been, huh? And to kick off the celebrations, the [b]Living Legacy[/b] event returns from [b]23 UTC on July 11 for Albion Asia[/b], and [b]10 UTC on July 12 for Albion Europe and Americas[/b]! Consider this your official invitation to the party, but wear something you can get dirty with – because you'll be hunting down statues old and new while gorging yourself on Fame-filled [b]Anniversary Cake[/b]. It might get a bit messy.

Oh, and before we forget, there’s a brand-new anniversary video too:

[previewyoutube=QC4gx-zJD4w;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Living Monuments[/h3]
The monuments to the heroes of Albion's past are coming back to life, and they have brought with them some of last year's season winners: [b]Paura[/b] from Albion Americas Season 19, and [b]Fr Bailand[/b] and [b]Winter[/b] from the first two seasons of Albion Asia!

Defeat these monumental foes as they roam through any [b]Tier 5 or higher[/b] zone for a chance to obtain [b]tradable rewards[/b] only available during the Living Legacy event:
[list]	[*][b]Seventh Anniversary Stallion[/b]: Riding Horse Skin[/*]	[*][b]Purple Anniversary Banner[/b]: Furniture Item[/*]	[*][b]Anniversary Cake[/b]: Gives you a 15% non-PvP Fame buff for 30 minutes, stackable with other foods[/*]	[*][b]Chromacannon[/b]: Vanity Weapon Skin which shoots celebratory fireworks[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4be49aa61c8ed5c2179dcaf4c89592a8c30597b7.png[/img]

The statues appear in three categories, increasing in difficulty but also in potential rewards:

notes.title: Paths to Glory Lie Ahead
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/548c256085ff661a7ec8297d25a33ebc53ea7176.jpeg[/img]

On [b]July 22[/b], the [b]Paths to Glory [/b]open up. Albion’s next major update brings the [b]Albion Journal[/b], a brand-new chronicle of your progress which grants a host of [b]unique rewards[/b]. [b]Guild Islands [/b]have been reworked, with beautiful new visuals and the possibility of multiple island ownership. Improvements are coming to the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b], and [b]Dynamic Spawn Rates [/b]adjust the amount of content in the Roads and open world based on activity levels. Along with new [b]Crystal Weapons[/b], a new [b]Rare Quarry [/b]to track down, and much more, Paths to Glory offers a host of improvements for a wide range of play styles.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/39969767e422764d0af976dc0672f20ad36cf6b6.jpeg[/img]
[h3]The Albion Journal[/h3]
Paths to Glory introduces a brand-new achievement system: the [b]Albion Journal[/b]. This presents each player with [b]missions [/b]at every stage of the game - from beginner-level tasks to truly gargantuan feats for the most experienced player - divided into [b]five main categories:[/b] PvE, PvP, Economy, Exploration, and Gathering. [b]Valuable rewards [/b]are available as you progress, from individual mission rewards like [b]Silver [/b]and [b]Tomes of Insight[/b], to unique, category-themed [b]vanity items [/b]to show off your progress to friend and foe alike.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4ceb72c25227b3f3bff26e4d69b492d9dbe3fa2c.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Roads to Glory[/h3]
This update also brings [b]Dynamic Spawn Rates [/b]to the open world and Roads of Avalon, adjusting the amount of treasure, resources, and mobs on each server throughout the day based on their activity levels. The [b]Roads of Avalon [/b]have also had their zones and content rebalanced, to make them more competitive and exciting. [b]Tracking [/b]is now possible in the Roads, and a new Rare Quarry can be hunted down too: the fearsome [b]Shadowmask[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/22ce1485fe093221735528f649f54dc91c577e93.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Choose your Path[/h3]
Guilds can now own [b]multiple islands [/b]- one for each Royal City and Caerleon - and these have gorgeous [b]new visuals [/b]reflecting the biome of their host city. [b]New Crystal Weapons [/b]are coming too, which players can earn through their Guild Season successes. In combat, weapons can be [b]overcharged twice [/b]for an extended boost, but at an increased risk of breakage, while weapons now have [b]all their spells [/b]available from Tier 4 upwards. A [b]Party Ready Check [/b]function allows better coordination in group activities, and the [b]Destiny Board [/b]has improved scaling and zooming.

With all this and more, Paths to Glory promises an improved experience in Albion whichever road you take. You can learn more about these features in this [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-paths-to-glory][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url], and on the [b]official update page[/b]:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/paths-to-glory]FIND OUT MORE[/url]

notes.title: Dev Talk: Paths to Glory Introduction
notes.content:
As Season 23 reaches its climax, it’s time to announce Albion’s next major update, coming in July: [b]Paths to Glory[/b]. At the heart of this update is the [b]Albion Journal[/b], which presents players with challenges and offers valuable new rewards. But this update also contains a host of other features, including some specific requests from the community. In this Dev Talk, [b]Game Director Robin Henkys[/b] shows us around some of the features and improvements that you’ll be able to enjoy when Paths to Glory releases next month.

[previewyoutube=Ge-A9Zyy7HY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Guild Island Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Guilds can now own [b]multiple islands[/b]	[list]		[*]Up to one island for each Royal City, plus Caerleon[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Guild Islands now [b]visually reflect the biome[/b] and atmosphere of their parent city[/*][/list][h3]Weapon Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Players can [b]double-overcharge[/b] their weapons in combat	[list]		[*]This prolongs the overcharge duration[/*]		[*]However, it also increases the risk of the weapon breaking afterwards[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Players can now use [b]all spells [/b]on weapons of Tier 4 and above	[list]		[*]This will increase gameplay variety for lower tiers[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/817d18afea3950653e0fec68a43d82d053d906a3.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Roads of Avalon Changes[/h3]
The most common request we heard was for changes to the Roads of Avalon. Many players said they couldn’t find the content they were looking for in the Roads, but our data showed activity there to be higher than ever.

For this update, we decided to focus on the core experience we had in mind when designing the Roads: an extension of the open world, creating interesting connections between places and offering opportunities for small groups. In the meantime, we’ll continue to think about other ways to provide the kind of small-scale PvP content that players are looking for.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/650b899d9b8f7aa5c8f17a5bda13fb3618b165bb.jpeg[/img]

Here’s what’s changing in the Roads:

[b]Zones[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Mob tiers standardized[/b] in each different Roads area[/*]	[*][b]Adjusted connections[/b] from the open world:	[list]		[*]Blue and Yellow Zones usually lead to Tier 4 Roads[/*]		[*]Red and Black Zones usually lead to Tier 6 Roads[/*]		[*]Tier 8 Roads are now exclusive to Deep Roads and Raid Clusters[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Number of Raid Clusters is being[b] increased[/b]	[list]		[*]This means Hideouts connect to Raid Clusters more frequently[/*]		[*]They also have a few connections to non-Hideout regions, to increase competition[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fd078bad595e0d8b097ddeb81aea59a049a90918.png[/img]

[b]Content and Rewards[/b]
[list]	[*]The Roads contain [b]fewer areas dedicated to gathering[/b]	[list]		[*]Resource respawn rates are increasing, to keep the total resource output the same[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]More PvE areas[/b] have been added	[list]		[*]These offer less Fame than before, to balance their leveling potential with other content[/*]		[*]To compensate, they offer more loot instead​[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Tracking[/b] has been added to the Roads	[list]		[*]This includes a new target that can be hunted here and in the open world: the [b]Shadowmask[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f70b5b2a2f35794fd92c3f5eb04263b4d5a2e54a.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Activity-Based Spawn Rates[/h3]
[b]Activity-Based Spawn Rates[/b] is a significant new feature coming to the Roads and the open world.
[list]	[*]Each server’s activity levels will be measured ongoingly[/*]	[*]Spawn and upgrade rates for treasures, mobs, and resources will adjust based on this metric[/*]	[*]During Prime Time, it should be easier to find content[/*]	[*]During low-activity periods, it will be more challenging and competitive to find massive rewards[/*][/list]
This adjustment will not be too strong, so periods of low activity will still offer more resources per player, but resources will be better distributed across time periods.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7e582bfa15912d9e72a74954ff70e2750a4fe180.jpeg[/img]
[h3]New Crystal Weapons[/h3]
Paths to Glory will introduce the third batch of [b]Crystal Weapons[/b].
[list]	[*][b]Twin Slayers (Daggers): [/b]creates a ring of spinning blades that return to the caster, cutting through all enemies in their path[/*]	[*][b]Dreadstorm Monarch (Mace): [/b]creates a growing storm around you, slowing enemies and shredding their resistances[/*]	[*][b]Exalted Staff (Holy Staff): [/b]can remove areas like Sacred Ground[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b8adac5bdb660c1f40339132e10d7fcd52afbe74.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]The [b]Party Ready Check[/b] function lets party leaders see when their group members are ready for action[/*]	[*][b]Corrupted Dungeon Maps[/b] allow you to easily open entrances to these dungeons[/*]	[*]Three [b]new activity events [/b]for Roads of Avalon, Tracking, and the Mists[/*]	[*]Improved filtering in the [b]Rankings UI[/b][/*]	[*]Rescaled [b]Destiny Board [/b]with improved zoom functionality for desktop users[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d9a2921167849a7bf0c334ac5755ec875e17645a.jpeg[/img]

All this is coming to Albion next month when Paths to Glory launches - and that’s not to mention the heart of the update: the Albion Journal. Join us for another Dev Talk soon, where we’ll take a look at this new feature and the unique rewards it brings to the game!

notes.title: The Community Fame Rush is Coming!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f5ad849a181aa59297cd14df9945345c48a4a9d7.jpeg[/img]

We did it! The Albion Online [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/albiononline][b]Reddit[/b][/url] community has hit the [b]100,000 subscriber[/b] mark, and to celebrate this achievement with you we’re having a three-day [b]Community Fame Rush[/b].

So sharpen your blades and saddle up your mounts, because this weekend you'll automatically receive an additional [b]25% Fame[/b] for all in-game activities! Dates are as follows:
[list]	[*][b]Albion Asia[/b]: June 13 to June 16 (begins and ends with maintenance)[/*]	[*][b]Albion Europe[/b] and [b]Americas[/b]: June 14 to June 17 (begins and ends with maintenance)[/*][/list]
(Note that this buff does not apply to fame earned from PvP kills and Tomes of Insight, and does not increase the rate at which you earn Challenge Points.)

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9ad3bdbc11d2bfe71498b72221d467f461582b1c.jpeg[/img]

Here’s to our amazing [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/albiononline][b]r/albiononline[/b][/url] community! If you haven’t checked it out yet, it’s home to a passionate bunch of players eager to share their wisdom and discuss all things Albion, from guides and fan art to builds and random questions. So come join us, and see you in Albion this weekend!

notes.title: The Knight Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/72716c5b77be445c25b5c93df28fe57945437ff0.jpeg[/img]

Who says chivalry is dead? For the entire month of June, take the [b]Knight Challenge[/b] to collect fantastic rewards. Earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim the powerful and imposing [b]Gallant Horse[/b] mount.

[h3][b]Knight Moves[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hinTWA0.png[/img]

[b]GALLANT HORSE:[/b] 
This month's Challenge brings back the powerful [b]Gallant Horse[/b], a noble mount with a combination speed boost / immunity spell that leaves foes in the dust. Ride fearlessly into the wilds of Albion on the back of this mighty steed!

 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bCKrrJm.png[/img]

[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] 
Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Knight Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], a bold, plate-armor-themed ring that will give your avatar an aura of nobility. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar ring for one character – or you can trade it at the Vanity Merchant for one Adventurer's Token.
 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kxPZwxn.png[/img]

[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] 
All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Knight Challenge chests[/b]. These chests contain valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes and Silver bags, plus knight-themed furniture like the [b]Stone Throne, Round Table, Knight Statue, [/b]and [b]Regal Carpet[/b].


As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, [/b]and [b]killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim your rewards!

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/63aec52915063_720.mp4[/video]

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim your rewards!

notes.title: Albion Europe is Open!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/331a7c33a172b6bdeacd0f2eb4afbf5ae5099b81.jpeg[/img]

After much anticipation, [b]Albion Europe[/b] is now open to all players! This brand-new server offers a [b]fresh version of Albion[/b] for you to make your mark on, and [b]substantially improved ping[/b] for players in the Europe and MENA regions. Already, players are out there crafting gear, gathering resources, and building up the economy from scratch. A new chapter in Albion’s history begins today!

[previewyoutube=xPyw4nZlGNA;full][/previewyoutube]
To get this new server off the ground as smoothly as possible, a number of measures are temporarily in place to give all players the best experience possible. This includes an initially reduced world size, some items added to the Marketplace, and certain restrictions on the Black Market. For more details on these measures, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/195377][b]this forum post[/b][/url].
[h3]The Untold Story[/h3]
But who are these brave bards stepping onto Albion Europe with tales to tell via the medium of music? Could it be…. Austrian power-metallers [b]Dragony[/b]?!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5b46bc05d23659d33e90f5ad725417dbbad28844.jpeg[/img]

It could indeed! That’s right, Dragony has written a brand-new track, [b]“The Untold Story”[/b], to mark this momentous occasion. The song captures the spirit of adventure, and the thrill of writing your own story, that is at the heart of Albion Online, and they even dared venture onto Albion’s shores to film a music video for it. Check it out here:

[previewyoutube=ZSLuF-MVh2Y;full][/previewyoutube]
So it’s official - after many requests we can finally announce: [b]Albion Online has Dragony[/b].
[h3]Twitch Drop Campaign[/h3]
And that’s not all - we’re also running a special [b]Twitch Drop[/b] campaign to mark the launch of the new server. Until [b]11:00 UTC on May 8[/b], players watching Albion Online streams can earn themselves the most adorable [b]Brown Alpaca[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5692a3ae1e8185b27e48af2a18437d95062ccd05.jpeg[/img]

This Stag mount skin can be yours if you watch streams from members of the Albion Online Creators Program for at least [b]15 hours[/b] during this period, and after that time the skin will still be available in Community Chests. If you already have a Brown Alpaca, don’t worry - you can still earn one and salvage it for Community Tokens, which can be traded in for a different skin. And this campaign runs [b]in addition to[/b] our regular daily chests. So if you’re not busy building up your character on Albion Europe, tune into Twitch to get a fluffy new mount skin!
[h3]Watch the First Guild Season[/h3]
[b]Season 23[/b] begins on Albion Europe on [b]May 4[/b], and we’ll be bringing you the action live on AlbionTV.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7f55ae8006b1f0c456141500c734abfd0bf10d85.jpeg[/img]

At [b]17:50 on Saturday 4 May[/b], join hosts Robinhoodrs, Shozen, and Bogul to watch the very first territory invasions on the new server. With guilds eager to stake their claims in the Outlands early on, it’s sure to be an exciting occasion. Check out the full season schedule [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/194638-Season-23-Schedules/][b]here[/b][/url], and see you at the weekend!

With the launch of Albion Europe, this season sees some changes introduced to territories across all three servers, to optimize action times and better serve each region. For a rundown of these changes, click [url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-23-changes][b]here[/b][/url].

[list]	[*]Levels 1-2 reduced from four daily matches to two[/*]	[*]Level 3 reduced from eight daily matches to four[/*][/list]

notes.title: The “Foundations” Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a223dfd54182c21ade978aec1a41480233a668a7.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Foundations[/b] are ready for a new era in warfare! With mighty [b]Fortifications[/b], rousing [b]Siege Banners[/b], overflowing [b]Territory Activity Chests[/b], and a lot more, Albion’s latest update lays the groundwork for fierce battles all across its lands.

In anticipation of what’s about to unfold, we’ve produced a brand-new trailer for the occasion. Check it out here:

[previewyoutube=vTj-NaMx4gs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Man the Barricades[/h3]
This update introduces[b] Fortifications[/b] to territory warfare. Guilds can upgrade the walls, gates, and guards protecting their territories, providing progressively more staunch barriers to would-be attackers. [b]Siege Banners[/b], meanwhile, change the dimensions of territory battles, forcing attackers and defenders alike to rethink their tactics - attackers must carry a banner to the territory tower to be victorious, but defenders have the opportunity to end an attack early by controlling the banner themselves, until it’s destroyed.

For more on these exciting new features, check out this [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-fortifications][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/59d13a9a8dcbb7422c3e263421827979ce58ca79.jpeg[/img]
[h3]New Incentives[/h3]
[b]Territory Activity Chests[/b] accumulate loot based on activity levels in surrounding regions. This encourages guilds to be active around their holdings, and even to ensure outsiders operate in safety there. But with greater riches comes an incentive for rivals, who can loot the chests and make off with the spoils themselves.

Foundations also introduces the next three[b] Crystal Weapons[/b] in the game: the[b] Arctic Staff[/b], [b]Phantom Twinblade[/b], and [b]Crystal Reaper[/b]. With unique, powerful spells, these weapons offer a prestigious reward for players who are successful in the Conqueror’s Challenge.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/baf7453dd7db33e06c38b58a8acbfeb8bb1d3a23.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Further Features[/h3]
A much-anticipated [b]Spectator Mode[/b] gives creators and streamers the ability to broadcast their own Custom Matches, allowing them to organize their own, exciting tournaments however they want to. [b]Hammers[/b] have been refreshed with [b]new spells[/b], ready to strike down opponents on Albion’s battlefields. And a host of further features have been added across the game, such as solo [b]Tracking [/b]improvements, [b]new territory layouts[/b], and a number of combat balance changes.

Foundations is live now, so log in and check out these new features! For a full rundown of the changes in this update, read the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/foundations][b]patchnotes[/b][/url], and see the [b]official update page[/b] for more info:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations]LEARN MORE[/url]

notes.title: Guild Season Wrapup: 22 Americas / 4 Asia
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1486fe0d7fe6d2e1960ce0f9e41a98d7ab6aec35.jpeg[/img]

The first [b]Guild Season[/b] of 2024 has reached its conclusion, and it’s time to congratulate the winners! So hats off to [b]IFures[/b], who claimed their first title on [b]Albion Americas[/b], and [b]PLAC[/b], who successfully defended their crown on [b]Albion Asia[/b]. Read on for a rundown of how the seasons played out…

[h3]Albion Americas: IFures Rise to the Top[/h3]
[b]Season 22[/b] began with a flurry of activity, as two major forces announced they'd be gunning for top spot. Both [b]IFures[/b] &[b] Superiore[/b] charged into the season battling it out over castles, cores, vortexes, and anything else that would give Season Points. It soon became clear that this clash of the titans wouldn't just involve these two guilds, though, and it wasn't long until coalitions were formed on both sides.

But within the first week Superiore suffered a devastating defeat in their homeland, [b]Sunfang Cliffs[/b], with IFures able to break through their lines and raid the territory, claiming the Raw Energy and causing a massive rift within Superiore. Within twenty-four hours this led to the guild’s collapse, seemingly opening the way for IFures to steamroll their way through the rest of the season.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/03395ffdd3a76068bc9810d4d3396660b866b7a4.jpeg[/img]

It wasn't all plain sailing from here though, as another contender for the top prize, [b]FAX[/b], stepped up and threw their gauntlet into the ring. This sparked conflicts across multiple timers, but IFures were up for the fight and, in the final month of the season, managed to breach FAX’s homelands and raid their energy. This didn't come without its costs, though, as the FAX coalition was able to evict [b]Contingent [/b]from their home of [b]Darkbough Snag [/b]in the process.

On the final Invasion Day, IFures managed to secure the title, ending their season with just over 1 million points, with FAX coming in second with 869,000 points, and [b]B l a c k-L i s t [/b]third with 581,000 points.

[h3]Albion Asia: PLAC Hold their Title[/h3]
[b]Season 4[/b] got off to a quieter start than previous seasons on [b]Albion Asia[/b], due to the hangover from the season-long war of Season 3. With guilds settling down and making pacts, [b]PLAC [/b]was set for a straightforward victory.

It wasn't long until things spiced up, though, and with the [b]SQUAD [/b]alliance still out for blood against the [b]LIGHT [/b]alliance, pockets of action flared up. Raids gradually gathered pace, along with battles for castles and vortexes, and it wasn't long until a full-scale war broke out again. This lasted until the end of the season, with both sides putting up some incredible battleboards.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/62a96ad356bc67c5080db882809cc431fba85558.jpeg[/img]

But, midway through the season, it wasn't SQUAD that LIGHT were looking to blind, but rather [b]Vermin [/b]and their comfortable hold on second place. [b]RADIANT [/b]looked to loosen their grip and, after a week of raids, Vermin soon conceded and RADIANT were on the way to second spot.

The final Invasion Day was another bloody one, as RADIANT looked to secure their homeland of [b]Sunfang Cliffs[/b], a territory holding 60,000 Season Points. With everyone’s gaze fixed here, RADIANT claimed the territory after a thirty-minute battle, and with that secured second place for the season.

In the final reckoning, PLAC took first place with a million points, followed by RADIANT in 2nd with 635,000 points and Vermin in third with 585,000 points.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/78804cd168c08624475015fa746b2fb18475c2c3.jpeg[/img]

[b]Season 23 [/b](as it will be known across all servers) kicks off [b]April 20[/b], bringing [b]Fortifications[/b], [b]Siege Banners[/b], [b]Territory Activity Chests[/b], and more new features introduced with the [b][url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations]Foundations[/url] [/b]update. It also ushers in some important changes to the way seasons operate in Albion - for details about these changes, click [url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-23-changes][b]here[/b][/url], and for the full season schedules, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/194638-Season-23-Schedules/][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

notes.title: The Albion Europe Open Beta is Live!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/37fe9cb36ef1298687b45043f6c2e354a13db50c.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Albion Europe Open Beta[/b] is now here, for[b] anyone[/b] who wants to join! Until [b]April 23[/b], players can earn the new [b]Duelist[/b] vanity set, play on a condensed version of Albion with massively [b]buffed progress[/b], and experience the new server before it officially launches - and it’s [b]completely free to play[/b]. Read on for more details…

[previewyoutube=vKt2NkOk37M;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Beta Challenge[/h3]
In the [b]Beta Challenge[/b], you can unlock a brand-new, exclusive vanity set: the Duelist. This razor-sharp fighter is not available in any store, and once unlocked can be used [b]on any server[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f586a137f89da55c651166b6690c5db28ed84837.png[/img]

Performing open-world activities will grant players challenge points, which you can use to unlock each of the vanity items. The milestones for each item are as follows:
[list]	[*][b]25,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Boots[/*]	[*][b]50,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Cape[/*]	[*][b]75,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Hat[/*]	[*][b]100,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Armor[/*]	[*][b]100,000 points[/b] and [b]Founder Status[/b]: Duelist’s Lynx[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f5a63cdc3ba8c7012d80f7c6af150df3dcae0b75.jpeg[/img]

At the same time, the Albion Europe Beta Season is running, giving guilds the opportunity to earn more unique rewards like [b]custom guild logos[/b] and a [b]custom season statue[/b].

[h3]A Unique Experience[/h3]
Players in the Albion Europe Beta receive a number of additional benefits to help them progress quickly through the stages of the game. These are:
[list]	[*][b]Premium status[/b] for the whole beta[/*]	[*][b]2000 Learning Points[/b][/*]	[*][b]+100% Fame[/b] from gathering, farming, and PvE[/*]	[*][b]+200% Resources[/b] from gathering and fishing[/*]	[*][b]+200% Silver[/b] from mobs[/*]	[*]Resource weight [b]reduced by 66%[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/974639172db1656c646192818234b05f70a0575d.jpeg[/img][/b]

The game world has a reduced scale, giving a unique, condensed version of Albion - the Royal Continent includes only the [b]Highland[/b] and [b]Steppe[/b] biomes, along with the city of [b]Caerleon[/b], while the Outlands is also considerably smaller than usual.

Please also note that the ingame store and Gold Market will be unavailable in the Beta.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/26117d0fa4c06675a7f42fb3c420969acdbd742a.jpeg[/img]

The Albion Europe Open Beta runs until [b]10 UTC on April 23[/b], so take this opportunity to experience a fresh rush on the new server, and earn your Duelist vanity set!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Fortifications
notes.content:
The [url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations][b]Foundations update[/b][/url] launches [b]April 15[/b], and promises to reshape warfare in Albion Online. At the heart of this update are three major new features coming to territories: [b]Fortifications[/b], [b]Siege Banners[/b], and [b]Territory Activity Chests[/b]. In this Dev Talk ahead of their release, [b]Game Director Robin Henkys[/b] sits down to give more information on these features, and what they’ll mean for the game going forward.

[previewyoutube=WcFauluLlqY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Fortification Upgrades[/h3]
At the beginning of the next Guild Season, all territories will receive an [b]updated layout[/b]:
[list]	[*]There are [b]five[/b] possible layouts[/*]	[*]These offer different natural obstacles and possibilities for [b]Fortification upgrades[/b][/*][/list]
Territories generate [b]Fortification Points[/b]:
[list]	[*]This starts at the beginning of each season[/*]	[*]They reset at the end of each season[/*]	[*]The amount generated in a territory depends on its [b]Energy Level[/b][/*][/list]
Players with the [b]“Manage Fortifications”[/b] guild right can use these to upgrade a territory’s Fortifications. There are three elements which can be upgraded: [b]Guards[/b], [b]Walls[/b], and [b]Gates[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c64e1a7176703e0381903bce2ec54c4b8e22fc62.jpeg[/img]

[b]Guards[/b]

Clicking a guard opens the Upgrade UI for that group of guards:
[list]	[*]This displays the [b]cost and effects[/b] of upgrading[/*]	[*]Once agreed to, the Silver is immediately taken from the guild account[/*]	[*]The guard group then upgrades [b]immediately[/b][/*]	[*]A guard group can only be upgraded [b]once a day[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/06be687998a30439d260bce379dddb2d7dbab92f.jpeg[/img][/b]

[b]Walls and Gates[/b]

Clicking a wall or gate will also display their upgrade group and UI:
[list]	[*]This displays the [b]cost and effects[/b] of upgrading[/*]	[*]However, upgrades take effect [b]after the following Prime Time[/b]	[list]		[*]This ensures that walls and gates can’t be upgraded in response to a declared attack[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]During Prime Time[/b], walls and gates prevent enemies from entering your territory:
[list]	[*]Enemies need to break through these defenses with a [b]Siege Hammer[/b][/*]	[*]Defenders can also use Siege Hammers to [b]repair walls and gates[/b][/*]	[*]Upgraded walls and gates have [b]more hit points[/b], buying the defenders more time to repair them[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5abd2d32b181dabcbd876a180a71a94863319d92.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Fortification Gates[/h3]
Each gate has a [b]crystal[/b] embedded in it, which allows defenders to [b]teleport[/b] through the gate for a quick retreat:
[list]	[*][b]Destroying the crystal[/b] removes this ability for the rest of the battle[/*]	[*]Once the crystal is destroyed, the gate can [b]take damage[/b][/*]	[*]Gates can be [b]repaired[/b], but crystals cannot[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/eeb368b79f8bd848c1745cb2e5f49ddf6cc01804.jpeg[/img]

Gates can be opened:
[list]	[*]By defenders with the “[b]Open/Close Fortification Gates[/b]” permission[/*]	[*]By attackers who are [b]inside the gates[/b][/*][/list]
Defenders will therefore need to be careful when opening gates, as attackers can try to rush inside.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/97f93cae8af1d49a2de561481c3f690939feddc6.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Siege Banners[/h3]
Territories are shielded from attack by the Territory Crystal for most of the day. During Prime Time, however, this shielding can be weakened with new [b]Siege Banners.[/b]

A banner can be raised by a player with a Siege Banner in their inventory, and the [b]“Raise Siege Banner”[/b] permission.
[list]	[*]If they do not have a previously declared attack, they will raise a [b]Raid Banner[/b], alerting the defending guild[/*]	[*]If they do have a previously declared attack, they will raise a [b]Conquest Banner[/b]	[list]		[*]This must be raised in the [b]first fifteen minutes[/b] of Prime Time[/*]		[*]This significantly [b]strengthens[/b] the territory’s guards[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Either of these raised banners will degrade the territory’s [b]Force Shield[/b], allowing its walls and gates to take damage[/*]	[*]There is a [b]limit [/b]to how many players can attack a certain wall at any one time[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f4ffe5194440a632a8b8eb64a32dd460b0780b9e.jpeg[/img]

Banners significantly change territory battles:
[list]	[*]A raid or attack only ends when	[list]		[*]The banner bearer reaches the[b] territory tower[/b] and successfully channels[/*]		[*]The defender kills the banner bearer, and controls the banner until it [b]despawns[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]If the banner bearer leaves the proximity of the territory, the banner is [b]dropped[/b][/*]	[*]If the attackers have not succeeded by the end of Prime Time, [b]the defenders are declared victorious[/b][/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c26fa28201957523c6547d7a2f556f38addd545a.jpeg[/img]

Siege Banners ensure that territory battles actually happen during Prime Time. They also allow defenders to end an attack early, if they control the banner for long enough. And in the case of raids, there is a clear starting point, allowing defenders to rush to the territory.

After a battle, broken walls and gates, and killed guards, respawn. However, if a territory is conquered:
[list]	[*]Its [b]upgrades are destroyed[/b][/*]	[*]The spent Fortification Points are [b]transferred to the new owners[/b]	[list]		[*]This allows them to [b]immediately begin upgrading[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6a9d578b34a167f2d20e84f68f2944b63df8d4f1.jpeg[/img][/b]

Fortification upgrades also reset on reset days, and at the end of each season. This facilitates a [b]constant demand for stone[/b] in the economy, and means the system can be adjusted between seasons. The cost of upgrades is affected by the region’s [b]quality level[/b].
[h3]Territory Activity Chests[/h3]
New [b]Territory Activity Chests[/b] are also coming:
[list]	[*]These are located [b]next to the territory tower[/b][/*]	[*]They are [b]filled each day[/b] at the beginning of Prime Time[/*]	[*][b]PvE activity[/b] in the local and connected regions determines what they are filled with	[list]		[*]Killing mobs, gathering, and fishing generate a [b]chance of adding loot to the chest[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d819e47e694f6cb5a791ad8a8b3583ea7fe1b541.jpeg[/img]

The owning guild can [b]claim this loot[/b] at the end of Prime Time. However, it can be [b]looted by raiders[/b] who reach the tower beforehand, offering a further incentive to build strong Fortifications.

Fortifications, then, represent a significant change to territory warfare in Albion:
[list]	[*]Guilds can [b]strategize[/b] how to upgrade Fortifications[/*]	[*]Attackers can formulate [b]new tactics and builds[/b] to break through[/*]	[*]Territory Activity Chests affect the attractiveness of territories, and [b]how guilds respond to activity in their regions[/b][/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/65a94a2128f4f8d21cec8f10e8c9a12422de5167.jpeg[/img]

This update is just the beginning of Fortifications, and opens the door to further development and expansion in the future. We can’t wait to see them begin to rise up at the start of the next season, along with all the other features coming with [b]Foundations[/b] on [b]April 15[/b]. See you then!

notes.title: The “Foundations” Update Launches April 15
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a223dfd54182c21ade978aec1a41480233a668a7.jpeg[/img]

As the current Guild Season reaches its climax, it’s already time to get ready for Albion’s next major content update. On [b]April 15[/b], [b]Foundations[/b] will launch, bringing with it a host of new developments and improvements. [b]Fortifications [/b]are upgradable defensive features for territories, and [b]Siege Banners[/b] offer possibilities for attackers and defenders alike. [b]Territory Activity Chests[/b] offer enticing rewards for territory owners - as well as their rivals. [b]New Crystal Weapons[/b] are coming, with a range of powerful spells. And a [b]Spectator Mode [/b]allows Albion’s creators to broadcast Arena battles and tournaments. With all this and more, Foundations opens the gates to new forms of warfare in Albion.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/451d5ca1489731a7a73517cf3ae7ef7e7e6c4bcb.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Raise the Banner[/h3]
[b]Fortifications[/b] offer formidable defensive structures for guilds of all sizes, and will bring forth new tactics and strategies in territorial combat. These structures, and their guards, can be further [b]upgraded[/b] by guilds who invest the time and resources, becoming mighty barriers against those who seek to raid and conquer. In addition, [b]Siege Banners[/b] complement this, adding a new twist to territory fights by providing opportunities for attacking and defending guilds alike.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e5b8e2e96e69701d179d3e0cdefb828cd6f88e5e.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Territories Transformed[/h3]
[b]Territory Activity Chests[/b] encourage constant activity around territories - but the more value they accrue, the more enticing they become to potential attackers. Territories in the Outlands also now have [b]new layouts[/b]. Meanwhile, [b]Prime Times[/b] have been adjusted across the different servers, to provide more consistent action for each region.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a1df58574894e6b882cda6507728b7bd34fb8c2c.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Let Battle Commence[/h3]
[b]New Crystal Weapons[/b] are coming, offering an array of powerful and prestigious prizes to top season performers. [b]Hammers[/b] are getting fresh and formidable new spells too, shaking up the combat meta. And a new [b]Spectator Mode[/b] gives creators the freedom to set up and broadcast their own Arena battles, opening the door to exciting, player-run tournaments.

With all this, [b]Foundations[/b] lays the groundwork for some exciting new developments to warfare in Albion. For more details, check out the [b]official update page[/b]:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations]LEARN MORE[/url]

notes.title: The Rites of Spring is Back with a Massive Fame Boost!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/85a6cd1548e1db89cb5c8d1b1622dff8a56f6c93.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Rites of Spring[/b] are back in Albion, and this year they’re accompanied by an unprecedented [b]35% Fame boost[/b]!

For a full two weeks, you can enjoy this huge increase on Fame earned through your ingame activities:
[list]	[*]This buff automatically grants an additional [b]35% Fame[/b] for all non-PvP activities[/*]	[*]The buff does not apply to Fame earned via PvP kills and Tomes of Insight, and does not boost the rate at which Challenge Points are earned[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/60a608e41ef47b382ef742d466a752c2d7a141ea.jpeg[/img]

The dates for this year's Rites of Spring are as follows:
[list]	[*][b]Albion Asia [/b](formerly Albion East): March 19 to April 2 (begins and ends with maintenance)[/*]	[*][b]Albion Americas [/b](formerly Albion West): March 20 to April 3 (begins and ends with maintenance)[/*][/list]
And, of course, there’s a whole array of seasonal rewards for you to earn during this time, including the return of the [b]Spring Cottontail[/b] and [b]Caerleon Cottontail[/b] mounts. Read on to learn more…
[h3]Spring’s Bounty[/h3]
Across the open world, all treasure chests will be sprouting up at a much increased rate for the duration of this event. And in addition, special [b]Spring Treasure Chests[/b] will be appearing, containing a host of valuable items and, if you’re lucky, [b]Spring Cottontail Eggs[/b] and [b]Eerie Cottontail Eggs[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c3ddc096188e1486e8df962fc097f9ecb8afe317.jpeg[/img]

These Eggs can be raised into the [b]Spring Cottontail[/b] and [b]Caerleon Cottontail[/b] mounts, respectively. These[b] Tier 8 mounts[/b] are notoriously difficult to catch - both in their rarity and their speed - and are simply some of the cutest mounts you’ll ever see. Each come with a unique [b]Hop[/b] ability, while the Caerleon Cottontail also has the terrifying [b]Rabbit Frenzy[/b] ability. You really don’t want to be on the wrong end of that, trust me.
[h3]…And There’s More[/h3]
On top of all these rewards, [b]Colored Eggs[/b] are popping up across Albion again, containing [b]chocolate[/b], [b]Surprise Eggs[/b], and, very occasionally, [b]Cottontail Eggs[/b]. Yes, that’s a lot of [b]eggs[/b]. And it’s a busy time for Albion’s vanity merchants, who are sure to do a roaring trade in [b]Eggsecutioner[/b] vanity weapons, [b]“Bunny Stalker”[/b] Wardrobe items, [b]Chocolate Bars[/b], and more.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1f557a77d35faaab76cfc6b838c9a7f4107239dd.png[/img]

Phew, that’s a lot of goodies up for grabs this year. Think we need a lie down before the frenzy starts. Oh no, what are those bunny ears coming this way…

notes.title: The Albion Europe Beta Challenge is Coming
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/974639172db1656c646192818234b05f70a0575d.jpeg[/img]

The [url=https://albiononline.com/europe][b]Albion Europe[/b][/url] server launches [b]April 29[/b], offering a fresh start on an untouched world, along with optimized game timers and ping for Albion’s players in the Europe and MENA regions. And from [b]April 3 at 11:00 UTC to April 23 at 10:00 UTC[/b] we’ll be running a unique [b]Beta Challenge[/b], with exclusive rewards up for grabs for individuals and guilds alike! Read on for details…
[h3]Exclusive Vanity Rewards[/h3]
The Beta Challenge offers every participant the opportunity to unlock an exclusive, brand-new vanity set: the [b]Duelist[/b]. This full wardrobe set will transform your character into a dashing swordfighter, masterful in close-quarters combat and ready to pounce on your enemies weaknesses. Once unlocked, the Duelist will be available to all characters on your account, [b]on any server[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f586a137f89da55c651166b6690c5db28ed84837.png[/img]

Performing open-world activities will grant players challenge points, and as you earn more of these points you can use them to unlock each of the vanity items. And in addition, Albion Europe Founder Pack owners will be able to unlock a matching mount skin: the [b]Duelist’s Lynx[/b]!

The milestones for each item are as follows
[list]	[*][b]25,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Boots[/*]	[*][b]50,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Cape[/*]	[*][b]75,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Hat[/*]	[*][b]100,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Armor[/*]	[*][b]100,000 points[/b] and [b]Founder Status[/b]: Duelist’s Lynx[/*][/list]
[previewyoutube=tzXrO7EupHk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Beta Season[/h3]
There will also be a one-off [b]Beta Guild Season[/b] running for the duration of the Albion Europe Beta, with more unique rewards up for grabs for guilds:
[list]	[*][b]Custom Guild Logos[/b]: The five guilds with the highest ranking at the end of the season will each get a unique custom guild logo, created in collaboration with our art team. These logos will be added to the game after the beta, and become permanently available to guilds on all servers.[/*]	[*][b]Custom Season Statue[/b]: The season’s top ranking guild will also get their own unique custom guild statue, which will be permanently placed in the open world for all to see.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Albion Online is Coming to Europe!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/331a7c33a172b6bdeacd0f2eb4afbf5ae5099b81.jpeg[/img]

Albion Online will launch a [b]new server for the Europe and MENA regions[/b] in April 2024! This server will make the world of Albion more accessible than ever for countless new and existing players. Along with offering [b]greatly improved connection speeds and ping[/b] for players in the region, the new server will also offer [b]optimized timers[/b] for ingame events, as Albion's two newest languages, [b]Turkish and Arabic[/b], further expand Albion's global community.

notes.title: Dev Talk: Foundations Introduction
notes.content:
[b]Crystal Raiders[/b] kicked off 2024 with a bang for Albion Online, bringing [b]Territory Raiding[/b], a reworked [b]Conqueror’s Challenge[/b], and the opportunity to compete for [b]Crystal Weapons[/b]. But it also marked the start of Albion’s new update schedule, and it’s already time to introduce the next major update: [b]Foundations[/b]. Game Director Robin Henkys sat down to share some insights into what’s in the pipeline.

[previewyoutube=zrKLaItYEao?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube][h3]Fortifications[/h3]
Crystal Raiders has seen the Outlands become more active among a more diverse range of guilds, thanks to the new mechanics it brought to Guild Seasons. At the same time, Territory Raiding can be difficult to defend against, particularly for smaller guilds.

With this in mind, the Foundations update will introduce a new territory feature: [b]Fortifications[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3ccee390d0621b521126651c81a4885f336cc451.jpeg[/img]
[list]	[*]Guilds can build and improve [b]fortified walls and gates [/b]in territories to hold attackers at bay[/*]	[*][b]Higher tiers [/b]of Fortifications will be harder to break down, allowing more time for the defenders to rally their forces[/*]	[*][b]Territory Guards [/b]will also be reworked, and will be able to be upgraded to [b]unlock new abilities[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9c54f1b18da6439d56e5dcdb158e11687262aa00.jpeg[/img][/b]

Fortifications stand to benefit the game in a variety of ways:
[list]	[*]As upgrading Fortifications will require stone, this will catalyze Albion’s [b]stone economy[/b][/*]	[*]Defenders will have to make [b]strategic choices [/b]when upgrading Fortifications	[list]		[*]It won’t be possible to upgrade an entire Fortification in one go[/*]		[*]Defenses will reset after a successful invasion, and at the end of a Guild Season[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]These choices will then guide attackers’ tactics, and bring [b]greater variety [/b]to territory battles and raids[/*]	[*]This system will be [b]further expanded [/b]in the future with more choices for both attackers and defenders[/*][/list]
[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/51a95156de3b62b25a1f8663c11169a06bd80167.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/dd57030757b7083e0cf694253dd52aef1278f6c1.jpeg[/img][/url]
[h3]Daily Reward Chests[/h3]
To add a further incentive for guilds to strengthen their territory defenses, their [b]value will be increased[/b]:
[list]	[*]Territories will give [b]Daily Reward Chests[/b]	[list]		[*]The contents of these chests increases based on [b]player activity in the territory and surrounding regions[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]This will [b]encourage guilds to be active [/b]in and around their territories[/*]	[*]It will also [b]discourage guilds from attacking players [/b]doing PvE activities near their territories	[list]		[*]Guilds may even look to [b]protect such players [/b]from potential attackers[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/60ca8eb6938e4ef99b816de00a26a4cfa6fc2ead.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Further Additions and Improvements[/h3]
The Foundations update will of course include additional features, for example:
[list]	[*]The next batch of [b]Crystal Weapons[/b][/*]	[*]A much-anticipated [b]Spectator Mode [/b]which will allow players to watch Custom Matches	[list]		[*]This will open the door to [b]community-organized tournaments[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/792b1140eeba80a1d43de7e5ffd102fb525b7707.jpeg[/img][/b]

Raiding and Fortifications will receive ongoing refinements and additions beyond this update, and new Crystal Weapons will of course continue to be developed. But beyond that, we will look to improve [b]existing game features [/b]in a forthcoming update, and we welcome your suggestions and feedback!

In the meantime, thanks for watching and stay tuned for more on [b]Foundations [/b]soon!

notes.title: Crystal Raiders is Live
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d17929b6f9d88bc193263ec787257b67d356ad75.jpeg[/img]

[b]Crystal Raiders[/b] is here! This update introduces major new additions and improvements to guild warfare in Albion, with [b]Territory Raiding, Crystal Weapons,[/b] [b]Guild Season updates[/b], and much more.

To mark the occasion, we’ve produced a new trailer:

[previewyoutube=th9a8Mu6FWM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Guild Warfare Re-Envisioned[/h3]

Crystal Raiders introduces a new [b]Territory Raiding[/b] system that brings thrilling new dimensions to territory control, while allowing smaller guilds more opportunities to strike. [b]Hideouts [/b]are rebalanced to offer more stability the longer they are held, with reworked crafting bonuses based on Power level. And [b]Might[/b] and [b]Might Levels[/b] have been updated to give smaller guilds more ways to earn Season Points, while increasing the challenge for larger guilds focused on bigger objectives such as Castles.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/999049680a35e7161de57cb9c162e8f524fd336d.png[/img]
[h3]New Weapons, Improved Rewards[/h3]

Crystal Raiders introduces [b]Crystal Weapons[/b], powerful weapons with unique abilities crafted from Artifacts gained as season rewards. The first three weapons fill out the Sword, Spear, and Arcane Staff lines, with three new weapons coming each subsequent season. A daily [b]Might Bonus[/b] rewards players for territories held by their guild, and a reworked [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b] rewards both individual and guild progress.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/82dd6bb4e2b279cedc051d9873f4a2309840818a.png[/img]
[h3]Additional Improvements[/h3]
[list]	[*]Rare Tracking Targets that drop valuable loot[/*]	[*]Combat balance changes[/*]	[*]Region quality overlay for the world map[/*]	[*]Numerous optimizations and improvements[/*]	[*]…and much more[/*][/list]
For the complete list of changes, see the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/crystal-raiders-update][b]patchnotes[/b][/url], and for more info, check out the [b]official update page[/b]:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/crystal-raiders]LEARN MORE[/url]

notes.title: Feature Focus: Crystal Weapons and Season Changes
notes.content:
[url=https://albiononline.com/update/crystal-raiders][b]Crystal Raiders[/b][/url] launches January 8, bringing new life to guild warfare in Albion. In our second Feature Focus, we take a look at the new Crystal Weapons, the changes coming to the Conqueror’s Challenge, and more.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cd6d51f9da5d7ac6ac93d173203f08973143add6.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Crystal Weapons[/h3]
Crystal Raiders introduces three brand-new [b]Crystal Weapons, [/b]the first in an entirely new weapon tree.

[b]What are Crystal Weapons?[/b]
[list]	[*]Crystal Weapons are powerful new weapons created from Artifacts[/*]	[*]Their design takes a "form follows function" approach with clear shapes and prominent crystal elements[/*]	[*]The Artifacts used to create them are awarded at the end of each Guild Season in Conqueror’s Challenge Chests, meaning the first three weapons will be craftable at the end of Season 22 West / 4 East[/*]	[*]Higher-level chests award higher-tier Artifacts[/*]	[*]Each Guild Season will introduce three new Crystal Weapons, with older Artifacts still given out but in decreased quantities[/*]	[*]Unlike other weapons, the usage and crafting of Crystal Weapons benefits all other weapons in the same Destiny Board tree (Warrior, Hunter, Mage)[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/565654b3cdfe1d06d639bc2888e45f8a82666261.png[/img]

[b]What are the first three weapons?[/b]

Crystal Raiders introduces the first three Crystal Weapons, each with its own unique spell:
[list]	[*][b]Infinity Blade (Sword):[/b] the "Limitbreaker" ability allows you to charge up your sword and run into enemy forces, then inflict a devastating double strike[/*]	[*][b]Rift Glaive (Spear):[/b] the "Razor’s Edge" ability fires a massive projection of the spear’s blade, which pierces through crowds and deals massive damage[/*]	[*][b]Astral Staff (Arcane Staff):[/b] the "Starfall" ability rains a shower of deadly stars down on enemies[/*][/list]These are just the beginning: as seasons are now synced with updates, each will introduce three additional weapons in this ever-expanding and diversifying weapons tree.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3db493578e1fb6cc45e619029230b22d1ca2fe52.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Conqueror’s Challenge Changes[/h3]
With the Crystal Raiders update, the Conqueror’s Challenge has been updated to directly reward players for both their individual progress and their guild’s progress. The former guaranteed Battle Mount rewards have been replaced with new Conqueror’s Chests, which in addition to potentially still containing Battle Mounts also contain Crystal Weapon Artifacts and other valuable rewards. The value of these chests increases in two separate ways:

[list]	[*][url=https://albiononline.com/update/crystal-raiders]Crystal Raiders Update Page[/url][/*]	[*][url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/190011]Guild Season Schedule and Changes[/url][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Crystal Raiders introduces three brand-new [b]Crystal Weapons, [/b]the first in an entirely new weapon tree.
Crystal Weapons are powerful new weapons created from Artifacts
Their design takes a "form follows function" approach with clear shapes and prominent crystal elements
The Artifacts used to create them are awarded at the end of each Guild Season in Conqueror’s Challenge Chests, meaning the first three weapons will be craftable at the end of Season 22 West / 4 East
Higher-level chests award higher-tier Artifacts
Each Guild Season will introduce three new Crystal Weapons, with older Artifacts still given out but in decreased quantities
Unlike other weapons, the usage and crafting of Crystal Weapons benefits all other weapons in the same Destiny Board tree (Warrior, Hunter, Mage)
Crystal Raiders introduces the first three Crystal Weapons, each with its own unique spell:
[b]Infinity Blade (Sword):[/b] the "Limitbreaker" ability allows you to charge up your sword and run into enemy forces, then inflict a devastating double strike
[b]Rift Glaive (Spear):[/b] the "Razor’s Edge" ability fires a massive projection of the spear’s blade, which pierces through crowds and deals massive damage
[b]Astral Staff (Arcane Staff):[/b] the "Starfall" ability rains a shower of deadly stars down on enemies
These are just the beginning: as seasons are now synced with updates, each will introduce three additional weapons in this ever-expanding and diversifying weapons tree.
With the Crystal Raiders update, the Conqueror’s Challenge has been updated to directly reward players for both their individual progress and their guild’s progress.

The former guaranteed Battle Mount rewards have been replaced with new Conqueror’s Chests, which in addition to potentially still containing Battle Mounts also contain Crystal Weapon Artifacts and other valuable rewards.
Individual progress in the Conqueror’s Challenge gives access to increasingly more valuable chests
Guild progress (Season Ranking) upgrades the chests earned, expanding and increasing their loot pools
Players are in this way incentivized to boost both their own and their guild’s progress
10% of the rewards from weekly reward chests have been moved into the new Conqueror’s Chests
For each day in which an owned territory generates Siphoned Energy, all Guild Members get a Daily Might Bonus
This Might can be claimed via the Conqueror’s Challenge UI
The Might received depends on the amount of energy generated
Tracking now grants Might and Favor
Tracking Might advances the Guild’s Gathering Might Challenge

notes.title: Feature Focus: Territory Changes
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e77f3a3a5cf68b51b5493fc68cb07adc871290e1.jpeg[/img]

With [url=https://albiononline.com/update/crystal-raiders][b]Crystal Raiders[/b][/url] on the horizon, it’s time to take a closer look at some of the update’s main features. Here, we delve into the changes coming to territories, with Raiding, Control Costs, and more.
[h3]Territory Raiding[/h3]
Crystal Raiders introduces [b]Raw Energy [/b]to Albion’s territories. This is generated by Siphoning Mages and refined into [b]Siphoned Energy [/b]over time, but it also brings an opportunity to other guilds, as it can be stolen in [b]Territory Raids[/b]:
[list]	[*]Each day at prime time, a territory’s [b]Energy Storage[/b] becomes attackable[/*]	[*]A territory can be raided during prime time if all Siphoning Mages and the Sentry Mage are defeated[/*]	[*]After a successful Raid, 50% of the Stored Energy is stolen in the form of four Raw Energy Cores, which can be transported back to another guild’s territory[/*]	[*]However, if they don’t reach a new territory [b]within 30 minutes[/b], these Raw Energy Cores will revert back to their original territory[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a744b210c3bbcbe0ba8adac4f20755815445375d.png[/img]

With higher frequency than other territory warfare mechanics, Territory Raiding opens new avenues for Albion’s guilds and encourages action throughout the day:
[list]	[*]Since each Raid has to happen in a territory’s prime time, there is a good chance of a [b]defending force amassing[/b], leading to a battle[/*]	[*]However, since these are happening every day, across all prime times, they are more likely to have [b]smaller defending forces[/b] than territory invasions[/*]	[*]This brings greater opportunities for[b] impromptu, guerilla-style warfare[/b] in the Outlands[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/32472a3b5e7b9142e39ec96587eaeae284557ccb.png[/img]
[h3]Further Territory Changes[/h3]
Changes have been made to territory prime times, to ensure territory-owning guilds are not under pressure to defend their territories around the clock:
[list]	[*]Territory prime times have been reduced to one hour[/*]	[*]Siphoning Mages can now only be attacked during prime time[/*]	[*]Territory Attacks can now only be scheduled during prime time[/*][/list]
Territories now also have [b]Control Costs[/b] associated with them:
[list]	[*]Territories closer to Portal Towns have higher Control Costs[/*]	[*]Once a Control Cost of 15 has been exceeded by a guild or alliance, the [b]Siphoned Energy Drain[/b] applies, and when a Control Cost of 25 is exceeded all individual members face Fame and Silver penalties[/*]	[*]In this way, large guilds who seek to dominate the outer ring of the Outlands will be punished, and [b]encouraged to compete[/b] further in[/*]	[*]This in turn gives newer and smaller guilds a better chance at finding a foothold in the outer ring[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f0eb4f68ffda2c10f504f8c513c10233e0167c91.png[/img]

Further changes also address the relative value of territories:
[list]	[*]The [b]Siphoned Energy[/b] and [b]Season Point[/b] output of territories has a more pronounced weighting towards the inner circle of the Outlands[/*]	[*][b]Territory attack costs[/b] increase with a region’s quality and tower level[/*]	[*]Territories begin a season with a certain amount of [b]Stored Energy[/b] depending on their region quality level[/*][/list]
And the way Stored Energy is paid out has been changed:
[list]	[*]After each prime time, a percentage of Stored Energy is paid out as [b]Season Points[/b] and [b]Siphoned Energy[/b], depending on region and tower level[/*]	[*]Conquering or giving up a territory [b]no longer reduces Stored Energy[/b][/*]	[*]There is a new, [b]fourth and final Invasion Day[/b] at the end of each season, where all Stored Energy is paid out directly as Season Points[/*]	[*]Prior Invasion Days no longer pay out Stored Energy[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5df883f4bc2ff424b0d8c82725e53b097e208d44.png[/img]

All this will encourage guilds to compete over valuable territories deep in the Outlands, whether through outright control or unexpected Territory Raids, and bring ongoing conflict to Albion’s Guild Seasons. We’re excited to see how this plays out with the start of the next season on January 13, along with the other big changes coming with the update. For a full season schedule, [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/190011][b]click here[/b][/url], and stay tuned for another [b]Feature Focus[/b] coming soon!
