notes.title: The Divine Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ee8123ef823b04921923ea97e407d1ba8061b520.jpeg[/img]

Summer is in full swing, and the [b]Divine Challenge[/b] is back! For the entire month of August, earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Divine Owl[/b].
[h3][b]Simply Divine[/b][/h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d83bf046c0279d2ecc98aa9e2f8ace278a723242.png[/img]
[b]DIVINE OWL:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back this ghostly white flying mount with a brisk base move speed. This mount has a special ability, [b]Foresight[/b], which creates a shield that gives a temporary speed boost when broken. (Note: like all mounts, the Divine Owl can only move in navigable ground areas and cannot fly over obstacles.)
 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4RhCStZ.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Divine Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], which will frame your chosen avatar in a heavenly golden aura. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Vanity Token.
 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5e8qvan.png[/img]

[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Divine Challenge chests[/b]. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes and Silver, you'll also have a chance to unlock mystical furniture items like the [b]Mage Statue, Magic Rune Circle[/b], and [b]Glass Sphere[/b].
 
As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount / avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while you can!

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/62cbee83a0a08_720.mp4[/video]

notes.title: Dev Talk: Tracking
notes.content:
We recently kicked off a series of Dev Talks which take a look at a number of new features coming soon to Albion Online, starting with the all-new [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-shapeshifter][b]Shapeshifter[/b][/url] weapons. In the next of these videos, Game Director Robin Henkys takes a look at [b]Tracking[/b], a new open-world activity.

[previewyoutube=fXr5N6i5sy4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Goals[/h3]

As the open world is the heart of Albion Online, Tracking looks add a new element to gameplay here:
[list]	[*]Players are challenged to search the open world in [b]pursuit of a target[/b][/*]	[*]The focus is less on direct PvP combat, but rather to increase the amount of players [b]roaming the open world[/b][/*]	[*]This encourages [b]chance encounters[/b] for different-sized groups[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/822a7388c59ad340394fce4f206b57a446e3c325.jpeg[/img]

[h3]How does it work?[/h3]

[b]Following Tracks[/b]
[list]	[*]Players must first craft a [b]Tracking Kit[/b], which lets them interact with tracks in the open world[/*]	[*][b]Reading a track[/b] reveals a location to search for further tracks	[list]		[*]This may be in the same region or a neighboring region[/*]		[*]Players will generally have to search a wider area for tracks, not a specific point[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]There, players may find [b]further tracks[/b], the [b]final target[/b], or other [b]random encounters[/b][/*]	[*]Each tracking step has a [b]time limit[/b][/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d4fda21a053735f05dc7f18458620e51264edd96.jpeg[/img][/b]

[b]Finding the Target[/b]
[list]	[*]Each step increases the chances of [b]catching the target[/b], which will usually then involve a fight[/*]	[*]Bringing too many players can [b]scare off[/b] the target, meaning the chase must continue[/*]	[*]As [b]only the hunters[/b] know the location of their target, larger groups cannot simply wait to contest them[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/86cab6714155acaa49019d73c8e7c48399540662.jpeg[/img]

[h3]What can be found?[/h3]
[list]	[*]Initially, rare creatures matching the [b]Shapeshifter[/b] weapon forms can be tracked down and fought[/*]	[*]These can drop new [b]Artifact Items[/b]	[list]		[*]These can be crafted into [b]Shapeshifter Artifact Weapons[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]They can also drop new [b]Alchemical Ingredients[/b]	[list]		[*]These can be crafted into a set of [b]rare potions[/b][/*]		[*]Part of a wider [b]rework of potion enchanting[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]A wider range of [b]trackable creatures[/b] will be introduced in later updates[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f5dbcb22c82779ca44f43851fd5d68255519b43a.jpeg[/img]

We hope you’re excited about all the new possibilities which Tracking will open up. In our next Dev Talk, we’ll talk about a new concept which may use ingredients from Tracking: [b]Legendary Items[/b]. Stay tuned for that, and thanks for watching!

notes.title: Albion Online is Six!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d5e816188a7e73e41ead81d44cf12e0be68c8453.jpeg[/img]

It might seem hard to believe, but today Albion Online marks [b]six years [/b]since its official launch in 2017! The last twelve months have been truly momentous, with a [b]new server [/b]added, [b]record player numbers [/b]reached, and the gameworld further expanded and improved. While we celebrate this with a special [url=https://albiononline.com/news/living-legacy-2023][b]event[/b][/url] and Anniversary Sale, join us to take a glance back at the last year in Albion’s history!

[h3]One Year Ago: Albion's Fifth Anniversary[/h3]

We begin with a look back at the previous anniversary, which marked a huge milestone: five years since Albion Online’s official launch. The celebrations kicked off with the debut of a brand-new in-game event, [b]Living Legacy[/b], which saw statues of Albion's past season winners come to life and roam the open world.

[previewyoutube=YlCnHz4g0B4;full][/previewyoutube]
The festivities continued with a special [b]Anniversary Stream[/b] where Albion's developers discussed creating the game, offered rare insights into early development builds, and gave a sneak peek at what the coming months and years might bring to the world of Albion.

[h3]Beyond the Veil[/h3]

In November, Albion's next major update, [url=https://albiononline.com/update/beyond-the-veil][b]Beyond the Veil[/b][/url], went live. This brought mysterious and magical new realms to the game, foremost among them the [b]Mists[/b], a new land of danger and opportunity. The update also introduced the lost city of [b]Brecilien[/b], a whole new [b]Fey Armor [/b]line, [b]Pristine Resources[/b], and numerous other features and improvements.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c6e340d3c0662d0acf5017a4374d00c0c7af3c5c.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Year-End 2022 Honors[/h3]

2022 was wrapped up with Albion Online receiving the MassivelyOP [b]"Best PvP" [/b]Award for the second year in a row, while also appearing on several best-of lists in 2022, including Rock Paper Shotgun's "30 Best Steam Deck Games" and MMORPG.GG's "18 Best Isometric MMOs".

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ccf38b08bde7a99f327f373a395bf8b8c2bd83e1.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Albion East[/h3]

2023 kicked off with the announcement of one of the biggest developments in Albion Online’s history: the launch of a second server based in Singapore, [b]Albion East [/b][https://albiononline.com/news/coming-to-asia]. This would offer a completely fresh version of the game which players would build from the ground up, along with massively improved ping for the Asia-Pacific region and game timers optimized for that region.

[previewyoutube=iUTHkUlxJ4A;full][/previewyoutube]
Prior to the server’s full launch, a [url=https://albiononline.com/news/closed-beta-is-here][b]Closed Beta[/b][/url] was held. This included a unique, three-week long [url=https://albiononline.com/news/closed-beta][b]Beta Guild Season[/b][/url], allowing players to experience an intense, condensed season with permanent rewards for the most successful. [b]S I A M[/b] marked their place in Albion’s history by taking the crown for this season, before the new server [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-east-live][b]opened its doors[/b][/url] to everyone!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/795e9a78079b9de172b47e3f72d935ed2ac7b148.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Record Player Numbers[/h3]

The launch of Albion East saw an unprecedented rush of players arrive, as they sought to progress their characters and guilds from humble beginnings and carve out their piece of Albion. The [url=https://albiononline.com/news/east-launch-stats][b]first two weeks[/b][/url] of the server saw nearly [b]two billion resources gathered[/b], nearly [b]three million PvP kills[/b], and, sadly, [b]2,680,889 dead rabbits [/b]- numbers which increased even more rapidly as the weeks went on.

[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/74977842feacf13f91677f6a8a0611193dd3569f.png][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/84e7f07d3615d751f62c0188733eff8ee1f6af76.png[/img][/url]

But most notably of all, the server launch saw Albion Online smash its [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-player-record][b]all-time player record[/b][/url], with an astonishing [b]300,000 active users [/b]on April 2 across both servers! This eclipsed the previous record, set following the mobile launch, and confirmed that the new server was taking Albion to new levels of popularity and activity across the globe.

[h3]Knightfall[/h3]

While this astounding achievement took place, development of the game did not stop, and May brought with it the release of a major patch: [url=https://albiononline.com/news/knightfall-is-here][b]Knightfall[/b][/url].

[previewyoutube=xhLxGK0MvnA;full][/previewyoutube]
This expanded on and improved the features from Beyond the Veil in significant ways, adding new layers of depth and gameplay opportunities. The Mists received [b]new treasure objectives[/b], along with a brand-new dungeon: the storied and atmospheric [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-knightfall-abbey][b]Knightfall Abbey[/b][/url]. Brecilien saw the arrival of a trader, [b]Eralia Wayfarer[/b], offering never-before-seen wares to those with sufficient standing. And swift, magical [b]Mystic Owl [/b]mounts could be raised from Owlets to transport players through the world.

[h3]Looking Ahead[/h3]

As Albion heads into its seventh year, anticipation is building for even more big developments over the coming months - including new [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-shapeshifter][b]Shapeshifter[/b][/url] weapons, which will allow players to switch back and forth between Human and Shape forms with different abilities, bringing entirely new dynamics to combat in Albion.

[previewyoutube=U2bXBopsnk0;full][/previewyoutube]
With this and more on the way, the next year shows no signs of slowing down. And of course, it is you, the players, who bring this world to life, and we’re eternally grateful for your continued enthusiasm and support for the game. The [url=https://albiononline.com/news/living-legacy-2023][b]Living Legacy[/b][/url] event is currently running, so you can mark this occasion in-game against sentient statues from Albion’s past to earn special rewards. And here’s a toast to you, the community, as we look ahead to another exciting year for Albion Online!

[previewyoutube=0GkBBVDtqIo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Living Legacy has Returned
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fba550db5089195e5e078e71975da6f47b1849e6.png[/img]

With Albion’s sixth anniversary just around the corner, the celebrations continue apace. [b]Decorations [/b]adorn the cities, adventurers enjoy some [b]birthday cake, [/b]and the statues of Conquerors’ Hall are back out in the open world! For the next two weeks, you can fight these living monuments to Albion’s history in the [b]Living Legacy [/b]event.

And to mark this special occasion, we’ve created a brand-new trailer:

[previewyoutube=0GkBBVDtqIo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Rich Rewards[/h3]

In addition to last year’s enemies, this year's event also features statues from Seasons 16, 17, and 18 brought to life. All of these monuments to Albion’s victorious guilds can be found roaming around any [b]Tier 5 or higher [/b]zone, carrying valuable loot like a [b]Sixth Anniversary Riding Horse Skin[/b], [b]Anniversary Cake [/b]which grants a temporary Fame buff, a firework-firing [b]Chromacannon[/b], and much more. The statues come in three different sizes and strengths - and of course, the fiercer the foe, the greater the rewards. For full details, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/living-legacy-2023][b]patchnotes[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/59e49afe7c199f7d6e1c8201d65a1d4d05b4a0ff.jpeg[/img]

On top of these rewards, any character who logs into the game while the event is running will receive a special [b]Sixth Anniversary Avatar [/b]and [b]Avatar Ring [/b]to mark their participation. The Living Legacy runs until maintenance on [b]July 26 on Albion East [/b]and [b]July 27 on Albion West [/b]- so arm up, bring down these malevolent monuments, and earn your rewards!

[h3]Twitch Drops, Contests, and More[/h3]

For the duration of the event, we’ll also be running a special [b]Twitch Drops [/b]campaign. This will run concurrently to our regular Twitch Drops campaign and have the same watchtime requirements, but will feature new [b]Exclusive Chests [/b]as rewards. And to top it all off, we’ll also be hosting contests on our social media platforms - check [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/183309][b]this forum post[/b][/url] for an overview of these.

notes.title: The Living Legacy is Coming Next Week
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fba550db5089195e5e078e71975da6f47b1849e6.png[/img]

Another year has passed, and Albion Online is turning six years old! Doesn’t time just fly? To mark the occasion, next week will see a double celebration: the return of the [b]Living Legacy [/b]event, and a [b]two-week vanity sale[/b]!

[h3]Murderous Monuments[/h3]
It feels like only yesterday that the statues of [b]Conquerors’ Hall [/b]rose up and caused chaos in Albion’s open world. Well, once more there are signs of movement, and soon they will wake from their slumbers again in the Living Legacy event!

This event starts on [b]July 12 at 23:00 UTC on Albion East[/b], and [b]July 13 at 10:00 UTC on Albion West[/b] and runs for two weeks. As was the case last year, monuments to the triumphant guilds of Albion's past will leave their seats in Conquerors’ Hall, roaming through Tier [b]5 or higher [/b]zones. And in addition to last year’s statues, this time there are three new faces, with the statues of Seasons 16, 17, and 18’s winners joining the party.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/15b37b95409a7ee4df7506eab591ec13785830e5.jpeg[/img]

These statues come in three different levels of size and difficulty, and can drop vast riches to those capable of defeating them, such as a new [b]Anniversary Mount Skin[/b], [b]Anniversary Cake [/b](which grants a temporary Fame buff), the [b]Chromacannon[/b], and much more. But such hardened fighters won’t give up their loot easily, and you’ll have to prove your worthiness in combat against them to grab these rewards. Meanwhile, any character that logs into the game during the event will receive a brand-new [b]Avatar [/b]and [b]Avatar Ring[/b].

The Living Legacy event will run until maintenance on [b]July 26 on Albion East [/b]and [b]July 27 on Albion West[/b], so join the festivities when they begin next week and make sure you don’t miss out!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8cbddf5be71c366a6c4b9a46f8ea9fdd2adae15e.jpeg[/img]

notes.title: Dev Talk: Shapeshifter Weapons
notes.content:
For those wondering what’s coming next for Albion Online, we’re excited to bring you a new Dev Talk - the first of a series showing off some new features we‘re currently working on and how they fit into our long-term plans. In the first of these videos, Game Director Robin Henkys introduces [b]Shapeshifter Weapons[/b], Albion’s next major weapon line.

[previewyoutube=U2bXBopsnk0;full][/previewyoutube]
Prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]What are Shapeshifter Weapons?[/h3]
These are [b]staff weapons[/b] that will further expand Albion’s ‘you are what you wear’ system in exciting new ways:
[list]	[*]Players can [b]transform into entirely different beings[/b] called [b]Shapes[/b][/*]	[*]Offers a new level of versatility as players can [b]switch back and forth[/b] between human and Shape, with different capabilities[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6b65f52bc0bc91fd25a031f4aab5663924953aa4.jpeg[/img]
[h3]How do they work?[/h3]
[b]Human Form[/b]
[list]	[*]In human form, Shapeshifters are masters of [b]manipulating raw energy[/b][/*]	[*]Inflicts damage, disrupts enemies or supports allies[/*]	[*]While using energy they build up [b]“Shift” charges[/b][/*]	[*]Shift charges can be used to transform into their weapon’s associated Shape[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/605608b5fc430f69d408d3c68577c8e928f0395c.jpeg[/img]

[b]Shape Form[/b]
[list]	[*]Each weapon comes with a unique Shape, with its own set of abilities[/*]	[*]Abilities can be enhanced using previously collected Shift charges[/*]	[*]Shapeshifters are encouraged to [b]continuously switch between forms[/b] to maximize their potential on the battlefield[/*]	[*]As each Shape comes with unique health and armor stats which replace human stats, players can [b]play different roles[/b] during a fight[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8763d1d65b889de95caf1320fab22075b7581a0b.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Looking Ahead[/h3]
This system allows for a vast array of build possibilities, under two broad strategies:
[list]	[*]Players can double down on their Shape’s strength by equipping matching gear when in human form…[/*]	[*]…or they can choose equipment which suits a different playstyle to their Shape, e.g. letting them switch from damage dealer to tank and vice versa[/*][/list]
Shapeshifter Staffs will arrive with Albion’s next major content update. Beyond that, expanding and improving the ‘you are what you wear’ system is always a priority on our Roadmap.

Our next Dev Talk will explore an [b]all-new open-world activity[/b] that complements the  Shapeshifter weapons. This activity will also introduce additional equipment choices and further enhance the range of options available for designing your builds.

Thanks for watching!

notes.title: Albion’s next Guild Seasons Start Saturday
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cce8b5e9ab7439b9ba58a0be0f6be676744087ce.jpeg[/img]

Albion’s next guild season begins this weekend on both servers! At [b]00:00 UTC[/b], Albion East Season 2 begins, before Albion West Season 20 starts at [b]11:00 UTC[/b]. Both seasons see huge rewards up for grabs, like the Crystal Juggernaut. Click [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/181982][b]here[/b][/url] for a full season rundown.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c4a125b30a54e47c723340e8389667f526805e5a.png[/img]

[h3]Season Changes[/h3]

This season brings some changes to [b]Hideouts[/b], with Level 4 or higher Hideouts draining more energy, and the energy gain from Power Cores for non-HQ Hideouts reduced. [b]Castle and Castle Outpost treasures[/b] now spawn 30 minutes earlier on Albion East. Meanwhile, the Crystal League and Crystal Arena will use the [b]Cross Map[/b] this season, and Rank Points have been adjusted to make progression through the ranks flow more smoothly.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4612d65b913b2af4cc105414e85aa77bc69a0c97.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Watch the Season Kickoff Live[/h3]

As always, we’ll be broadcasting the season kickoff live on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url]. At [b]13:30 UTC[/b] on June 17 we’ll be broadcasting Invasion Day on Albion East. Then at [b]17:30 UTC[/b] we’ll bring coverage from Albion West ahead of the first round of territory resets there. Finally, at [b]00:30 UTC[/b] on June 18, those in the North and South American time zones can tune in for the second round of territory resets on Albion West. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

Check out coverage from a recent Invasion Day here:

[previewyoutube=0uCUr_Ox31s;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Knightfall Abbey Theme is Available to Stream Now
notes.content:
One of the standout features of the recent Knightfall patch was an all-new dungeon in the Mists - [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-knightfall-abbey][b]Knightfall Abbey[/b][/url]. Along with beautiful visuals and new gameplay, it also features a stunning new theme song which is now available on [url=https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/sandboxinteractiveandmariehavemann/knightfall][b]all major streaming platforms[/b][/url].

[previewyoutube=MI1bwhEHES8;full][/previewyoutube]
The track was composed by Albion’s longtime [b]Senior Audio Designer Marie Havemann[/b], who described the ideas behind it:

[i]“The Undead roaming Knightfall Abbey were once humans who lived there, cursed by Merlin's ritual to remain forever trapped, unable to uphold the knightly virtues they once held dear. With the music, we wanted to capture both this tragedy and the feeling of longing that comes with striving for a virtuous life. At the same time, it was important for us to convey a sense of unity among the people who believed in those virtues as well as their flawed nature. To reflect this unified yearning through sound, we combined choir with orchestral instruments and focused on strong melodies. The music alternates between moments of hope and despair, as the Undead could never complete their journey and are trapped in time in Knightfall Abbey, covered in thick layers of dust. The transitions between exploration and combat are fluid, with the musical identity of the place always palpable.”[/i]

Listen to the new piece [url=https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/sandboxinteractiveandmariehavemann/knightfall][b]here[/b][/url], and listen to the rest of Albion Online’s soundtrack [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BT8113CQ0K0&list=PLvJxnupyVHJi_sR_uPMlyA1G_U9zFu9pk][b]here[/b][/url].

Simply visit [url=https://albiononline.com/wallpapers][b]this page[/b][/url], click the image to expand, and right-click and "Save As" to download. It fits HD and 4K screens, and can be cropped according to your preferences. And if you ever feel like a change, check out the wide array of other wallpapers available on that page!

notes.title: The Knightfall Patch is Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e5f94be72bea8da12fb6e7fa972b5cde8b18b8b3.png[/img]

[b]Knightfall[/b] is here! This major patch expands and improves on the features introduced with the [b]Beyond the Veil[/b] update - and to mark the occasion, we've produced a brand-new trailer:

[previewyoutube=xhLxGK0MvnA;full][/previewyoutube]
To celebrate the launch, we’re also holding a contest where you can share your perfect Knightfall build. Head over to The [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/albiononline/comments/138gt05/share_your_knightfall_abbey_build_and_win/][b]Albion Online Subreddit[/b][/url] and submit yours for a chance to win!

And to keep the celebration going, we're also offering [b]double Twitch Drops[/b] from May 8-15. These additional drops can be earned by watching any Albion stream that has Drops enabled. (To learn more about Twitch Drops, click [url=https://albiononline.com/twitch][b]here[/b][/url].)

Read on to learn what's new with Knightfall…

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f9aa57328280d0c57afcc0b7b352785bbd893c39.jpeg[/img]

[h3]The Mists: Opportunity and Mystery[/h3]

Knightfall brings some major new features and improvements to the Mists, offering players of all types and levels a chance at big rewards. [b]Coffers[/b] are treasures that only reveal their location to nearby players, and [b]Caches [/b]offer individualized loot for clearing mob camps. [b]Knightfall Abbey[/b], a mysterious dungeon hidden within the Mists, is an atmospheric realm of crumbling stone and beautiful stained-glass windows. Seek out treasures and ancient shrines that offer powerful buffs, because you'll need all the help you can get - not only against other adventurers, but against the dungeon’s former residents as well.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b5dd84959a7ffcc0605bd8af639b49e4867992e3.jpeg[/img]

[h3]New Items, Traders, and Standing[/h3]

Knightfall also brings brand-new items and crafting components, plus a new face in Brecilien, [b]Eralia Wayfarer[/b], who will trade with adventurers with sufficient standing. New [b]Avalonian[/b] and [b]Brecilien Capes[/b] offer unique defensive capabilities, [b]Mystic[/b] [b]Owl mounts [/b]carry you swiftly through the world, and new currencies and items await your discovery. The [b]Roads of Avalon[/b] have also been updated with new enemies, new paths, and greater mob density, with some mobs now dropping Avalonian Energy to further link the Roads to the new cape lines.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b27a6c76b1bf3aa5a57dca3d599eafa6c945813e.jpeg[/img]

notes.title: Dev Talk: Knightfall Abbey
notes.content:
The [b]Knightfall [/b]patch is just around the corner, and will bring some big new features and changes to Albion, like new Mists objectives, Roads changes, and more. In this Dev Talk, [b]Game Director Robin Henkys [/b]looks inside one of the most exciting of these new features, the Mists dungeon known as [b]Knightfall Abbey[/b] (subtitles are available for all supported languages):

[previewyoutube=ylWW68upEcE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Knightfall Abbey[/h3]
Knightfall Abbey is a [b]dungeon [/b]that can be found within the Mists:
[list]	[*]Was once a stronghold of King Arthur’s knights, now lost in the Mists and filled with [b]Undead[/b][/*]	[*]Entrances shimmer into existence [b]temporarily[/b][/*]	[*]Features stained-glass illustrations of Albion’s history, and [b]brand-new music[/b][/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/568a2e2709f7314098b29ad86ec54c75988d2f61.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3][list]	[*]Each room contains a [b]statue[/b]; once all enemies there are defeated, the statue reveals its reward[/*]	[*]Some statues reveal treasure, but most grant a blessing based on one of three knightly virtues: [b]Justice[/b], [b]Valor[/b], and [b]Compassion[/b][/*]	[*]These blessings are effects that trigger once a player falls [b]below 40% health[/b][/*]	[*]Each blessing also grants a [b]temporary strength buff[/b][/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/da08890103f3e01b78587b0ed8ecbd678c2aae88.jpeg[/img][/b]

The dungeon also features [b]Coffers [/b]of loot which reveal their location to nearby players, and shortly before the dungeon closes a [b]Treasure Chest [/b]reveals itself to tempt those still within.

Knightfall Abbey will provide a rewarding new gameplay opportunity to those exploring the Mists, which is rare enough that it can’t simply be played on repeat but will still appear regularly enough during an extended Mists session.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b167ceea847adecb5738e04d6794a5daeed61ca0.jpeg[/img]

Knightfall releases on [b]May 8[/b], when you can check out Knightfall Abbey and all of the other new and improved features. Meanwhile, Albion’s next major content update is in the works, so stay tuned for a new Dev Talk on that soon.

notes.title: The Morgana Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/027dde82b736f8d6b84326863dbd8c9d7f287f1f.jpeg[/img]

The Disciples of Morgana have re-emerged from the shadows... and for the entire month of May, you can take the [b]Morgana Challenge[/b] to collect fantastic rewards. Earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Morgana Raven [/b]mount.

[h3]Embrace the Darkness[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FCBnHa1.png[/img]
[b]MORGANA RAVEN:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back the popular [b]Morgana Raven[/b], a fearsome, fast-moving flying mount with an area-of-effect Fear spell. (Note: the Morgana Raven requires the same terrain pathing as all other mounts, and cannot fly over gaps or obstacles).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ke0GfuX.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Morgana Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], a menacing, fiery frame that will give your avatar an aura of dread. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar ring for one character.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TjmuDnJ.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Morgana Challenge chests[/b]. These chests contain valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes and Silver bags, along with unique Morgana-themed furniture items.

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim your rewards!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Knightfall Introduction
notes.content:
While Albion East has helped bring [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-player-record][b]record numbers of players[/b][/url] to the game, we’ve been hard at work on our next major patch, called [b]Knightfall[/b]. In this Dev Talk, [b]Game Director Robin Henkys [/b]takes a look at some of the features and improvements that will be introduced with this patch (subtitles are available for all supported languages):

[previewyoutube=ZnVZAVE2-8s;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Mists: New Features[/h3]
Three new gameplay features added to the [b]Mists[/b]:
[list]	[*][b]Caches[/b]: a new type of chest found in Mob Camps, with personal rewards for each player who completes the objective[/*]	[*][b]Coffers[/b]: similar to open-world treasures, but only reveal their location to nearby players[/*]	[*][b]Knightfall Abbey[/b]: a new type of dungeon within the Mists, which will be explored in a forthcoming Dev Talk[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/de3ee4ef8a0c329dcd48ae6d5199da040d6a85a2.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Roads of Avalon: Changes and Improvements[/h3]

Various changes made to the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b]:
[list]	[*][b]Elite Camps[/b]: Difficulty and rewards rebalanced for groups of 5-7[/*]	[*][b]Journey Back cost[/b] from Brecilien to the Roads halved[/*]	[*][b]More off-road paths[/b] added, as well as more roaming Mobs[/*]	[*][b]New upgrade levels[/b] of Avalonian Mages and Archers[/*]	[*]Hideouts can be declared a [b]Headquarters[/b] even without a booster[/*]	[*][b]Power Cores [/b]in the Roads more concentrated on Raid regions[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/02f3a8a30f3013a876751de6a8a09fe33bd4aff0.jpeg[/img]

[h3]New Items[/h3]

A new trader, [b]Eralia Wayfarer[/b], can be found in Brecilien. Depending on your Brecilien Standing, you can purchase several items here:
[list]	[*]Ingredients for [b]Brecilien Capes[/b], with a Mists-inspired design and protective shield ability[/*]	[*]Eggs to grow [b]Mystic Owls[/b] or [b]Elite Mystic Owls[/b]:	[list]		[*]Have reduced load capacity, but very high speed[/*]		[*]Elite Mystic Owls have a [b]Glide[/b] ability, flying upwards and becoming temporarily unhittable[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]‘Wanderer in the Mists’[/b] Avatar and Avatar Ring for Mists veterans[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b0422ef0a6876b2b90630972e84662c778f9a3b0.jpeg[/img]

At the Energy Manipulator you can now also buy ingredients for [b]Avalonian Capes[/b], which have a damage-debuffing energy explosion ability.

[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]

This patch also brings several big [b]Quality-of-Life improvements[/b]:
[list]	[*][b]‘Travel Mode’ [/b]display option: a partly-transparent Region Map overlaid on the screen[/*]	[*]Items can be [b]repaired at the Marketplace[/b][/*]	[*][b]Character gender [/b]can be changed for Gold[/*]	[*]Directional movement can be bound to hotkeys (for example [b]WASD[/b])[/*]	[*]…and much more[/*][/list]
[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ea9e9ac1e70cccb1be1c6a7acf6db426ac81de05.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ec9f19b18ec8ccde1d2d962e96fc45ea11996e94.jpeg[/img][/url]

Along with all this, Knightfall comes with a significant number of combat balance adjustments to shake up the meta.

The patch is now on the [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/179827][b]test servers[/b][/url], and we look forward to receiving your feedback on these features. Join us again for another Dev Talk soon, where we’ll dive into the new Mists dungeon: [b]Knightfall Abbey[/b].

notes.title: Basic Builds: Nature Staff
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/98fdb0c33695a196c143fca0c1b0d5b7fa7be80d.jpeg[/img]

Welcome to another of our [b]Basic Builds[/b] guides for beginner-to-intermediate players. Each guide presents a suggested build and describes how its abilities work in tandem. You can try these out as-is, or use them as a starting point to create new builds of your own.

[h3]Characteristics[/h3]

This build features the Nature Staff, a healing weapon located in the hunter tree that is characterized by its large area healing abilities and its thorns abilities that offer continuous damage.

Here’s the full breakdown!

[h3]Equipment and Skills Used[/h3]

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9bb6a1d1aacd11afa27454d5ed82e9cd4f8180ed.jpeg[/img]

[b]Adept’s Nature Staff[/b]
[list]	[*]Thorn Growth	[list]		[*]Your Q creates a field of thorns on the ground that applies charges to all enemies within every 0.5 seconds; it has a short cooldown and can be recast 3 times[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Brambleseed	[list]		[*]Your W places a line of seeds on the ground that will grow after a short time, throwing all enemies on top of it into the air; both these effects deal damage, the latter more so[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Circle of Life	[list]		[*]Your main ability heals up to 5 allies in a large radius around you; if enemies within that radius have at least 3 thorn charges on them, they take additional damage and are rooted for a short time[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][b]Adept’s Mage Cowl[/b]
[list]	[*]Firebreath	[list]		[*]Your Cowl has an offensive spell that briefly ignites enemies in a small cone in front of you[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][b]Adept’s Mercenary Jacket[/b]
[list]	[*]Bloodlust	[list]		[*]This jacket's active ability allows you to regain some health every time you auto-attack or cast a damage spell[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][b]Adept’s Soldier Boots[/b]
[list]	[*]Rejuvenating Sprint	[list]		[*]Your shoes’ active ability is a sprint that also heals you slightly[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][b]Adept’s Bag: [/b]Increases carry weight capacity

[b]Adept’s Cape: [/b]Increases Energy and passive Energy Regeneration

[b]Minor Poison Potion: [/b]Inflicts damage-over-time effect on targets and decreases their resistances for its duration

[b]Pork Omelette:[/b] Increases your cast speed and cooldown rate, allowing you to use your abilities more frequently

[b]Journeyman’s Riding Horse: [/b]Brings you swiftly across the map while adding more carrying capacity

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c42de53d36566aa66a729994cbab663aa1e61a56.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Pros and Cons[/h3]

[b]Pros:[/b]
[list]	[*]Fast clear speed[/*]	[*]High sustain[/*]	[*]Good for healing small PvE groups[/*]	[*]Affordable[/*][/list][b]Cons:[/b]
[list]	[*]No additional mobility besides boots spell[/*]	[*]High standtime and cast time[/*]	[*]Not suited to large-scale fights[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3bebfc33eba99ef7439b7cca0100d42da891952f.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Playstyle[/h3][list]	[*]Your Q-spell creates a field of thorns on the ground that repeatedly applies a charge to enemies within it. It can also be recast within three seconds up to three times. Using an auto-attack on an enemy within the thorns consumes them while dealing bonus damage.[/*]	[*]Your W-ability places bramble seeds on the ground that shoot up after a short delay, launching enemies into the air and interrupting them. Its two damage instances allow for good synergy with the Mercenary Jacket.[/*]	[*]You may change your W to Revitalize for tougher enemies. This will allow you to increase your sustain at the expense of some damage and crowd control.[/*]	[*]Your E-spell is a large-area heal that can be used for group play. It has a strong synergy with Thorn Growth, as it roots all enemies that have at least 3 charges on them. It also deals some bonus damage.[/*]	[*]The whole weapon kit can alternatively be used to heal groups, by switching the Q to Rejuvenation or Rejuvenating Flower and the W to anything other than Brambleseed.[/*]	[*]The cowl has an additional damage spell that allows you to take down groups of enemies more quickly.[/*]	[*]The jacket can be used to regain health. It is best used in combination with your W and E-abilities as they can hit multiple targets and apply lifesteal charges more quickly. Your Q does not trigger Bloodlust as it doesn’t deal direct damage. Auto-attacks are also advised while using this jacket.[/*]	[*]Your boots offer a sprint ability that can regain a small amount of health quickly, while providing increased movement speed.[/*]	[*]An enemy encounter should look something like this:	[list]		[*]Stack multiple Thorn Growths and try to get all enemies inside the areas.[/*]		[*]Use the W to keep them away from you or to interrupt their key abilities.[/*]		[*]Cast your E when all enemies have multiple thorn stacks on them.[/*]		[*]Use auto-attacks on the enemy you’re trying to finish off for additional damage.[/*]		[*]When you drop to low health, use your jacket followed by Brambleseed and auto-attacks. You may also use your boots to create space and heal even more.[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Energy can be an issue, so it’s recommended to use the energetic passive and auto-attack enemies in between cooldowns.[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ed50850d14022054a0460dfa8836a1845c363459.jpeg[/img]

That's it for this week - stay tuned for more Basic Builds guides coming soon!

tags.feature: Your Q creates a field of thorns on the ground that applies charges to all enemies within every 0.5 seconds; it has a short cooldown and can be recast 3 times
Your W places a line of seeds on the ground that will grow after a short time, throwing all enemies on top of it into the air; both these effects deal damage, the latter more so
Your main ability heals up to 5 allies in a large radius around you; if enemies within that radius have at least 3 thorn charges on them, they take additional damage and are rooted for a short time
Your Cowl has an offensive spell that briefly ignites enemies in a small cone in front of you
This jacket's active ability allows you to regain some health every time you auto-attack or cast a damage spell
Your shoes’ active ability is a sprint that also heals you slightly
Increases carry weight capacity
Increases Energy and passive Energy Regeneration
Inflicts damage-over-time effect on targets and decreases their resistances for its duration
Increases your cast speed and cooldown rate, allowing you to use your abilities more frequently
Brings you swiftly across the map while adding more carrying capacity

Your Q-spell creates a field of thorns on the ground that repeatedly applies a charge to enemies within it. It can also be recast within three seconds up to three times. Using an auto-attack on an enemy within the thorns consumes them while dealing bonus damage.

Your W-ability places bramble seeds on the ground that shoot up after a short delay, launching enemies into the air and interrupting them. Its two damage instances allow for good synergy with the Mercenary Jacket.
You may change your W to Revitalize for tougher enemies. This will allow you to increase your sustain at the expense of some damage and crowd control.

Your E-spell is a large-area heal that can be used for group play. It has a strong synergy with Thorn Growth, as it roots all enemies that have at least 3 charges on them. It also deals some bonus damage.
The whole weapon kit can alternatively be used to heal groups, by switching the Q to Rejuvenation or Rejuvenating Flower and the W to anything other than Brambleseed.
The cowl has an additional damage spell that allows you to take down groups of enemies more quickly.

The jacket can be used to regain health. It is best used in combination with your W and E-abilities as they can hit multiple targets and apply lifesteal charges more quickly. Your Q does not trigger Bloodlust as it doesn’t deal direct damage. Auto-attacks are also advised while using this jacket.
Your boots offer a sprint ability that can regain a small amount of health quickly, while providing increased movement speed.
Stack multiple Thorn Growths and try to get all enemies inside the areas.
Use the W to keep them away from you or to interrupt their key abilities.
Cast your E when all enemies have multiple thorn stacks on them.
Use auto-attacks on the enemy you’re trying to finish off for additional damage.
When you drop to low health, use your jacket followed by Brambleseed and auto-attacks. You may also use your boots to create space and heal even more.
Energy can be an issue, so it’s recommended to use the energetic passive and auto-attack enemies in between cooldowns.

notes.title: The Rites of Spring are Back!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7c184f379cf77d9b97b01f122759d50f00a93eb2.jpeg[/img]

Spring has sprung, and Albion’s most bold and brave are rushing across the lands. For they know that this is the time of year when special chests appear, containing seasonal objects and maybe even prized [b]Spring Cottontail Eggs[/b].

But this time a new type of egg has been discovered, one which has spelled trouble for more than one unfortunate adventurer…

Yes, the [b]Rites of Spring [/b]are here for the next two weeks! And to mark the occasion, we’ve created a brand new video:

[previewyoutube=krIaosbfFUk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Ruthless Rabbits Released![/h3]
As with last year’s event, [b]Spring Treasure Chests [/b]will appear in the open world, containing valuable items and - sometimes - a Vibrant Spring Cottontail Egg, which can be raised into the [b]Spring Cottontail [/b]mount. This year, though, you might come across a darker, more sinister type of egg. By all means raise these too, but be careful - you’re about to unleash the [b]Caerleon Cottontail[/b]!

This is a vengeful, vicious version of the Spring Cottontail. Like its cute cousin, it is a mount with a quick hop ability. But this one comes with other, more terrifying talents. If you manage to rear one, they will repay your trust and act as a loyal steed. Your enemies, on the other hand, won’t be so fortunate…

The [b]Eerie Cottontail Egg [/b]is extremely rare - so get out there now and start ransacking those chests to find one!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/85a6cd1548e1db89cb5c8d1b1622dff8a56f6c93.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Further Treasures Await[/h3]
Along with these rare and valuable rewards, [b]Colored Eggs [/b]are once again sprouting across the lands, containing chocolate, [b]Surprise Eggs[/b], and, very occasionally, Cottontail Eggs. Furthermore, [b]all chests [/b]will be spawning at an increased rate for the next two weeks - so there’s abundant wealth to be found out there. And Albion’s vanity merchants will be hawking their seasonal wares once again, like the [b]Eggsecutioner [/b]vanity weapon,[b] “Bunny Stalker” [/b]Wardrobe items, and more.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1f557a77d35faaab76cfc6b838c9a7f4107239dd.png[/img]

The Rites of Spring runs until [b]April 19 at 23:00 UTC on Albion East[/b], and [b]April 20 at 10:00 UTC on Albion West[/b]. So go and head out into the open world today and see what treasures await. Who knows, you might end up with a fierce new friend…

notes.title: Get the Steelplate Cougar this Referral Season
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4d27c10ddc8cf2637f91cbad49dbfea4b01b66a4.jpeg[/img]
Another [b]Referral Season [/b]is here, and this time you have the chance to claim the much-loved [b]Steelplate Cougar [/b]with a single referral!

This skin makes your [b]Swiftclaw [/b]base mount even more powerful and intimidating to behold - and once you’ve unlocked it, it can be used by any of your characters on that particular server ([b]either Albion East or West[/b]).

As you may have already seen, with the opening of Albion East we are introducing some [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/178077][b]changes to our referral system[/b][/url]:
[list]	[*]To make some of our most beloved skins available to players who missed them the first time, we will be [b]rerunning some older referral rewards[/b][/*]	[*]These can be any referral skins or mounts released from [b]April 2019 onwards[/b][/*]	[*]Referral seasons will now last [b]one month[/b], rather than two[/*]	[*]There will, of course, still be [b]all-new referral skins[/b] produced[/*]	[*]Referral seasons will now end on the [b]last day of every month at 23:59 UTC[/b][/*][/list]

These items - and the Gold and Premium in the Packs - can be claimed on [b]either server[/b], so they can be enjoyed no matter where someone prefers to play.

They’re only available until [b]10:00 UTC on April 30[/b], so you have until then to enjoy some extra Gold for your referrals!
[h3]How to Earn Seasonal Referral Rewards[/h3][list]	[*]Send your referral link, which you can find [url=https://albiononline.com/profile/referral/overview][b]here[/b][/url], to a friend. (You must be logged into your account on the website to view this page.)[/*]	[*]Your friend creates an account and starts playing Albion Online (preferably along with you!).[/*]	[*]The first time your friend purchases either an [b]Albion East Founder Pack[/b] or at least 30 days of Premium, they will trigger a reward for you: 1,000 Gold for a Founder Pack, 500 Gold for Premium.[/*]	[*]For your first referral this month, you’ll get the [b]Steelplate Cougar Swiftclaw Skin[/b].[/*]	[*]On top of that, for your very first referral ever, you'll receive a [b]T8 Recruiter's Pile of Tomes[/b], worth a massive [b]200,000 Fame[/b].[/*][/list]
This Referral Season lasts until [b]23:59 UTC on April 30[/b], so invite your friends and enjoy these rewards!

notes.title: Dev Talk: 2023 Development Update
notes.content:
The new [b]Albion East[/b] server opened to players worldwide March 20, offering a Singapore-based server with an untouched version of Albion. The launch attracted throngs of new and old players to the server, and we're thrilled to see this new version of Albion take shape day-by-day. 

With the launch a success, Game Director [b]Robin Henkys[/b] discusses what's next for the world of Albion in our newest Dev Talk (subtitles are available for all supported languages):

[previewyoutube=QIOAQ5EVch8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]What's Next in the Short Term?[/h3][list]	[*][b]Rites of Spring[/b] event: Similar to 2022, but with a new, bad-tempered counterpart to the Spring Cottontail[/*]	[*][b]Beyond the Veil Content Patch[/b]: New features for the Mists, adjustments to the Roads of Avalon, usability improvements[/*]	[*]"[b]Dungeons in the Mists[/b]": Central feature; will be discussed in a forthcoming Dev Talk[/*]	[*]After that: Next [b]major content update[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/64c8ac7169e58b25b69a84378209f1c6ef6a9df7.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]Albion's Development Strategy[/h3]
Albion has become quite large and complex, requiring a development strategy that allows us to maintain, improve and revolutionize the game at the same time.

[u][b]Better Basics[/b][/u]

Consistent improvement of [b]core aspects[/b] of the game, especially where most impactful:
[list]	[*][b]Improved Marketplace experience[/b]: Repair All, Sell All, improved filtering and easier large-scale purchases[/*]	[*][b]More stable loot experience[/b] by optimizing [b]Black Market[/b][/*]	[*][b]Improving Stone market,[/b] reworking [b]crafting capacity[/b] and [b]crafting on player islands[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b8a6fbecac6643137aaadefbbe7e34e4954aaed0.jpeg[/img][/b]

[u][b]Continuous Content[/b][/u]

Expanding on features [b]already in the game[/b]:
[list]	[*][b]New gear choices[/b] for the "You are what you wear" system[/*]	[*][b]Rites of Spring + Content Patch[/b] (both with new items)[/*]	[*][b]New Weapon Line[/b] for the Hunter tree[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/38585d9e1599e23c6e92f535c398a4e7b4502e06.jpeg[/img]

[u][b]Fantastic Features[/b][/u]

[b]New features[/b] that expand the scope of Albion Online (these are always in flux, but a few are in progress):
[list]	[*][b]Legendary Weapons[/b]: Weapons can attain "Legendary" status through use, and be given a [b]unique name[/b]; these have a chance of being added to the [b]loot pool [/b]on death, thus leaving a lasting mark on Albion[/*]	[*]Improved spell behavior around [b]walls and height differences[/b]: Precursor to proper [b]castle and siege fights[/b] that may include [b]player-made fortifications[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/731312e687c9e63de8c607de57527b3fa7cd5afc.jpeg[/img][/b]

That's it for today - stay tuned for more Dev Talks covering these themes and Albion’s next major update!

notes.title: Albion East is Open!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/43731e7b3e7b5fc7ed394a91b46d4462ac7154f5.jpeg[/img]

Today’s the day: after much anticipation, [b]Albion East[/b] is now publicly accessible to all players!

Following a successful Closed Beta phase, and an early access period for Founder Pack owners, anyone can now play on Albion’s new, Singapore-based server as this entirely [b]fresh version of Albion[/b] develops from the ground up. Players are pouring into the Royal Continent and Outlands, gathering, crafting, building the economy, and progressing their characters as they gain Fame and form guilds. It’s a truly momentous occasion!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b569ebb7b2501280bbfc5f33a5a549968b1f493f.jpeg[/img]

Initially, Albion East will have a [b]reduced world size[/b] relative to Albion West, in order to maintain competitiveness and density of players. As the player base grows on this new server, it is anticipated that more regions will be opened up, and its development will be constantly observed in order to judge this process. For an overview of available regions, check out [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/177778][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/21262877def13a67dbc3e5a7a1055edd15805c27.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Limited-Time Starter Bundle Offer[/h3]
To help you get off to the right start in Albion, for a short time there’s a brand-new [b]Starter Bundle[/b] on offer, featuring the popular [b]Knight Adventurer Vanity Bundle[/b]! For the price of a [b]7-day Premium subscription[/b], you’ll receive the following:
[list]	[*][b]Knight Adventurer Vanity Bundle[/b][/*]	[*][b]7 Days Premium Status[/b][/*]	[*][b]50 Gold[/b][/*][/list]This deal is available in the Albion Online Web Shop, the ingame store, the Steam client, and Google Play. Once purchased, it can be claimed on either Albion East or Albion West, and the Vanity component will be available on [b]both servers[/b] once unlocked. The offer runs until [b]10:00 UTC on April 3[/b], so take advantage now!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/98eba5eddd577bcafb377bca36e5dc4d3a0be8d1.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Special Twitch Drop Campaign[/h3]
To celebrate the launch of Albion East, we’re running a special [b]Twitch Drop campaign[/b] from [b]March 15[/b]-[b]29[/b], with exclusive chests containing [b]brand-new items[/b]. During this period, campaigns will run [b]daily[/b] rather than weekly, meaning you can earn chests each day by watching any channel participating in our regular campaigns. For details, check out [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/177924-Special-Twitch-Drops-for-the-Early-Access-and-Launch-of-Albion-East/][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

notes.title: Albion's Next Guild Season is Coming
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ba0f90ee248a9f8d23b17681d0a8badfd3deec27.jpeg[/img]

Albion’s next Guild Season kicks off soon - including the [b]first official season[/b] on the new [b]Albion East[/b] Server!

On [b]March 11[/b], [b]Season 19[/b] will begin on [b]Albion West[/b]. Two weeks after that, on [b]March 25[/b], [b]the first Albion East season[/b] will kick off. Note that this time the Albion East season will be slightly shorter - but moving forward seasons on the two servers should be synchronized. Because of its reduced length this time, the final stretch on Albion East will offer [b]tripled Season Points[/b]. For full schedules for both servers, click [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/177438][b]here[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fb4c837d8eec71c39986eece9841222cab5b8b4a.jpeg[/img]

Both Guild Seasons are [b]open to anyone[/b] who wants to play on that server - so you can participate in both simultaneously if you choose. And both offer fantastic prizes to guilds that reach a high enough rank, like the [b]Roving Bastion[/b] and new [b]Sword Dancer Avatar Sets[/b].

In addition, the top three guilds will no longer receive a furniture item of their season statue, but instead will receive new [b]Direwolf Skins[/b] (see top image).

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79f130300408080aeff7451a26160fa7a90e2f0b.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Season Changes[/h3]
As well as those new Direwolf Skin rewards, these seasons bring changes to scoring in the Crystal League and Crystal Arena. All scoring Runestones will reset at the end of each round, to prevent teams from simply defending a Runestone advantage to win a match. Furthermore, Albion East and Albion West will have different time slots for Crystal League matches. For full details on these changes, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/177438][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cce8b5e9ab7439b9ba58a0be0f6be676744087ce.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Watch the Albion West Season Kickoff Live[/h3]
The [b]Albion West Season 19[/b] kickoff on [b]Saturday, March 11[/b] will be broadcast live on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] starting at [b]17:30 UTC[/b], with hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Lewpac[/b] and [b]Bogul[/b] bringing full coverage of Invasion Day.

At 18:00 UTC all territories will be reset for guilds to claim. Those in the North and South American time zones can tune in for the second round of territory resets on [b]Sunday[/b] at [b]00:30 UTC[/b], when hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Tazzik[/b] cover the next round of invasions. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

Check out AlbionTV's coverage of a previous Invasion Day, which kicked off Season 18:

[previewyoutube=Y8RswYAmoAE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:

Spring is back, and the Keepers of Albion are beginning to awaken... and for the entire month of March, you can take the [b]Keeper Challenge[/b] to collect fantastic rewards! Earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Grizzly Bear mount[/b].

[h3][b]Timeless Treasures are Yours to Claim[/b][/h3]

In addition to its Intimidating Aura toggle spell, it also gains a temporary [b]speed boost[/b] when attacked, giving its rider an edge when enemies are in pursuit.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dg76ds8.png[/img]

This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded for one [b]Adventurer's Token[/b] at the Vanity Merchant.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/C4sRQZo.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Keeper Challenge chests[/b]. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver bags, and rare resources, this month's chests contain various [b]Keeper-themed furniture and capes[/b].

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim your rewards!

notes.title: The Albion East Closed Beta is Here!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f87cdb7837971e989e053ae80fa96acbe002eab7.png[/img]

The Albion East Closed Beta is now underway! This special, one-of-a-kind event offers a fresh version of the world of Albion with a reduced world size, where all participants can earn unique, valuable rewards.

If you missed it, the newest [b]Dev Talk[/b] from Game Director Robin Henkys gives a good overview. He discusses what to expect from the Albion East server and the Closed Beta, gives a rundown of the unique rewards and unlocks you can earn, and discusses how the world will be unlocked gradually over the course of both the Beta and the full launch.

[previewyoutube=efCTzcsH1aQ;full][/previewyoutube]
And remember, everyone who gets a Founder Pack and joins the Beta will also get the new premiere Vanity Bundle, the [b]Arcanist[/b], unlocked for free on [b]both servers[/b] before it officially goes on sale!

[h3]A Unique Three-Week Guild Season[/h3]
For the duration of Albion East's beta, a unique [b]Beta Guild Season[/b] will let players experience an intense, condensed three-week season. The Beta Season has much faster progression, to allow players to test out as many features and gameplay options as possible.

This progression buff is automatic for all players, and grants the following:
[list]	[*]+100% Fame from gathering, farming, and PvE[/*]	[*]+200% Resources from gathering and fishing[/*]	[*]+200% Silver from mobs[/*]	[*]Resource weight reduced by 66%[/*]	[*]All characters start with 2000 Learning Points[/*][/list][b]Note[/b]: This boost is active only during the beta, and [b]only [/b]on the Albion East server.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/250d2245ae7f5750007719d922758c2868389781.png[/img]

[h3]Earn Permanent Rewards[/h3]
While normal Guild Season rewards unlocked via the Conqueror's Challenge will only be available during the beta, and will not persist after the server is reset at beta end, top-ranking guilds, along with players who make sufficient progress during the season, can unlock unique rewards that [b]persist even after the beta ends[/b].

[b][u]Guild Rewards[/u][/b]

[b]Custom Guild Logos: [/b]The five guilds with the highest ranking at the end of the season will each get a unique custom guild logo, created in collaboration with our art team. These logos will then be added to the game after the beta and become permanently available to guilds on both servers.

[b]Custom Season Statue: [/b]The season’s top guild will get a unique custom guild statue, which will be permanently placed in Albion East's open world for all to see. The second- and third-place guilds will also receive non-custom statues in the open world.

[b][u]Personal Rewards[/u][/b]

[b]Unique Placeable Statues:[/b] During the beta, each player can unlock up to three unique placeable Statue items that they can claim on Albion East or West after the beta ends. Statues are unlocked once per account, and are earned for the following activities (with only the highest-tier statue given for each activity):

[b]PvE Statue:[/b]
[list]	[*]Bronze: Reach 500,000 PvE Fame during beta[/*]	[*]Silver: Be in the top 30% of the Bronze group[/*]	[*]Gold: Be in the top 10% of the Bronze group[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/63d22759ec9cd3c351cbf7ace4cef5a411badcc1.png[/img]

[b]Gathering Statue:[/b]
[list]	[*]Bronze: Reach 150,000 Gathering Fame during beta[/*]	[*]Silver: Be in the top 30% of the Bronze group[/*]	[*]Gold: Be in the top 10% of the Bronze group[/*][/list][b]Trader Statue:[/b]
[list]	[*]Bronze: Possess 300,000 Silver at the end of beta[/*]	[*]Silver: Be in the top 30% of the Bronze group[/*]	[*]Gold: Be in the top 10% of the Bronze group[/*][/list]For the complete season schedule, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/175203][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

notes.title: The Albion East Closed Beta is Coming
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/795e9a78079b9de172b47e3f72d935ed2ac7b148.jpeg[/img]

On [b]February 20[/b], the Closed Beta for the new Albion East server begins! This offers a unique, one-of-a-kind opportunity to play a [b]fully untouched version of the game[/b] with boosted progress, and earn rewards which will persist even after launch.

Key features of the beta include:
[list]	[*]A [b]pristine, untouched version of the world of Albion[/b] to explore[/*]	[*]Hugely boosted [b]Fame progression[/b][/*]	[*]Automatic [b]Premium, 2000 Learning Points, [/b]reduced [b]Resource weight[/b][/*]	[*]Unique, one-of-a-kind [b]Guild Season [/b]with permanent rewards for [b]guilds[/b] and [b]individuals[/b] that persist [b]after the beta[/b][/*][/list]
Additionally, everyone who participates in the beta will get the forthcoming [b]Arcanist Wardrobe and Mount Skin Bundle[/b] permanently unlocked free on all characters on their account, before its official release. This premiere bundle will not only make your character stand out during the beta, but can also be used on Albion West and once the Albion East officially launches as well - so you can stand out amongst the crowds on [b]both servers[/b]!

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/63e67be141bc9_360.mp4[/video]

In fact, many [b]unique rewards[/b] that you can earn during the Closed Beta, like custom guild logos and placeable statues, will be claimable on [b]Albion West[/b] as well. So even if you’re primarily an Albion West player, you can still mark your triumphant progress in this one-off beta season there. Go get involved, experience Albion like never before, and claim lasting rewards!
[h3]Albion East Founder Packs[/h3]
[b]Albion East Founder Packs[/b] allow you access to all of these benefits, and even more on top. To see what you can get, check out this video:

[previewyoutube=5VeY973vQp4;full][/previewyoutube]

These Founder Packs come in four different tiers, and among the benefits on offer are:
[list]	[*]Up to one year of [b]Premium[/b][/*]	[*]Up to 2,000 [b]Gold[/b][/*]	[*]Up to five days [b]early access [/b]to Albion East[/*]	[*][b]Closed Beta[/b] access[/*]	[*]Themed [b]wardrobe and mount skins[/b][/*]	[*]… and much more![/*][/list]
And don’t forget that many of these rewards [b]can be claimed on Albion West [/b]too - so if that’s your preferred server you can still enjoy these benefits!

For full details of these new Founder Packs and the Albion East server in general, visit the [b]dedicated Albion East page[/b]: [url=https://albiononline.com/asia]LEARN MORE[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8icVSJN.png[/img]

Albion Online will launch a [b]dedicated server for the Asia-Pacific region[/b] in March 2023! This new server will make the world of Albion more accessible than ever for countless new and existing players.

[previewyoutube=iUTHkUlxJ4A;full][/previewyoutube]

Tune in to learn more about the new server and its development, and [b]ask your own questions in the chat[/b], in this special event. Stay tuned for more details.

notes.title: Beyond the Veil Patch 3 is here!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0b0763538113b43c5611f3096def7545c7988b03.jpeg[/img]

[b]Beyond the Veil Patch 3[/b] has arrived! This patch continues to improve the Roads of Avalon, as well as introducing Streamer Mode, various Combat Balance changes, and more. Read on for details…

[h3]Roads of Avalon Improvements[/h3]
Following player feedback after the Beyond the Veil update, the [b]Roads of Avalon [/b]have undergone some significant changes to improve their playability for all group sizes, including solo players. Avalonian Camps have been rebalanced for [b]different group sizes[/b], and are once again [b]marked by a chest icon [/b]on the map. Furthermore, mobs surrounding chests in the Roads will [b]upgrade in line with the chests[/b], and with each upgrade all dead mobs around the chest will [b]respawn[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/373090e22886d1b1f596d5ff83ca85a85323d9da.jpeg[/img]

These changes should make the Roads more appealing to a wider range of players, and in turn ensure they’re a lively, well-populated part of Albion. And alongside these improvements, the Roads have received a long-awaited [b]visual overhaul[/b], making them more aesthetically in-tune with the rest of Albion while highlighting their unique character.

[h3]Streamer Mode[/h3]
To improve the experience of those who stream Albion, as well as their viewers, a new [b]Streamer Mode [/b]has been introduced. This can be toggled on and off in the Settings menu, and when activated hides certain UI features that can identify the streamer’s location to viewers. This will help streamers avoid stream-snipers while broadcasting, as well as hide login details when disconnected.

[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Changes to the [b]home removal debuff[/b], allowing more freedom for small-scale travel[/*]	[*]Various [b]Combat Balance changes[/b][/*]	[*]New [b]Crystal Realm map [/b]for Season 18[/*]	[*]… and more[/*][/list]For a complete list of changes, see the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/beyond-the-veil-patch-3][b]official patch notes[/b][/url].

notes.title: 2022: Albion's Year in Review
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/72140ef436e0121f99bda78720a02f3b99f8c9ce.jpeg[/img]

2022 was a big year in the world of Albion, with major content updates, a huge five-year milestone, and an ever-growing worldwide community of players. Join us for a look back at some of the major highlights…

[h3]Albion Awakened[/h3]
2022 began by building on the solid foundation laid by the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/lands-awakened][b]Lands Awakened update[/b][/url] in late 2021. The [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b], newly introduced with Lands Awakened, was streamlined over the ensuing Guild Seasons in early 2022 to offer guilds of all sizes a huge number of ways to earn Might and Favor and unlock spectacular rewards, while making Might Levels easier to reach.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1f30afea69f343eb7dd094fb22faba5b6f4398a8.jpeg[/img]

Rewards for the Crystal League were also increased, and an updated map was introduced to make this core 5v5 content more dynamic and unpredictable.
[h3]Controller Support, Awards and Events[/h3]
In March 2022, Albion Online became playable with controllers and on the newly launched [b]Steam Deck[/b], opening the game up to a whole new audience and playstyle.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2cc5438b6ff74d312016b3c7be89ea7baaf4c9ea.jpeg[/img]

Then in April, Albion Online received the [b]German Computer Games Prize[/b] for [b]Best Mobile Game[/b]. This rounded out a season that saw Albion honored by a growing list of achievements:
[list]	[*][b]Deutscher Entwicklerpreis: Best Mobile Game[/b][/*]	[*][b]MassivelyOP Year-End Awards: Best PvP[/b][/*]	[*][b]GamingonPhone Game Awards: Best Mobile Port[/b][/*]	[*][b]Deutscher Computerspielpreis: Best Mobile Game[/b][/*][/list]Spring also brought a massively expanded [b]Rites of Spring[/b] event that introduced a new mount, the [b]Spring Cottontail[/b] rabbit, which was growable from rare eggs that spawned throughout the world.

[previewyoutube=c2F0CrLMd3k;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Into the Fray[/h3]
In June, the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/into-the-fray][b]Into the Fray[/b][/url] update went live, improving and expanding numerous game systems and introducing fully reworked [b]Magic Staffs[/b]. The update also brought new [b]Portal Towns[/b], improved Castles, the non-lethal Crystal League, Victory Emotes, and numerous other features and much more.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/232d592b4a8baf3962038b41f82ba2143aaf5429.jpeg[/img]

Further improvements to Magic Staffs came with the "Arcane and Frost" Patch several months later, and additional patches later in the year brought features like a new [b]Guild Finder[/b] and support for [b]Japanese and Italian[/b].

[h3]Albion Celebrates Five Years[/h3]
In July, Albion Online celebrated a huge milestone: the [b]fifth anniversary[/b] of its launch in 2017. The celebrations kicked off with a major in-game event, [b]Living Legacy[/b], which saw statues of Albion's past season winners come to life and roam the open world.

[previewyoutube=pwTNtdvemgs;full][/previewyoutube]

The festivities continued with a special [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YlCnHz4g0B4][b]Anniversary Stream[/b][/url] where Albion's developers discussed creating the game, offered rare insights into early development builds, and gave a sneak peek at what the coming months and years might bring to the world of Albion.

[h3]Beyond the Veil[/h3]
In the fall, Albion's next major update, [b]Beyond the Veil[/b], went live. This update brought mysterious and magical new realms to the game, foremost among them the [b]Mists[/b], a new land of danger and opportunity. The update also introduced the lost city of [b]Brecilien[/b], a whole new [b]Fey Armor[/b] line, Pristine Resources, and numerous other features and improvements.

[previewyoutube=rZqlngveFyo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Year-End Honors[/h3]
Last but not least, 2022 was rounded out by another honor: the game received the [b]MassivelyOP "Best PvP" Award[/b] for the second year in a row! It also appeared on several best-of lists in 2022, including [b]Rock Paper Shotgun[/b]'s "30 Best Steam Deck Games" and [b]MMORPG.GG[/b]'s "18 Best Isometric MMOs".

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4bfb4ddd4b9357ac491bf797ed4804cbaff0d1f8.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Looking Forward to 2023[/h3]
In early 2023 we'll continue improving on the updated Mists and Roads introduced with Beyond the Veil. Alongside that, we'll be working on new features and improvements to the game throughout the year, so stay tuned for announcements. For now, we want to extend our thanks to you, the Albion community, for making everything we do possible.

Happy New Year!

In June, the Into the Fray update went live, improving and expanding numerous game systems and introducing fully reworked Magic Staffs.
The update also brought new Portal Towns, improved Castles, the non-lethal Crystal League, Victory Emotes, and numerous other features and much more.

Further improvements to Magic Staffs came with the "Arcane and Frost" Patch several months later, and additional patches later in the year brought features like a new Guild Finder and support for Japanese and Italian.
In July, Albion Online celebrated a huge milestone: the fifth anniversary of its launch in 2017.
The celebrations kicked off with a major in-game event, Living Legacy, which saw statues of Albion's past season winners come to life and roam the open world.
In the fall, Albion's next major update, Beyond the Veil, went live.
This update brought mysterious and magical new realms to the game, foremost among them the Mists, a new land of danger and opportunity.
The update also introduced the lost city of Brecilien, a whole new Fey Armor line, Pristine Resources, and numerous other features and improvements.

notes.title: Find Uncle Frost this Yuletide
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/205437b427a7dde28d70c5663c0925947a6ebdfc.jpeg[/img]

Across the lands, monsters and adventurers alike are preparing for the arrival of a legendary being. No one knows where he comes from. Many have even questioned his existence. But we can confirm: [b]Uncle Frost [/b]is real, and he’s in Albion!

Until [b]Friday December 30 at 10:00 UTC[/b], you have the chance of encountering this famous figure in one of his festive grottos. These can appear in any [b]T4-T8 Solo or Group Randomized Dungeon[/b], regardless of the faction or zone - just look for Christmas trees at the end of the dungeon. If you defeat Uncle Frost there, you can find themed furniture and vanity items, including snowballs and, for the very fortunate, the ultra-rare [b]Yule Stag[/b] mount skin!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/810b92b4ef9296276a932ccccc48125d6059d505.png[/img]

[h3]Join the Festivities[/h3]
It’s not just down in the dungeons that you’ll find the seasonal spirit, though. Across Albion the cities will be decked out in festive finery, and all players will be sent [b]fireworks[/b] and a [b]huge heap of snowballs[/b] to join in the mood. To claim these, simply log into the game before [b]10:00 UTC on December 30[/b], and you’ll find an ingame mail containing your gifts. All characters will receive this, as long as they’ve completed the tutorial.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7637238d533cfddb74aade728704aaab304fd77e.png[/img]

So delve into the dungeons, engage in some snowball-based non-lethal PvP, or set the skies ablaze with a firework show - see you out there!

notes.title: Season 18 Starts Saturday
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d34f4449fe29068d3473986d6456866a3b3d1873.png[/img]

Albion’s next Guild Season begins Saturday, December 17, with a quicker pace and changes to the Crystal Arena and Conqueror’s Challenge, plus valuable rewards like the powerful [b]Goliath Horseeater[/b] for ranking guilds. Click [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/173054][b]here[/b][/url] for the full season schedule, or read on for more details...
[h3]Unique Season Rewards[/h3]
Players who gain enough Might will receive unique [b]Avatar Sets[/b], as well as the [b]Goliath Horseeater[/b] and valuable [b]Fame Buffs[/b]. Might is earned through a huge range of activities in the [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b], and there are additional [b]bracket rewards[/b] for guilds who reach at least Iron Rank. And as always, the season's number-one guild will become a permanent part of the world of Albion with their very own statue in [b]Conquerors' Hall[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/300828bd4848feff883b2029f8ade2fbbb593454.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Season Changes[/h3]
Season 18 brings some changes to the [b]Crystal Arena[/b]. Wins will offer more ranking points, to make the rank-up process flow more smoothly. Furthermore, players will receive new avatar frames for reaching Gold, Silver, and Crystal ranks, which are non-tradable and can only be obtained by reaching these ranks. In the Conqueror’s Challenge, the [b]Crystal Spider Rush[/b] requires less Might for each Guild Might Level, and each level gives more Season Points - significantly increasing the point value of each Spider. Finally, Crystal Spiders in the open world and the Roads of Avalon now drop double the loot.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1957905f0fe184f22f277148f99ca4f81e0d61ea.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Watch the Season Kickoff Live[/h3]
The season kickoff on Saturday, December 17 will be broadcast live on [url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] starting at [b]17:30 UTC[/b], with hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Lewpac[/b] and [b]Bogul[/b] bringing full coverage of Invasion Day.

At 18:00 UTC all territories will be reset for guilds to claim. Those in the North and South American time zones can tune in for the second round of territory resets on Sunday at [b]00:30 UTC[/b], when hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Tazzik[/b] cover the next round of invasions. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

Check out AlbionTV's coverage of the last Invasion Day here:

[previewyoutube=aq21rs1NZLc;full][/previewyoutube]

Then a bell rings in the distance, and soon the beating of hooves can be heard as steam emanates from broad, bovine nostrils. Rejoice: the [b]Yuletide Yak [/b]has arrived bearing gifts!

Yes, a new [b]referral season [/b]has begun, and you can transform your [b]Transport Ox [/b]base mount into this dependable, decorated yak by referring a single friend! Once unlocked, it can be used by any character on your account.

notes.title: The Yuletide Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/018abb2522e1b1feab3288d50274986151fbcafc.jpeg[/img]

Winter has returned to Albion, and the [b]Yuletide Challenge[/b] is back! For the entire month of December, earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests, and earn rewards like an avatar ring, classic furniture items, and the beloved [b]Snow Husky mount[/b].
[h3][b]Yuletide Greetings[/b][/h3]
[b]SNOW HUSKY:[/b] You've got another chance to claim the charming [b]Snow Husky[/b], a handsome canine companion that will carry you through Albion's harshest terrain. Along with its strong base move speed, its Hunting Instinct spell gives a short but powerful speed burst. 

[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Along with the Snow Husky, adventurers who reach this month's total point goal will unlock the [b]Yuletide Challenge Ring[/b], which gives your avatar a cheery holiday look any time of year. And remember: unclaimed Adventurer's Challenge Rings can always be traded in for Adventurer's Tokens at the Vanity Merchant!

[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] Unlock Yuletide Challenge chests to get a mix of holiday-themed prizes, along with goodies like Silver, Tomes of Insight, treasures and resources. Each chest has a chance to give classic Yuletide decorations like [b]Presents [/b]and [b]Decorated Trees[/b] as well as the [b]Yuletide Candle, Wreath, Lantern,[/b] and[b] Candy Boot[/b]!

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/730a9a6a607393bc2948d9877df49f7ab8e1ad52.mp4[/video]

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!
