notes.title: Beyond the Veil is Here!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c6e340d3c0662d0acf5017a4374d00c0c7af3c5c.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Beyond the Veil [/b]update is now live! This huge update introduces a whole new realm - the [b]Mists [/b]- dedicated to solo and duo play, along with the city of [b]Brecilien[/b], all-new [b]Fey Armor[/b], [b]Pristine enchantment [/b]levels, reworked [b]Roads of Avalon[/b], and more.

To mark this occasion, we’ve created a brand-new trailer:

[previewyoutube=rZqlngveFyo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Enter the Mists[/h3]
[b]The Mists[/b] offer an array of PvP and PvE possibilities to [b]solo and duo [/b]players, with lethal and non-lethal areas and some never-before-seen creatures. Some of these creatures drop valuable artifact pieces, which can be used to craft nine all-new [b]Fey Armor[/b] items with unique spells. And intrepid players will be able to discover an ancient city floating in the Mists - [b]Brecilien[/b] - offering access to the Mists and Roads, plus new [b]Player Islands[/b], for those who are able to get there.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ab431870c9f37a419539f40fd22d1d1095bdfc08.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Roads and Resources[/h3]
The Roads of Avalon have been reworked, offering more gameplay opportunities for [b]smaller and independent guilds[/b]. [b]Headquarters [/b]can now be declared in the Roads, and larger guilds will have to work harder to dominate regions. In the Outlands, meanwhile, rare and extremely valuable [b]Pristine resources[/b] will spawn, encouraging groups to gear-up and fight for these riches, while bringing a new element to the crafting economy.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9584d767352371f41c4a9a1dafb552f5162923c6.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Additional Improvements[/h3]
Some major [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] have also been introduced for Albion’s guild players, with a reworked Guild Crest Creator and Guild Description UI, as well as the ability to directly equip and purchase Guild Loadouts. The Character Selection Screen has a new look, and the Character Inspect UI now shows vanity items. And [b]mobile players [/b]will find their experience enhanced by improved spell targeting and casting, along with other UI and usability improvements.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/758cce4d02cc7a6317d61742c83b51992caf6dd5.jpeg[/img]

For the complete list of changes, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/beyond-the-veil-update][b]patchnotes[/b][/url], and for more info, see the [b]official update page[/b]:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/beyond-the-veil]LEARN MORE[/url]

And mobile players will find their experience enhanced by improved spell targeting and casting, along with other UI and usability improvements.

notes.title: Dev Talk: Fey Armor and Pristine Enchantment
notes.content:
With the [b][url=https://albiononline.com/update/beyond-the-veil]Beyond the Veil[/url] [/b]update just around the corner, it’s time for our fourth and final Dev Talk introducing some of the features coming on [b]November 21[/b]. Here, Combat Designer Michael Schwahn and Game Designer Cornelius Nitschkoff take a look at the all-new [b]Fey Armor [/b]and [b]Pristine Enchantment[/b].

[previewyoutube=CqvgfkIbyw8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Fey Armor[/h3]
Within the Mists, dangerous, fantastical creatures can be found, which drop [b]rare artifacts [/b]when killed:
[list]	[*]These can be used to craft new armor:	[list]		[*]The scales of the [b]Fey Dragon [/b]can be woven into Cloth Armor[/*]		[*]The feathers of the [b]Griffin [/b]can be stitched into Leather Armor[/*]		[*]The carapace of the [b]Veilweaver [/b]can be forged into Plate Armor[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]These artifacts are exclusively found in the Mists, and [b]cannot [/b]be created at the Artifact Foundry[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/33417e9159874c6113ed83a92252d6031bf33056.jpeg[/img]

These armors:
[list]	[*]Have the same base stats and Item Power as [b]level 3 Artifact Armors[/b][/*]	[*]Can be found next to them on the [b]Destiny Board[/b][/*]	[*]Have their own [b]Combat and Crafting Specializations[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ced781322309007b02fc54e934f593bbacc00ec9.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]New Abilities[/h3]
Each Fey Armor piece comes with its own unique ability, for example:
[list]	[*]The spider-themed [b]Duskweaver [/b](Plate Armor):	[list]		[*]Helmet ability [b]Spider Thread[/b]		[list]			[*]Shoots a thread, if it hits an enemy they are slowed[/*]			[*]Can be recast to pull you close to the enemy[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Mistwalker [/b](Leather Armor):	[list]		[*]Jacket ability [b]Mist Cloud[/b]		[list]			[*]Makes you immune to damage and healing except for when attacking or using an ability[/*]			[*]Allows ‘hit and run’ gameplay[/*]			[*]Allies within the cloud are invisible, but can take damage[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7183fcf729bc24eaf32ac473941b29f9edacba2b.jpeg[/img]
[list]	[*][b]Feyscale [/b](Cloth Armor):	[list]		[*]Robe ability [b]Wild Magic[/b]		[list]			[*]Rotates through [b]three different spell options[/b]:			[list]				[*][b]Ring of Fire[/b]: sets fire to the ground around you, causing enemies to flee[/*]				[*][b]Storm Shield[/b]: Increases resistances and stuns enemies who attack you[/*]				[*][b]Frozen Fragments[/b]: Summons five fragments which shoot at the enemy when you deal damage[/*]			[/list]			[/*]			[*]Recasting the ability casts the highlighted spell[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][h3]Pristine Enchantment[/h3]
Resources can now exist in a new[b] Pristine [/b]enchantment level:

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/214e866d52e00650276719ec8839fe74ef4a6037.jpeg[/img]
[list]	[*]An [b]open world [/b]objective, encouraging large group fights[/*]	[*]Correspond to a [b].4[/b] enchantment level[/*]	[*]Extremely rare, and found exclusively in the [b]Outlands[/b][/*]	[*]Appear as [b]T4-8 big resource nodes[/b][/*]	[*]Hide, Fiber, Wood, and Ore can be Pristine, but [b]not Stone[/b][/*]	[*][b]Protected [/b]for a long period after spawning by a magic shield[/*]	[*]Appear on the [b]minimap [/b]and [b]zone map[/b], as well as on the [b]world map [/b]when close enough[/*][/list]
[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/203aabf76eeb83bd36e49f0ac5e3c0efa4ccc425.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/edd61d771fb464d8c2b2c7490e9b42acd102b070.jpeg[/img][/url]

Pristine Resources:
[list]	[*][b]Can [/b]be acquired via transmutation[/*]	[*][b]Cannot [/b]be gained via Laborers[/*]	[*][b]Can [/b]be crafted into [b]Pristine Items[/b][/*][/list]
Pristine Items:
[list]	[*]Grant [b]100 additional Item Power[/b][/*]	[*][b]Cannot [/b]be gained by enchantment at the Artifact Foundry[/*][/list]
Fey Armor and Pristine enchantment will bring exciting new dimensions to combat and crafting in Albion. We’re looking forward to seeing what new interactions and playstyles develop around Fey Armor, and witnessing tense open-world fights over Pristine Resources. Thanks for watching, and check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/beyond-the-veil][b]Beyond the Veil[/b][/url] update when it launches on [b]November 21[/b]!

tags.feature: - Brecilien takes its name from the forest surrounding it
- Serves as a safe haven for those lost in the Mists or who willingly choose to make it their home
- Built on the ruins of an abandoned Avalonian settlement
- Fusion of wilderness and magic creates a symbiotic relationship between the forest, the wisps, and the ancient Avalonian architecture
- Position is constantly changing
- Reaching it for the first time is its own challenge
- Once inside, the city has a new mystical environment resembling the Mists
- Includes new music as well (as do the Mists themselves)
- Many of the same amenities as other cities in Albion
- Own crafting specialties, shops, and city plots
- Includes all-new Player Islands:
- New aesthetic, but identical in price and function to traditional Player Islands
- Same purchasing requirements, but can be owned alongside Royal Continent islands
- For this reason, upgrade levels between Brecilien/Royal islands aren’t shared, and abandoning a Royal island does not give a head start in Brecilien
- Allows direct access to the Roads of Avalon and the Mists
- Chooses a random Roads zone
- When a party member goes through it binds itself to the destination, allowing up to four other party members to join
- Only bound for a limited time
- Members who join the group after the binding is in place cannot use it
- Allows access to any available Mists mode (solo nonlethal, solo lethal, duo lethal)
- Entrance can be used at any time, but has a cooldown to discourage "rerolling" location
- Gives access to common Mists regions; higher-value regions require Wisps in the open world or the Mists
- Four permanent regions just outside the city
- Minimal resources can be found
- Primarily there so players can access Randomized/Corrupted Dungeons and Hellgates
- These regions aren’t protected by the city and players can be attacked, though protections exist:
- Invisibility shrines as in Portal Towns
- Several ways to re-enter: same exit previously used, OR additional portals
- Two other exits linked to other regions around the city
- Total of six ways to avoid attacks
- Finally, attacking unflagged players results in reputation loss
- Brecilien's Wisps are skeptical of outsiders, but players may be able to earn their respect
- Value of this respect is currently unknown
- However, the locals speak of a leader who left the city and may return, shedding more light on this mystery

notes.title: Beyond the Veil Arrives November 21
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c6e340d3c0662d0acf5017a4374d00c0c7af3c5c.jpeg[/img]

[b]November 21 [/b]brings Albion’s latest content update: [b]Beyond the Veil[/b]. This huge update expands the realms of Albion, introducing a new region called the [b]Mists[/b], a [b]new city[/b], [b]new mobs[/b], and new [b]Artifact Armor[/b]. Additionally, the [b]Roads of Avalon [/b]are significantly reworked, making them more competitive for smaller guilds while still offering large-group content. And a [b]new resource enchantment [/b]– Pristine – brings extremely rare and valuable treasures for high-level players. With all this and more, Beyond the Veil expands Albion’s possibilities for every player type.

[h3]Lift the Veil[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b747be96fef0bf0112aeb54e8a074f881a0d65b0.jpeg[/img]

A strange and magical realm known as the [b]Mists [/b]is dedicated exclusively to [b]solo and duo players[/b], offering a range of PvP and PvE in unpredictable zones. The Mists also contain a new City – [b]Brecilien[/b] – with [b]no fixed location[/b], offering access to the Mists and the Roads of Avalon along with its own crafting bonuses. The Mists are also home to [b]fantastical creatures[/b], which drop [b]never-before-seen artifacts[/b] that can be crafted into [b]Fey Armor[/b], with nine items featuring all-new spells.

[h3]Roads Revisited[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5505a4df5a204a519880958ea682ae0189ceb214.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Roads of Avalon [/b]have received a significant rework, becoming more accessible for [b]smaller and independent guilds[/b]. Such groups will find it easier to make their home in the Roads, while larger guilds will have to work harder to dominate regions. Certain areas of the Roads offer [b]greater riches [/b]than ever before, ensuring they remain attractive to those groups. Back in Albion’s open world, a [b]new enchantment level [/b]of resource is spawning in the Outlands: [b]Pristine[/b]. Extremely rare and valuable, and shielded at first, these resources offer a high-level goal for powerful groups to contest. They can also be created through transmutation, offering [b]high-level crafting [/b]possibilities and bringing new dimensions to combat.

[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c3aa011fd1415b9114d39077c2fbec6613fdafad.jpeg[/img]

Albion’s guilds will find their [b]UIs significantly improved[/b], with an updated [b]Guild Crest Creator[/b], a new [b]Guild Description UI [/b]making it easier to reach potential recruits, and [b]Guild Loadouts [/b]easily equippable from the Marketplace and chests. The [b]character selection screen [/b]has been revamped, [b]mobile players [/b]have improved spell targeting and casting, and the Destiny Board better explains Auto-learn and Auto-respec.

[h3]Lock in the Best Price on Premium[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4c3980b7abb7ffad91bac2ee88e9dd6d48587676.png[/img]

With the price of Premium set to increase in November, now is the best time to lock in the current price. Check out [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/170746][b]this forum post[/b][/url] for more information about the increase.

[h3]Go Beyond[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a2a55b3c3d71d213b4d708ef64edec2f571c9499.jpeg[/img]

Beyond the Veil expands and enriches Albion’s possibilities for players of all types and groups of all sizes. For full details, check out the [b]official update page[/b]:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/beyond-the-veil]LEARN MORE[/url]

notes.title: The Grim Challenge is Back
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/ec1560b9441b828936377c59c79adf7e38cc0ecf.jpeg[/img]

Allhallows is in full swing, and the [b]Grim Challenge[/b] is back! For the entire month of November, earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Pest Lizard[/b].
[h3]Pestilential Prizes For Intrepid Adventurers[/h3]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/37098394fc221f53b22942d5c2018a17b86b1dca.png[/img]
PEST LIZARD: [/b]This month's Challenge offers another chance to claim the popular [b]Pest Lizard[/b]. This sleek, slithery mount comes with a [b]Toxic Cloud[/b] ability that causes enemies who touch it to become temporarily disoriented, and can be used to disrupt enemy players in numerous situations.

[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/fd248429c8bb16fadb892cc6075439f63762bd27.png[/img]
AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Grim Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], featuring a spooky skull-topped iron frame. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Adventurer's Token.

[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b4e8429d41f50d3444dd5beab0bf7fc0a7f824ca.png[/img][/b]

[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly point totals to unlock [b]Grim Challenge Chests[/b]. Along with valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver, resources, and other loot, you'll also have a chance to unlock four furniture items: the [b]Empty Coffin, Grim Gravestone, Grim Lantern, [/b]and[b] Weeping Woman Statue.[/b]

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming,[/b] and[b] killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/45b3cb66836e268789ff59a6fe7f6c5113029808.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dev Talk: The Mists
notes.content:
Our [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-roads-revisited][b]last Dev Talk[/b][/url] announced the forthcoming [b]Beyond the Veil [/b]update, and introduced the Roads of Avalon rework that will be coming with it. In the second Dev Talk taking a closer look at this update, Game Director Robin Henkys introduces a massive and much-awaited feature: [b]the Mists[/b].

[previewyoutube=6-cJwu6_n-A;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Wisps and Portals[/h3]
When Beyond the Veil goes live, ghostly [b]Will o’ Wisps [/b]will be found drifting through the open world and the Roads of Avalon:
[list]	[*]These will retreat when approached, and [b]open a portal [/b]to their home - the Mists[/*]	[*]These portals are [b]open for a short time[/b], and chasing a Wisp through one will bring a player to this new realm[/*]	[*]Most portals allow [b]only one player [/b]through before closing, but [b]some will allow a second [/b]player to enter[/*]	[*]These two portal types are separate, meaning [b]solo players will never encounter duos [/b]in the Mists.[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e1f88c15dfd761c2747c8d56be67ee48cf6b5c41.jpeg[/img][h3]Mobs, Treasures, and Resources[/h3]
The Mists are a magical realm full of dangers and treasures:
[list]	[*][b]Heretic[/b], [b]Morgana[/b], and [b]Undead [/b]mobs roam the Mists[/*]	[*][b]Treasures [/b]and [b]resources [/b]can also be found, as in the open world[/*]	[*][b]Unique creatures [/b]can be killed for Hides, and three special types of creature exist: the Griffin, the Mistcrawler, and the Fey Dragon[/*]	[*]Similar to solo dungeons, some Mist regions are [b]enchanted[/b], with more powerful but more valuable enemies[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3aae957ac700340e8c9452333476991b1012afa8.jpeg[/img]
[h3]PvP in the Mists[/h3]
Exploring the Mists comes with the possibility of encountering other players, and engaging in combat:
[list]	[*]The Mists have both [b]lethal and non-lethal [/b]areas	[list]		[*]Entrances to lethal Mists areas can only be found in other lethal areas of Albion[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Combat within the Mists [b]does [u]not [/u]affect reputation [/b]on the Royal Continent[/*]	[*]Players have access to their [b]mounts[/b][/*][/list][h3]Rising Mists[/h3]
The tides of the Mists are constantly rising and falling:
[list]	[*]Any region will be [b]consumed by the growing Mists [/b]at some point[/*]	[*]Players can follow Wisps through a new portal to a [b]different Mists region[/b][/*]	[*]Those who do not will become ‘lost’, and returned to the place [b]where they first entered [/b]the Mists[/*]	[*]This ensures players [b]cannot band together [/b]for long within the Mists, as their groups will always be separated[/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3a10bdd151aecc45cdb671747286885e2a0ffeb8.jpeg[/img][/b]

In addition to all this, players in the Mists can encounter Wisps who have been endangered by the influx of new adventurers and are in need of aid. Helping them will [b]earn their gratitude[/b], which may have some benefits…

The Mists offer a whole range of PvE and PvP possibilities similar to the open world, but dedicated exclusively to solo or duo players. We can’t wait to launch this feature and let you explore this magical realm and its mysteries, whatever it is you seek there. See you soon!

[b]Heretic[/b], [b]Morgana[/b], and [b]Undead [/b]mobs roam the Mists
[b]Treasures [/b]and [b]resources [/b]can also be found, as in the open world
[b]Unique creatures [/b]can be killed for Hides, and three special types of creature exist: the Griffin, the Mistcrawler, and the Fey Dragon
Similar to solo dungeons, some Mist regions are [b]enchanted[/b], with more powerful but more valuable enemies
The Mists have both [b]lethal and non-lethal [/b]areas
Combat within the Mists [b]does [u]not [/u]affect reputation [/b]on the Royal Continent
Players have access to their [b]mounts[/b]
Any region will be [b]consumed by the growing Mists [/b]at some point
Players can follow Wisps through a new portal to a [b]different Mists region[/b]
Those who do not will become ‘lost’, and returned to the place [b]where they first entered [/b]the Mists
This ensures players [b]cannot band together [/b]for long within the Mists, as their groups will always be separated

In addition to all this, players in the Mists can encounter Wisps who have been endangered by the influx of new adventurers and are in need of aid. Helping them will [b]earn their gratitude[/b], which may have some benefits…
The Mists offer a whole range of PvE and PvP possibilities similar to the open world, but dedicated exclusively to solo or duo players.

notes.title: Dev Talk: Roads of Avalon Revisited
notes.content:
Albion’s next major content update is just around the corner, and we can announce it will be called [b]Beyond the Veil[/b]. Today, in the first of several in-depth looks at some of the new features and changes coming with this update, Game Director Robin Henkys introduces some significant improvements to the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b].

[previewyoutube=UnGPr1C03Xg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Changes to Hideouts in the Roads[/h3]
A number of new features will help players to make their homes in the Roads:
[list]	[*]Hideouts in the Roads will be able to be declared [b]Headquarters[/b][/*]	[*]Hideouts [b]will require power [/b]to be maintained	[list]		[*]There will be an initial three-day grace period before this applies[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Power Cores [/b]can be found in the Roads, but cannot be carried to or from the open world[/*]	[*]Guilds seeking to control entire Hideout regions within the Roads will have to be [b]considerably more active [/b]to do so[/*]	[*]Hideout construction can be [b]accelerated[/b][/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c393af9911b4509ff477d5e4856b32869be88802.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]Logout Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Logging out in the Roads will return you to the [b]place you first entered [/b]the Roads	[list]		[*]This causes [b]durability damage [/b]to equipment, and the [b]loss of some stacked items[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Players who are disconnected will have an [b]extended window to reconnect [/b]before being removed from the Roads[/*]	[*]This will prevent players staying in high-value locations to scout them constantly, making the Roads [b]more competitive and rewarding exploration[/b][/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f529a6523a637bad9871350f5d64dbb34dc19202.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]New Objectives[/h3]
The types of objectives found in the Roads have been expanded:
[list]	[*][b]Open-world treasures [/b]will randomly appear[/*]	[*]Mobs will [b]upgrade over time [/b]if untouched, as they do in the open world[/*]	[*][b]Crystal Spiders [/b]will also be found[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/af407ca838c99b605b72a2234db38444fa691dfb.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Large Group Content[/h3]
The reworked Roads will provide challenging and rewarding content for groups:
[list]	[*]Mobs have been [b]strengthened [/b]overall[/*]	[*]The areas between Hideout regions will contain [b]high-value content [/b]for large groups[/*]	[*]Large portals are now exclusive to these ‘raid regions’, while small portals have been removed entirely[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2ed23273c1be87a3e2c66bc3981c27b24ad86de3.jpeg[/img]

These changes should reinvigorate the Roads of Avalon as an area for[b] small group play [/b]and [b]independent guilds[/b], providing a variety of PvE and PvP options and rewarding exploration. We hope to encourage new guilds to enjoy this content, and can’t wait to see who makes their home in the Roads.

Stay tuned for our next Dev Talk, where we’ll delve into some more mysterious content coming with [b]Beyond the Veil[/b].

Hideouts will require power to be maintained
Power Cores can be found in the Roads, but cannot be carried to or from the open world
Guilds seeking to control entire Hideout regions within the Roads will have to be considerably more active to do so
Hideout construction can be accelerated
Logging out in the Roads will return you to the place you first entered the Roads
This causes durability damage to equipment, and the loss of some stacked items
Players who are disconnected will have an extended window to reconnect before being removed from the Roads
This will prevent players staying in high-value locations to scout them constantly, making the Roads more competitive and rewarding exploration
Open-world treasures will randomly appear
Mobs will upgrade over time if untouched, as they do in the open world
Crystal Spiders will also be found
Mobs have been strengthened overall
The areas between Hideout regions will contain high-value content for large groups

notes.title: New Victory Emotes Are Here
notes.content:
[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/47f54dbd3264ea183d7a7feb44fcd1fa1a8485b4.mp4[/video]

Albion can be a harsh land, where the winner takes all while the loser limps back to town. Each victory is an accomplishment, so when you do get a hard-earned PvP kill, [b]Victory Emotes[/b] are the perfect way to leave your mark on the battlefield! These celebratory flourishes were first introduced with the Into the Fray update, and with today's patch, there are now six new emotes to choose from: [b]Platform Banners[/b] (one each for mobile, PC, and Controller), [b]Sword, Hammer, [/b]and [b]Hellgate[/b].

Victory Emotes can be equipped in the in-game Appearance menu, and offer a wide variety of audiovisual effects that play automatically upon killing another player. Each time the effect is triggered, one charge is consumed. Each Emote can be recharged in a variety of ways.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b3ca3728ce13500d19156dc1438bae52c81c59ee.jpeg[/img]

[h3]How to get Emotes and Charges[/h3]
Charges for all Victory Emotes are purchasable with Gold in the Appearance menu, and come in different bundle sizes and prices depending on the Emote’s rarity. In addition, you can also get charges through [b]Twitch Drops[/b] – for more info on those, click [url=https://albiononline.com/twitch][b]here[/b][/url].

For more details about Victory Emotes and how they work, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/170219][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

Pick up some Victory Emotes and charges today and get ready to show off your skills!

notes.title: The Harvest Challenge is Back!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/06a4dcc5d3f6aacfeed5797945b98b539aa30661.jpeg[/img]

Fall has come to the world of Albion... the shadows are growing longer... and the [b]Harvest Challenge[/b] is back! For the entire month of October, earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get spooky loot, and claim your very own [b]Spectral Bat[/b].

[h3][b]Reap What You Sow[/b][/h3]
[b][img]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/5a9e734d7a37c596bd8f341dbc3a91df18612d68.png[/img]
SPECTRAL BAT:[/b] This month's Challenge offers another chance to claim the amazing [b]Spectral Bat[/b]. In addition to its spooky appearance, this winged menace comes with a powerful [b]Flicker[/b] spell that allows you to jump to a target location in the blink of an eye. (Note: like all mounts, the Spectral Bat cannot fly over obstacles or gaps.)

[b][img]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/19075c42b2f6083a97620356e3a682f66f0a4774.png[/img]
AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Harvest Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], featuring a pair of eerie, grinning skeletons. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Vanity Token.

[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2c7ba7c8b9fff4083306b993696b33ec95415878.png[/img][/b]

[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly point totals to unlock [b]Harvest Challenge Chests[/b]. Along with valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver, resources, and other loot, you'll also have a chance to unlock six seasonal furniture items: the [b]Scary Pumpkin Lantern, Friendly Pumpkin Lantern, Halloween Lantern, Halloween Cauldron, Halloween Scarecrow,[/b] and [b]Halloween Pyre[/b].

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!

notes.title: Season 17 Starts Saturday
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79f130300408080aeff7451a26160fa7a90e2f0b.jpeg[/img]

Albion’s seventeenth Guild Season starts Saturday, and brings some important changes to the Crystal Arena, open-world chests, Headquarters Hideouts, and more. Read on for details, or [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/168529-Season-17-Schedule-and-Changes/][b]click here[/b][/url] for the complete Season 17 schedule.

[h3]Crystal Arena Ranking Changes[/h3]
From Season 17 there will be additional substeps in the [b]Crystal Arena ranking system[/b]. While the amount of Ranking Points needed to reach maximum rank remains the same, there will be extra steps between the ranks (Iron III, Iron IV, etc.) As a result, there are now more Chests available for ranking up in a Crystal Arena Season. Additionally, Arena rankings will not fully reset, but instead players will be partially ranked down at the start of the next Season. For example, Crystal Rank players will start at Silver I. All upranking rewards that are skipped will be received in an in-game mail.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5bb077a829cf483d2091ea993245a7364d8303a6.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Headquarters Hideouts Changes[/h3]
[b]Headquarters boosters [/b]are no longer obtained at the end of the season; instead, each guild will always start with a booster. Guilds must still meet the Season Points threshold to use their booster. Using the booster, though, will now trigger a [b]90-day cooldown[/b]. These changes should make it much easier for new guilds to establish a Headquarters Hideout in the Outlands..

[h3]Open-World Chests and Crystal Spiders[/h3]
[b]Large open-world treasure chests[/b] will contain [b]more valuable loot[/b], but will spawn less frequently to make this content rarer, more desirable, and more competitive for groups.

[b]Small open-world treasure chests [/b]will take three minutes to unlock instead of five, making it less likely that organized groups form and giving solo players a better chance to fight over them.

Additionally, Regular Chests will also be slightly more valuable overall, making these open-world objectives more rewarding for all players.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1957905f0fe184f22f277148f99ca4f81e0d61ea.jpeg[/img]

[b]Crystal Spider Might Levels[/b] will be adjusted, with levels much easier to attain. As a result, each Crystal Spider will indirectly give significantly more Season Points, making them more attractive season objectives. Guild Levels for Hellgates and Corrupted Dungeons will also be easier to reach, allowing guilds to progress faster through these activities.

[h3]Season Schedule Changes[/h3]
This season will be [b]one week shorter[/b] than most. However, the final three weeks of the season will offer [b]triple Season Points[/b] from Territories and triple Might and Favor from Siphoning Mages.

[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
[b]Corrupted Dungeons: [/b]After defeating another player or getting banished, players will now be able to immediately enter a new dungeon or exit into the open world. This allows players who are interested purely in the PvP aspect of this content to directly start another invasion without needing to clear their own dungeon first.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fcc72c82b96e35b64638626f2421961e1488b758.jpeg[/img]

[b]Guild Season Rewards:[/b] In order to receive guild rewards, players must now again be a member of the qualifying guild for at least [b]75% of the season[/b]. Qualifying time spent with a guild will be easily visible in a new UI.

[h3]Unlock the Ancient Ent[/h3]
Players who gain enough Might will receive unique [b]Avatar Sets[/b], as well as the [b]Ancient Ent[/b] and valuable [b]Fame Buffs[/b]. Might is earned through a huge range of activities in the [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b], and there are additional [b]bracket rewards[/b] for guilds who reach at least Iron Rank. And as always, the season's number-one guild will become a permanent part of the world of Albion with their very own statue in [b]Conquerors' Hall[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2a7bbb848a61c8f02975d2a2dde48a7426069d40.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Watch the Season Kickoff Live[/h3]
The season kickoff on Saturday, September 17 will be broadcast live on [b]AlbionTV [/b]starting at [b]17:30 UTC[/b], with hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Lewpac[/b] and[b] Bogul[/b] bringing full coverage of Invasion Day.

At 18:00 UTC all territories will be reset for guilds to claim. Those in the North and South American time zones can tune in for the second round of territory resets on Sunday at [b]00:30 UTC[/b], when hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Tazzik[/b] cover the next round of invasions. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

Check out AlbionTV's coverage of the last Invasion Day here:

[previewyoutube=_FXUuPDDpWw;full][/previewyoutube]

For the complete Season 17 Schedule, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/168529-Season-17-Schedule-and-Changes/][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

notes.title: Into the Fray Patch 6 is Live
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/21aa301c72b57f409c428bdb9abd2aea52911c23.jpeg[/img]

[b]Into the Fray Patch 6[/b] is here! This patch brings [b]Japanese[/b] and[b] Italian [/b]language support, introduces a brand-new[b] Guild Finder[/b], and more. Read on for a summary…

[h3]Japanese and Italian Added[/h3]
This patch expands Albion Online’s supported languages to include Japanese and Italian, with the game now [b]fully playable[/b] in both of these languages. It also includes dedicated[b] in-game chat [/b]channels for each language, and new [b]language-specific subforums[/b]. All articles and patchnotes will now be translated into these languages to keep you fully updated, and if you wish to change the language in which you receive our newsletters you can update this in your [url=https://albiononline.com/profile][b]Account Settings[/b][/url]].

We hope to make playing Albion Online a more immersive and user-friendly experience for our existing Japanese and Italian-speaking players. And to those who are joining the game for the first time now:[b] welcome[/b]!

[h3]Guild Finder[/h3]
Along with new languages, this patch brings a massive new quality-of-life improvement: a brand-new [b]Guild Finder[/b]!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c0382c2d79f31c3784e4999981282473b4c6e54e.png[/img]

Players will be able to search for a specific guild by name, or browse guilds by filters such as language, time zone and activity. And if you’re a guild member looking to recruit, you can set criteria by which players can easily find you and apply for membership - or join directly if you prefer. This feature will help beginners and experienced players alike to team up and access Albion’s high-level content together. Please note that the Guild Finder wil not be available immediately, but we'll announce once it's fully up and running.

[h3]Guild Season Changes[/h3]
Albion’s seventeenth Guild Season is coming [b]September 17[/b], with some important changes. The [b]Crystal Arena[/b] ranking system will include more substeps than previously, and players will no longer rank down completely at the end of a season. [b]Headquarters Hideouts[/b] boosters will be more easily accessible to guilds, making it easier for new guilds to establish an Outlands HQ. Open-world [b]Treasure Chests[/b] will generally contain greater loot, in order to make them more rewarding for all players. And additionally, there will be quality-of-life improvements to [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b] and the [b]Guild Rewards[/b] system.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c81256d50c64dac5b47f5906ebe6dd8b59e82abe.jpeg[/img]

For full details of the Season 17 changes and rewards, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/168529][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

For more detailed patchnotes, [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/into-the-fray-patch-6][b]click here[/b][/url].

tags.balance_change: The Crystal Arena ranking system will include more substeps than previously, and players will no longer rank down completely at the end of a season.
Headquarters Hideouts boosters will be more easily accessible to guilds, making it easier for new guilds to establish an Outlands HQ.
Open-world Treasure Chests will generally contain greater loot, in order to make them more rewarding for all players.
And additionally, there will be quality-of-life improvements to Corrupted Dungeons and the Guild Rewards system.

notes.title: Dev Talk: Development Update
notes.content:
It's been a while since our last Dev Talk, and many of you have been eagerly awaiting updates. In our newest video, Game Director [b]Robin Henkys[/b] introduces some of the major new features coming to Albion with the next content update, including changes to the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b], a massive new feature called the [b]Mists[/b], and a [b]new line of artifacts[/b] for trade and crafting.

[previewyoutube=HKS-6vuo7SA;full][/previewyoutube]
Prefer a written summary? Then read on…
[h3]Roads of Avalon Changes[/h3]
Following player feedback, the Roads of Avalon are set to receive a rework in our next major update:
[list]	[*]Roads will be focused on [b]small group gameplay[/b][/*]	[*]It will be [b]easier to establish a Hideout[/b] in the Roads, but more difficult to control an entire Hideout region[/*]	[*]It will be more difficult to control high-value zones, making Roads exploration [b]more competitive and exciting[/b][/*]	[*]Rewards will focus more on group gameplay and [b]enemies that upgrade over time[/b][/*]	[*]The Roads will also receive a [b]visual update[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d6756d06967d9fedf7b490c242db5e997a4f7470.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]The Mists[/h3]
The Mists will be a brand-new environment with its own gameplay possibilities:
[list]	[*]Accessed via a network of [b]unpredictable and temporary connections[/b], like the Roads[/*]	[*]Each entrance will only allow a [b]single player[/b] to enter before it disappears[/*]	[*]A single Mists region will have [b]multiple entrances[/b], allowing for chance encounters between solo players[/*]	[*]Gameplay will be a mixture of[b] solo PvE and solo PvP[/b], with an emphasis on exploration and risk-taking[/*]	[*]Visually and thematically will be the most magical area of Albion so far, with [b]all-new music[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/02b333906ff606f4dae630093be749991d90e303.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]New Artifacts and Items[/h3][list]	[*]Within the Mists players can encounter a new range of [b]fantastical creatures[/b][/*]	[*]These drop [b]new artifacts[/b] that can be used to craft[b] brand-new items[/b][/*]	[*]The items needed to craft these new items are [b]unique to these creatures[/b] in the Mists, adding new dimensions to trading, crafting, and PvE[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/69f4e4eaf82f5fa6bb16e6275ab50f4ff441757e.jpeg[/img]
[h3]The City in the Mists[/h3]
A new City exists within the Mists, acting as a hub for trading and other activities:
[list]	[*]This City has [b]no fixed, physical location[/b], but can be said to ‘drift’ in the Mists[/*]	[*]Entrances can sometimes be found in the Mists and the Roads, but [b]not all will be able to enter[/b][/*]	[*]This City will offer [b]instant access[/b] to the Roads, Mists, and other forms of small-scale content that can be encountered elsewhere[/*]	[*]It will serve as an ideal base for advanced[b] solo and small group adventurers[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c37782425d148845babc250e70d4ae183a1eb541.jpeg[/img][/b]

We hope you enjoyed this glimpse at some of the forthcoming features we’re working on, and we can’t wait for you to try them out and discover exciting new ways to play. We’ll be going into further detail about these in future Dev Talks - and until then, see you in Albion!

notes.title: The Heretic Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/24ff6b74ff48225c7a263ca26c68477a665167b2.jpeg[/img]

The chill of fall is beginning to creep into the air... and the Heretic Challenge is back! For the entire month of September, earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Heretic Combat Mule[/b].
[h3][b]Mighty Mules and Heretic Decor[/b][/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8f727a835c35856831b6572979da864effd7f0c5.png[/img]
[b]HERETIC COMBAT MULE:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back the [b]Heretic Combat Mule[/b], a war machine from the twisted minds of Heretic saddlers. The Combat Mule fires a powerful cannon shot that knocks back and slows targets, but watch out for its massive recoil!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hd6P24z.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Heretic Challenge avatar ring[/b]. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this crazed, ramshackle avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Adventurer's Token.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f100e812f7050459d2f9253296b0d5b51c54f068.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock Heretic Challenge Chests. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver, and resources, you'll also have a chance to unlock special furniture items like the [b]Heretic Lantern, Heretic Junkpile [/b]and [b]Heretic Scarecrow[/b].
 
As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring rewards. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!

notes.title: Season 17 Arrives September 17
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cce8b5e9ab7439b9ba58a0be0f6be676744087ce.jpeg[/img]

Albion’s seventeenth Guild Season starts on September 17, and brings some important changes to the Crystal Arena, open-world chests, Headquarters Hideouts, and more. Read on for details, or [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/168529-Season-17-Schedule-and-Changes/][b]click here[/b][/url] for the complete Season 17 schedule.
[h3]Crystal Arena Changes[/h3]
From Season 17 there will be additional substeps in the [b]Crystal Arena ranking system[/b]. While the amount of Ranking Points needed to reach maximum rank remains the same, there will be extra steps between the ranks (Iron III, Iron IV, etc.) As a result, there are now more Chests available for ranking up in a Crystal Arena Season. Additionally, Arena rankings will not fully reset, but instead players will be partially ranked down at the start of the next Season. For example, Crystal Rank players will start at Silver I. All upranking rewards that are skipped will be received in an in-game mail.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79f130300408080aeff7451a26160fa7a90e2f0b.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Headquarters Hideouts and Guild Reward Changes[/h3]
[b]Headquarters boosters [/b]are no longer obtained at the end of the season; instead, each guild will always start with a booster. Guilds must still meet the Season Points threshold to use their booster. Using the booster, though, will now trigger a [b]90-day cooldown[/b]. These changes should make it much easier for new guilds to establish a Headquarters Hideout in the Outlands.
[h3]Open-World Objectives[/h3]
[b]Large open-world treasure chests[/b] will contain [b]more valuable loot[/b], but will spawn less frequently to make this content rarer, more desirable, and more competitive for groups.

[b]Small open-world treasure chests [/b]will take three minutes to unlock instead of five, making it less likely that organized groups form and giving solo players a better chance to fight over them.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/48416dbd310b7a58d0276b8da209525326cb1935.jpeg[/img]

Additionally, Regular Chests will also be slightly more valuable overall, making these open-world objectives more rewarding for all players.

[b]Crystal Spider Might Levels[/b] will be adjusted, with levels much easier to attain. As a result, each Crystal Spider will indirectly give significantly more Season Points, making them more attractive season objectives. Guild Levels for Hellgates and Corrupted Dungeons will also be easier to reach, allowing guilds to progress faster through these activities.
[h3]Season Schedule Changes[/h3]
This season will be [b]one week shorter[/b] than most. However, the final three weeks of the season will offer [b]triple Season Points[/b] from Territories and triple Might and Favor from Siphoning Mages.
[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
[b]Corrupted Dungeons: [/b]After defeating another player or getting banished, players will now be able to immediately enter a new dungeon or exit into the open world. This allows players who are interested purely in the PvP aspect of this content to directly start another invasion without needing to clear their own dungeon first.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8d6686b9790ba692156cc798ee7365c2a7c68e02.jpeg[/img]

[b]Guild Season Rewards:[/b] In order to receive guild rewards, players must now again be a member of the qualifying guild for at least [b]75% of the season[/b]. Qualifying time spent with a guild will be easily visible in a new UI.
[h3]Unique Season Rewards[/h3]
Players who gain enough Might will receive unique [b]Avatar Sets[/b], as well as the [b]Ancient Ent[/b] and valuable [b]Fame Buffs[/b]. Might is earned through a huge range of activities in the [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b], and there are additional [b]bracket rewards[/b] for guilds who reach at least Iron Rank. And as always, the season's number-one guild will become a permanent part of the world of Albion with their very own statue in [b]Conquerors' Hall[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5f69916ffc44f14f6619ae81fc495a0fc397ca66.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Watch the Season Kickoff Live[/h3]
The season kickoff on Saturday, September 17 will be broadcast live on [b]AlbionTV [/b]starting at [b]17:30 UTC[/b], with hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Lewpac[/b] and[b] Bogul[/b] bringing full coverage of Invasion Day.

At 18:00 UTC all territories will be reset for guilds to claim. Those in the North and South American time zones can tune in for the second round of territory resets on Sunday at [b]00:30 UTC[/b], when hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Tazzik[/b] cover the next round of invasions. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

Check out AlbionTV's coverage of the last Invasion Day here:

[previewyoutube=_FXUuPDDpWw;full][/previewyoutube]
For the complete Season 17 Schedule, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/168529-Season-17-Schedule-and-Changes/][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

notes.title: The Arcane and Frost Patch is Live!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/449fc025c76ca24f953313257d2a2b0da39d4ccf.jpeg[/img]

Into the Fray Patch 4, AKA The [b]Arcane and Frost Patch,[/b] is here! This patch brings the long-awaited reworks to the final two Magic Staff lines, as well as unveiling a new season winner statue, introducing changes to Black Zone looting, and much more. Read on for details…

[h3]Magic Staff Overhaul: Arcane and Frost Staffs[/h3]
This patch completes the overhaul of the [b]Magic Staffs[/b] weapon line that was kicked off with the Into the Fray update. With entirely revamped visuals and animations, along with new and reworked abilities, Arcane and Frost players will enjoy a fully refreshed and revitalized combat experience. For full details of the spell changes, see the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/into-the-fray-patch-4][b]patchnotes[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/13b2b791c7af4cae263b27cdd0ab2537b3444732.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Season 15 Winner Statue Unveiled[/h3]
With the statues safely back home in Conquerors’ Hall following the Living Legacy event, a new face has joined them! So congratulations to Season 15 winners [b]Elevate[/b], whose statue now sits at the entrance to the Hall, along with the banners for second and third-place guilds [b]Team Pilas [/b]and [b]RAQ[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5f69916ffc44f14f6619ae81fc495a0fc397ca66.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Black Zone Looting Changes[/h3]
To give active PvP participants a better chance at gaining and keeping the spoils of their battles, changes have been made to loot restrictions in the Black Zone. For the first 90 seconds after a black-zone kill, the dead player can only be looted by their own allies, the player who dealt the killing blow and their allies, or the player who dealt most damage and their allies. After 90 seconds anyone can collect the loot again.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cff1ed74346af6eb8c7032e9e161e8606ddddaae.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Updated Building Nutrition and Trade UIs[/*]	[*]Might from Castle and Outpost Chests now distributed in a wider radius[/*]	[*]Buffer zones added around open-world furniture[/*]	[*]… and more[/*][/list]
For a full list of changes, read the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/into-the-fray-patch-4][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Into the Fray Patch 3 is Live!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2b2b6ab34b500873d69a1b9158c081f878986fa4.jpeg[/img]

Into the Fray Patch 3 is live! This patch brings changes and improvements to the [b]Arena and Crystal Arena[/b], [b]Training Dummies[/b], the [b]Journey Back[/b] ability, and more. Read on for details…
[h3]Arena & Crystal Arena Changes[/h3]
This patch brings some refinements to the Crystal Arena, with [b]Rank Point calculations[/b] adjusted to better place players in an appropriate rank bracket, and Crystal Arena matchmaking now matching players of a similar ranking. Additionally, Arena losses now give fewer Adventurer’s Challenge points, to ensure players cannot reach their daily bonus with one Arena defeat. And Arena rewards are now displayed at the end of a match.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/243d7dd1ebda095f6ae5c0216646bbdddb1ac43f.png[/img]
[h3]Training Dummy UI[/h3]
[b]Training Dummies[/b] now display a small UI when being attacked or healed which displays useful information, as follows:
[list]	[*]Total Damage / Total Healing[/*]	[*]Damage Per Second / Healing Per Second[/*]	[*]Last Hit Damage / Last Heal Healing[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b8cdfcea33210d2d2e5457ee1f6c39972b48a1e1.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Journey Back Ability Changes[/h3]
Some important changes have been made to the [b]Journey Back cost calculation[/b] in this patch:
[list]	[*]It now uses the [b]average zone modifier[/b] for the zones you would have traveled through, rather than only the zone you are currently in[/*]	[*]It uses what would be the [b]cheapest route[/b], rather than the shortest[/*][/list]
To balance these cost reductions, zone type and item value now have a greater impact, while distance has less effect on the cost.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2acec2eb6c905cff3bdd79bdf9928c2872bcfba3.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*][b]Access rights[/b] after undeclaring a Headquarters Hideout are now restricted for 7 days, rather than 14[/*]	[*][b]Rare Castle and Castle Outpost chests[/b] will no longer reroll their rarity, and simply be Rare[/*]	[*]Various [b]mobile[/b] optimizations and fixes[/*]	[*]…and more[/*][/list]
For a full rundown of all the changes in this patch, check the official [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/into-the-fray-patch-3][b]patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Happy Fifth Anniversary, Albion Online!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/72140ef436e0121f99bda78720a02f3b99f8c9ce.jpeg[/img]

Today marks a truly momentous occasion in the history of Albion Online, as the game celebrates its [b]fifth anniversary[/b]! As part of our ongoing anniversary celebrations, we're taking a look back at some of the major events of the past five years…
[h3]Launch Day: July 17, 2017[/h3]
After years of development, including countless new builds and alpha and beta launches, Albion Online officially launched on July 17, 2017. In the weeks leading up to the launch, anticipation in the community reached fever pitch: people took days or weeks off work to dive into the game, created extensive spreadsheets to document their burgeoning guilds and alliances, and spent late nights on the forums plotting their first steps in the world of Albion.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9RenamXTvqU
At 13:00 UTC on July 17th, the game was officially live, and people began streaming into the Royal Continent. It was a time of firsts: first kills in the red zone, first to enter a black zone, first Hellgates, first GvGs, and claiming of Home Territories. Guilds and alliances soon began to take shape as well.

While thrilling, the launch was also challenging: the community had grown beyond all expectations, and was fully prepared to log in the moment the game was live. The numbers alone would have been challenging to handle from a support/moderation perspective, but coupled with malicious DDOS attacks it became an exhausting week for the developers and community alike. Over the following weeks, the technical issues receded, and players were able to fully immerse themselves in the game.
[h3]Early Content Updates: Expanding Albion's Possibilities[/h3]
The first post-launch update, [b]Joseph[/b], brought the Arena, which offered 5v5 battles in each of the game's cities, and PvE opportunities in the form of two new higher-tier Expeditions. From the betas through the release and into late 2017, players gained a much better understanding of Albion as a hardcore sandbox game and what to expect from it. Accordingly, in December 2017 the [b]Kay [/b]update introduced Guild Seasons, territory raids, and a political world map to the game.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/012a0d918a277247c6f5e96aa0e9f6a9fbb86aef.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Year Two: From Lancelot to Nimue, and a Steam Launch[/h3]
2018 brought three major content updates: [b]Lancelot [/b]in the spring, [b]Merlyn [/b]in the summer, and [b]Nimue [/b]in the fall. These brought major new features like fishing, open-world mobs, Faction Warfare, crafting bonuses, the Crystal Realm, and more.

Then, on May 16, 2018, Albion Online launched on [b]Steam[/b], bringing thousands of new players into the greater Albion community. The influx of players expanded the Albion ecosystem, providing new economic and combat opportunities for seasoned players.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/57e20b6f36aae60517f61d8a41132677ed6728c6.png[/img]

2018 also saw a massive expansion of [b]guild warfare[/b] in Albion, spawning rivalries that have continued to the present day. Guild conflicts varied from friendly group PvE to small-scale interguild skirmishes to all-out backstabbing and warfare. 2018 also saw the introduction of new seasonal rewards, including valuable mounts and a chance at a permanent spot in Conquerors' Hall.
[h3]A Major Milestone: Albion Goes Free-to-Play[/h3]
On April 10, 2019, Albion Online became entirely [b]free to download and play[/b]. Tens of thousands of new players flooded into the game, necessitating a queue system, an expansion of the Outlands, and an ongoing series of optimizations to server performance. As new players made it past the early-tier bottleneck, the gameworld became more lively and action-filled than ever, with full cities, constant Hellgate, Arena, and Dungeon parties, and an explosion of new guilds and alliances. The veteran Albion Online community stepped up, offering a hand up to new players via ingame chat, the forums, Discord, and numerous video tutorials.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eBU_Fxd0Jf4
Albion's free-to-play launch was a huge milestone in its development, opening up the game to hundreds of thousands of new players from around the world, making the world of Albion more alive and vibrant than ever before.

Toward the end of 2019, a new presence began stirring in the Outlands. Soon its true nature became clear: an ancient force known as the [b]Avalonians [/b]had returned to Albion. As the strength of the Avalonians grew, their intent became clear: to invade Caerleon and reclaim all of Albion for themselves. The season culminated in the chaotic Battle of Caerleon, in which Avalonian Mages and Constructs laid siege to the city before ultimately being driven back.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ea2b871dcea1e72f8236fc164b424e0e56390f94.jpeg[/img]
[h3]2020: Challenge and Change[/h3]
The [b]Queen update[/b] in January 2020 was Albion's largest content update since launch. First and foremost, the update brought a completely new Outlands continent, shaped by the magic of the Avalonians. The update also brought a whole new guild warfare system, where territory control was now determined via massive open-world battles. And those looking for 5v5 combat could battle it out in the new Crystal League, with victors able to claim valuable rewards and boost their territory's tower level.

Combat Designer Michael Schwahn remembers these changes as being a leap of faith, which fundamentally altered one of Albion's core endgame features:

"With Queen we changed territory warfare completely. We removed the existing 5v5 GvG system with Open World Territory Battles, which let more guilds and players take part in territorial warfare and also made it impossible for guild politics to be controlled by a handful of elite players. It was quite a big leap for us to replace an existing high-end feature with something completely different, but looking back, this change was absolutely for the benefit of the game and has helped it grow further."

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gW_oM4J0HO8
The [b]Rise of Avalon[/b] update, released in August of 2020, followed up with two major new gameplay systems, the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b] and [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b], as well as new Avalonian Weapons and numerous other changes and quality-of-life improvements. August also brought Albion's first-ever [b]Crystal League Championship[/b], a new high-stakes tournament that would become a regular part of Albion's offseason, pitting the top 5v5 teams against each other with massive rewards at stake.
[h3]Pandemic and Resilience[/h3]
In April 2020, with the COVID-19 pandemic affecting the entire Albion Online community, the Staff of Hermes Charity Pack was launched, with a unique healing-themed offhand costume item and avatar ring and all proceeds going to the COVID Solidarity Fund.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f4122e7bf98463f0442433203225ff29957493d8.jpeg[/img]

The response was tremendous: in the four weeks this special pack was available, the Albion Online community came together and raised an incredible €42,644.94. The outpouring of support for this cause was truly inspiring, and the "staffies" sent in by those who had bought the pack contributed to the overall feeling of community and goodwill.
[h3]2021: Major Updates and a Promise Fulfilled[/h3]
On March 17, 2021, the [b]Call to Arms[/b] update went live, bringing a complete ground-up rework of [b]Faction Warfare[/b]. Caerleon joined the fight as a sixth playable Faction with its own unique rules and playstyle, and valuable rewards including Elite Faction Mounts became available to those who pledged their loyalty to a single city. Call to Arms also brought major changes to Hellgates and the new Loadouts feature.

This was followed up by the massive, much-anticipated [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update, perhaps the game's most expansive to date. This update touched nearly every aspect of open-world gameplay, from gorgeous new visuals for all five biomes, mobs that upgrade in power and value over time, and reworked static dungeons, to the brand-new War Gloves weapon line, an expanded soundtrack, big changes to guild warfare, UI and quality-of-life improvements, and more.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1f30afea69f343eb7dd094fb22faba5b6f4398a8.jpeg[/img]

But the biggest milestone of 2021 was the fulfillment of a long-awaited promise: a truly cross-platform MMO experience…
[h3]Albion's Mobile Launch[/h3]
On June 9, 2021, Albion Online reached the final major milestone in its quest to become a truly cross-platform Sandbox MMORPG: the [b]official mobile launch[/b]. As a core goal since the earliest days of development nearly a decade ago, the worldwide launch on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store was the next massive step in opening up the world of Albion to countless new players, as well as allowing longtime players to play Albion Online whenever and wherever they wanted.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7MEvv81i3ek
The worldwide mobile launch brought unprecedented player numbers to the game, and Albion shattered its all-time record with an incredible 270,000 daily active players, nearly doubling the previous record.

In Fall 2021 the [b]Albion Online Creators Program[/b], a new program designed to support the game's talented streamers and video creators while growing the overall Albion community, was introduced. The program received a further boost the following year with the introduction of [b]Twitch Drops[/b] to support Albion's dedicated streamers..
[h3]Entering 2022: Awards, Honors, and More in Store[/h3]
As 2021 drew to a close and 2022 began, Albion Online received several major honors: the game was awarded the 2021 [b]Deutscher Entwicklerpreis[/b] for "Best Mobile Game", the 2021 [b]MassivelyOP Year-End Award[/b] for "Best MMO PvP", and the 2022 [b]Deutscher Computerspielpreis[/b] for Best Mobile Game, recognizing the game’s development into an immersive and truly cross-platform MMORPG.

And on June 8, 2022, the [b]Into the Fray[/b] update brought a fully reworked Magic Staffs line, Portal Towns, Castle improvements, Dynamic Events, and more, making it easier for new and experienced players alike to enjoy Albion’s higher-level content.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0a0caa366a3a0fe038f4544a9b73e10226fc3499.jpeg[/img]

Which brings us up to the present day…
[h3]Anniversary Celebrations: Legacies, Livestreams… and Cake[/h3]
At the start of Anniversary Week, Albion's residents were shocked to discover that the season winner statues were missing from Conquerors' Hall. Rumors began to swirl of strange rumblings across the land, and soon it was confirmed: the statues had come to life and were roaming the world!

The two-week [b]Living Legacy[/b] event kicked off July 14, bringing Albion's player-created history to life, with big rewards for those skilled enough to claim them. These included Anniversary Cake, Albion's first-ever decaying item.

Like all major events, Living Legacy came with its own dedicated trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pwTNtdvemgs
And last but not least, this milestone absolutely would not have been possible without the most important element: our incredible players. Game Director Robin Henkys shares his gratitude with the worldwide Albion community:

"The world of Albion lives through its players, and we're incredibly lucky to have such a dedicated, active, and diverse community to bring Albion to life. The past five years have certainly had their share of challenges, but we're very proud of where we've brought the game so far, and we can't wait to see what the coming years will bring."

Here's to the next five years!

notes.title: The Living Legacy Starts Today!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/162a2ef082fc7e95a0aa2d2a621d29d4f4c9d41f.png[/img]

Albion Online is turning five! And to mark this momentous occasion, today sees the beginning of a unique, two-week event: [b]Living Legacy[/b].

Until maintenance on [b]July 28[/b], we’re celebrating Albion’s history and your part in it with some special[b] themed vanity items[/b], [b]birthday cake[/b], [b]city decorations[/b], and – above all else – some [b]familiar faces[/b] roaming through the open world…

For a taste of what’s out there, check out this brand-new video:

[previewyoutube=pwTNtdvemgs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Albion’s Past Comes to Life[/h3]
After much speculation as to their whereabouts, the missing statues from Conquerors’ Hall have been discovered – and [b]they’re alive[/b]! These monuments to Albion’s triumphant guilds can be encountered in any [b]Tier 5 or higher zone[/b], and carry vast riches with them. But they’re not friendly towards adventurers, and will fight with fearsome weapons and spells before they give up their loot.

The living statues exist in [b]three different sizes[/b], which vary in strength, rarity, and value. So the stronger the statue you or your party can defeat, the better the chance of claiming some unique anniversary rewards. Arm up and take down these idols!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/64b77516e69ac3898c3443ed1f6c1aa61f75d89f.png[/img]

[h3]Birthday Presents and Unique Rewards[/h3]
For the duration of the event an array of [b]unique rewards[/b] will be available to players. All characters who log in during this time will receive a [b]Fifth Anniversary Avatar[/b] and [b]Avatar Ring[/b]. Those who watch the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/fifth-anniversary-stream][b]Anniversary Stream[/b][/url] can claim a one-off [b]Twitch Drop[/b]. And slaying statues can get you an anniversary-themed [b]Riding Horse skin[/b], a firework-launching [b]Chromacannon[/b], an [b]Anniversary Banner[/b], and slices of cake which grant a [b]temporary Fame boost [/b]- just make sure to eat them before the event is over!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/eac47361cf5f1b34c08f8b3ca7113b8e466b3ce5.png[/img]

Albion’s history is the history of its players, so join us for this unique celebration. Check out the full event patchnotes [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/living-legacy][b]here[/b][/url], and go make some history of your own!

notes.title: The Pyromancer and Cryomancer are Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b767bf25c92fda6f553404b38b5145ecd99cbc91.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Pyromancer[/b] and [b]Cryomancer [/b]have arrived! Available now from the in-game store, these premium vanity bundles include [b]full costume sets[/b] along with matching skins for your [b]Swiftclaw base mount[/b].

With the fully reworked [b]Magic Staffs[/b] in the recent Into the Fray update, now is the perfect time to show off your hard-earned magical specializations. Scorch the earth and leave ashes in your wake with the fearsome [b]Pyromancer[/b], which features vivid red vestments set with active flames and glowing embers, or freeze your foes in their tracks with the [b]Cryomancer[/b], featuring a mystical deep-blue color scheme inlaid with shards of active frost. Or grab both sets together at a [b]discounted price[/b], and become a master of both fire and ice, undefeatable in any fight.

The [b]Pyromancer Bundle[/b] includes:
[list]	[*][b]Pyromancer's Aspect[/b][/*]	[*][b]Pyromancer's Robe[/b][/*]	[*][b]Pyromancer's Boots[/b][/*]	[*][b]Pyromancer's Cape[/b][/*]	[*][b]Flamebeast[/b] (requires Swiftclaw base mount)[/*][/list]The [b]Cryomancer Bundle[/b] includes:
[list]	[*][b]Cryomancer's Aspect[/b][/*]	[*][b]Cryomancer's Robe[/b][/*]	[*][b]Cryomancer's Boots[/b][/*]	[*][b]Cryomancer's Cape[/b][/*]	[*][b]Frostbeast[/b] (requires Swiftclaw base mount)[/*][/list]As with past bundles, you can mix and match costume and mount skins with [b]all characters on your account [/b]- both male and female - and they are never lost or destroyed. Items will be unlocked in the in-game "Appearance" menu after purchase.

Pick one or both of these bundles up today, reveal yourself as a master of elemental magic, and send your foes scattering!

notes.title: Into the Fray Patch 2 is Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5368aafa7c820964d76b4140bc50d9b6f6042c4b.jpeg[/img]

Into the Fray Patch 2 is live! This patch brings updates to the Crystal League, some significant UI and audio improvements, a number of combat balance changes, and more. Read on for a summary…

[h3]Crystal League Changes[/h3]
Time slots for Crystal League battles have been updated with this patch, for non-lethal 5v5 and for Levels 1-3 20v20. Level 2 and 3 tokens for both the Lethal and non-Lethal League can once again be purchased from the Energy Manipulator, and old Level 2 and 3 tokens can be used again. Season-bound Level 2 and 3 tokens can be salvaged for their Silver purchase price, while Level 4 and 5 tokens are tradable again.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/911dcd27d7137fdd26c387fa91f61c00ba76c281.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
This patch continues to add to the significant quality-of-life improvements introduced since the Into the Fray update, with new changes including:
[list]	[*]Laborer Journals can now be purchased in bulk[/*]	[*]Active gathering yields are now displayed in the Character Details UI[/*]	[*]Daily Production Bonuses (from Dynamic Events) are now included in the Local Production Bonuses UI on the zone map[/*]	[*]Sounds created by remote players in Cities, particularly chests and player/mount footsteps, have been reduced[/*]	[*]…and more[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3f62750de37449b1711f0b1a93cc50fb439ded80.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
Improvements have been made to some of the reworked Magic Staff abilities, for example:
[list]	[*]Grudge (Cursed Staffs) Damage has been increased, and the Cursed Tar hit delay reduced[/*]	[*]Thorns (Nature Staffs) area Damage has been increased, and the Rejuvenating Flower growth interval reduced[/*][/list]Additionally, Corrupted Dungeons have seen adjustments, with Mephits made more effective at preventing players from kiting excessively. Some heavily used weapons in this game mode  have also been toned down to diversify the meta here.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fcc72c82b96e35b64638626f2421961e1488b758.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Castle chests now include rarity effects on the world map[/*]	[*]Castle world map icons now indicate when they are under attack[/*]	[*]Crystal Arena rank icons now display a tooltip showing ranking points[/*]	[*]…and more[/*][/list]For a full rundown of all the changes in this patch, check the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/changelog/into-the-fray-patch-2][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: The Undead Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/414ad4674ae86b39348ad2366177a03a297a2c54.jpeg[/img]

The dead just won't stay buried! For the entire month of July, take the [b]Undead Challenge[/b] to unlock fantastic rewards. Earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Spectral Direboar[/b].

[h3][b]Live Your Best Afterlife[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Emqzvgr.png[/img]
[b]SPECTRAL DIREBOAR:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back the popular [b]Spectral Direboar[/b], a ghostly mount with a unique spell, [b]Glimpse of the Other Side[/b], which renders you temporarily invisible. Use it to evade your enemies... or to launch a sneak attack! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TR1A3xK.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Undead Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], featuring a spooky skull-themed design that will strike fear into the hearts of your foes. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Vanity Token.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1e0fca1206375091962832c1c6ba85f1937fa559.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Undead Challenge chests[/b]. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes and Silver, you'll also have a chance to unlock spooky furniture items like the Candelabra, Lantern, and Memorial of the Fallen, as well as rare and valuable [b]Undead Vanity Skins[/b].

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount / avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while you can!

notes.title: Into the Fray Patch 1 is Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79f130300408080aeff7451a26160fa7a90e2f0b.jpeg[/img]

The first patch for the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/into-the-fray-update][b]Into the Fray update[/b][/url] is now live! This patch brings changes and improvements to the Arena, Crystal Arena, Portal Town travel, spells and UIs, and more. Here’s a summary of some of the changes:
[h3]Arena and Crystal Arena[/h3]
This patch brings some improvements to the [b]Arena[/b] and the brand-new [b]Crystal Arena[/b]. Firstly, players are fully healed at the end of a match and have all cooldowns reset, so that you enter the next fight at full health. Players’ max load now receives a significant increase while in an Arena match. Waiting times in the queue have been significantly reduced, particularly for premade 5-player teams, to get you into the action even quicker. And the highest Crystal Arena Rank Points that a player has reached in a season is now displayed in the Character Stats UI.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/21d41d9b2a052f57ef7634c2c56815d8148c20cf.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
This patch builds on the Into the Fray update with some helpful [b]Quality-of-Life improvements[/b], including:
[list]	[*]Players can now travel to Royal Cities and islands from Portal Towns with luggage[/*]	[*]Clicking a capturable orb, for example in the Crystal League, while mounted now dismounts a player rather than displaying an error message[/*]	[*]Various spell and UI optimizations[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cadc6b2346c992a6de69b20b378eb4330751f192.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]The time it takes for [b]Castle and Castle Outpost chests[/b] to despawn has been increased from 5 minutes to 30 minutes[/*]	[*]"Enrage" buff of Elite Castle Guards no longer stacks[/*]	[*]… and more[/*][/list]
For a comprehensive list of changes, read the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/into-the-fray-patch-1][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Season 16 Starts Saturday
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d34f4449fe29068d3473986d6456866a3b3d1873.png[/img]

Albion's [b]sixteenth Guild Season[/b] kicks off [b]June 11[/b], with big changes to Castles and Castle Outposts, a new Crystal League mode, Might Level adjustments, and more.
[h3]Castles Re-Envisioned[/h3]
Season 16 updates [b]Castles[/b] and [b]Castle Outposts[/b], with [b]improved layouts[/b] to encourage fighting on multiple fronts, and [b]reworked visuals[/b] to make them more varied and visually appealing. Instead of generating passive points, Castle and Outpost chests now grant [b]Might [/b]to those who claim them, and appear dynamically on a new timer. And a dedicated [b]Might Level[/b] in the Conqueror’s Challenge still allows big Season Point payouts.
[h3]Crystal Arena and Non-Lethal Crystal League[/h3]
Season 16 brings two new 5v5 modes for players of all levels. The new [b]Crystal Arena[/b] offers a ranked version of the classic Arena, with matches played in the Crystal League map with knockdown mechanics. And the new [b]Non-Lethal Crystal League[/b] provides access to the full 9-level experience, but without the full-loot kills of the regular League. Both modes have unique rewards as well, including Gladiator Wardrobe Skins. And of course, the classic 5v5 and 20v20 full-loot modes are still available for players looking for hardcore endgame content.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/243d7dd1ebda095f6ae5c0216646bbdddb1ac43f.png[/img]
[h3]Might Level Balancing[/h3]
To keep seasons balanced, progress has been boosted in several [b]Might Levels[/b] where guild progress was somewhat behind the curve. Corrupted Dungeons, Crystal Spiders, and Outland Treasures now offer [b]faster level progress[/b], giving guilds more overall Season Points and more ways to stay competitive.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1957905f0fe184f22f277148f99ca4f81e0d61ea.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Unlock the Behemoth[/h3]
Players who gain enough Might will receive unique [b]Avatar Sets[/b], as well as the coveted [b]Behemoth[/b] and valuable [b]Fame Buffs[/b]. Might is earned through a huge range of activities in the [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b], and there are additional [b]bracket rewards[/b] for guilds who reach at least Iron Rank. And as always, the season's number-one guild will become a permanent part of the world of Albion with their very own statue in [b]Conquerors' Hall[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/29dea58b7452ff4a385138ceccc7e3aeb10d45e7.jpeg[/img]

For the full list of season rewards, check out [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/164273-Season-16-Schedule-and-Changes/?postID=1222385#post1222385][b]this forum post[/b][/url].
[h3]Watch the Season Kickoff on AlbionTV[/h3]
The season kickoff on Saturday, June 11 will be broadcast live on [b]AlbionTV[/b] starting 17:30 UTC, with hosts [b]Shozen, Lewpac[/b] and [b]Bogul [/b]bringing full coverage of Invasion Day.

At 18:00 UTC all territories will be reset for guilds to claim. Those in the North and South American time zones can tune in for the second round of territory resets on Sunday at 00:30 UTC, when hosts [b]Shozen, Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Tazzik [/b]cover the next round of invasions. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

Check out AlbionTV's latest Invasion Day coverage:

[previewyoutube=da_5Ls_AFdg;full][/previewyoutube]
For the complete Season 16 Schedule, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/164273-Season-16-Schedule-and-Changes/][b]this forum post[/b][/url].
