notes.title: Dev Talk: The Sixth Faction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/a4f083c66df232f736a2eaa84c14a62ea382dc49.jpg[/img]

In his third and final Dev Talk on the upcoming Faction Warfare rework, Game Director Robin Henkys gives a first look at the mysterious new Faction joining the fight. If you haven't yet watched the first two videos, you can check them out here:
[list]	[*][b]Part 1: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dwTs_R95u_Q&t=0s]Faction Warfare Revamped[/url][/b][/*]	[*][b]Part 2: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8eC73qrEFYw&t=0s]Faction Ranks and Elite Mounts[/url][/b][/*][/list]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vBLdULJ-elA
Prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]Caerleon Joins the Fight[/h3]
Since the fall of the Caerleon portal and the city’s resulting decline, Caerleon has become a nest of bandits, smugglers, rogues and mercenaries. Now the Council of Caerleon has decided to join the war between the cities and profit from the situation.

To represent this development, we’ve [b]reworked the layout and massively improved the graphics[/b] of the city. We've added the “Stabbed Mug” Tavern, where Mercenary Captain [b]Henry Cutter[/b] recruits unscrupulous souls to fight the other cities.
[h3]A Different Kind of Faction[/h3]
The Caerleon Faction offers [b]a different style of Faction gameplay[/b]:
[list]	[*]As with all Factions, fighting for Caerleon lets you engage other Factions without reputation loss[/*]	[*]However, you will also be able to engage (and be engaged by) [b]other players in the Caerleon Faction[/b][/*]	[*]You can capture other Factions' Outposts and regions as usual, but instead of generating value over time, these turn into [b]bandit camps[/b] which generate no defensive value[/*]	[*]Instead, Caerleon players can make huge profits plundering Outposts and regions, as captured points [b]are not shared with the Faction as a whole[/b][/*]	[*]Finally, Caerleon players need to beware of betrayal: should one bandit group become too dominant, the others will have to put a stop to it if they want any of the profits for themselves[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2f488fd1b7d66981dc12acbf501e973235c035e0.jpeg[/img]

With this playstyle, Caerleon offers unique gameplay for veteran players looking for dynamic full-loot PvP with plenty of enemies.
[h3]What makes Caerleon worthwhile?[/h3]
In addition to the appeal of living free under your own banner, Caerleon offers unique Faction rewards of its own:
[list]	[*]Faction Points can buy [b]Caerleon Greywolf Pups[/b] or [b]Caerleon Elite Greywolf Pups[/b][/*]	[*]These can be grown into a [b]T5 Caerleon Greywolf[/b] or a [b]T8 Caerleon Elite Greywolf[/b] respectively[/*]	[*]Like other Elite Faction Mounts, the Elite Greywolf has two unique abilities:	[list]		[*][b]Hunter’s Mark[/b]: marks an enemy who then leaves behind a trail; collecting this trail boosts movement speed, with wounded targets offering a greater boost[/*]		[*][b]Faction ability - Spite[/b]: dismounts the rider and grants a damage reflection aura to nearby allies (can only be used while flagged for Caerleon, only affects Caerleon players in your party)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Caerleon players can also purchase [b]crests [/b]to craft [b]Caerleon Faction capes[/b] with a powerful passive that resets your Q-ability for double casting[/*]	[*]Finally, [b]Trade missions[/b] are available which are more profitable than those of other Factions[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8e6bbabf0a39d9011cad8f2b81ab6e359f58553f.jpeg[/img]
[h3]New Daily Event: Bandit Assault[/h3]
Additionally, the Caerleon Faction NPCs are responsible for the recurring “[b]Bandit Assault[/b]” event in Albion's red zones:
[list]	[*]Irregularly throughout the day, Factions will lose control of all Outposts and regions in the red zones, which will be taken over by Bandits[/*]	[*]Recapturing them is a top priority, as there will be a massive reward paid out to players in the Faction which has claimed the most regions during the event[/*]	[*]Although Caerleon players cannot participate in this event as a Faction, they can use the rush of Faction players into the red zones to set ambushes and find plenty of full-loot PvP[/*][/list][h3]In Conclusion[/h3]
This concludes our look at the all-new Faction Warfare system coming with the Call to Arms update. Will you join the Caerleon Faction and lead a life of villainy? Or will you proudly fly the banner of another city? We can’t wait to see which Faction will produce the mightiest heroes, and we're really looking forward to joining the battle ourselves.

Call to Arms will be released in mid-March – until then, stay tuned for more Dev Talks on new features!

tags.feature: To represent this development, we’ve reworked the layout and massively improved the graphics of the city.

These can be grown into a T5 Caerleon Greywolf or a T8 Caerleon Elite Greywolf respectively
Like other Elite Faction Mounts, the Elite Greywolf has two unique abilities
Hunter’s Mark: marks an enemy who then leaves behind a trail; collecting this trail boosts movement speed, with wounded targets offering a greater boost

Finally, Trade missions are available which are more profitable than those of those of other Factions

notes.title: Dev Talk: Faction Ranks and Elite Mounts
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/d09b2b2c5618ebafb21050cab99eb5f535fad443.jpg[/img]

[b]Call to Arms[/b], the next major update for Albion Online, will bring a complete revamp of the Faction Warfare system. In our [url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/devtalk-faction-warfare-revamped][b]last Dev Talk[/b][/url], Game Director Robin Henkys introduced the major components of this rework. This week, he gives a first look at Faction Campaigns, Faction Ranks, and rewards including new [b]Elite Faction Mounts[/b].

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8eC73qrEFYw
Prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]The Faction Screen[/h3]
The [b]Faction Screen[/b] is accessed via the Activities button. It shows the current overall Faction rankings, as well as which Factions offer the best rewards for joining. Most importantly, it shows your personal [b]Faction Campaign[/b] progress and your current [b]Faction Rank[/b].

After enlisting with a Faction, you become eligible to fight in their [b]Campaign [/b]and climb the ranks. Campaigns are month-long seasons that count all points you earn on behalf of your Faction, and award chests with valuable loot as you reach certain milestones.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a49d2fb50a3011591cfecb20f27508beb22d77be.jpeg[/img]

[b]Faction Ranks[/b] measure your [b]loyalty [/b]alongside your contribution. Lower ranks are the same for all Factions, but higher ranks are unique to each city and are extremely hard to unlock and maintain. We’re also working on showing which players currently rank highest within your Faction. Your rank affects the rate at which you earn points.
[h3]Faction Store + Elite Mounts[/h3]
Once you've earned points, you can still spend them on [b]City Faction Hearts[/b], [b]crests for Faction Capes[/b] and [b]Faction Mounts[/b]. We've significantly boosted Faction Mount stats, and we’ve added an [b]Elite version of each Faction mount[/b]. These offer new T8 rare mounts for animal breeders to grow, and come with [b]two unique abilities[/b] each.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/822e14c1de56b619c46895b83b16ceec4f968818.png[/img]

Note: Faction abilities are unlocked when the player is [b]flagged for the appropriate Faction[/b] and only affect players [b]in the same Faction[/b]:
[list]	[*][b]Lymhurst Elite Boar[/b]	[list]		[*][b]Regular ability[/b]: dash forward, damaging unmounted enemies and knocking them backwards[/*]		[*][b]Faction ability – Boar Vitality[/b]: dismount and give allies a large healing area of effect[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Bridgewatch Elite Terrorbird[/b]	[list]		[*][b]Regular ability[/b]: “Zig” to a targeted direction, then “Zag” to dash again and avoid attacks[/*]		[*][b]Faction ability – Desert Breeze[/b]: dismount and grant all allies a move speed bonus[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Martlock Elite Ram[/b]	[list]		[*][b]Regular ability[/b]: reduce damage taken while channeling, then gain move speed based on the number of hits taken[/*]		[*][b]Faction ability – Mountain Resilience[/b]: dismount and grant a Max Health bonus to allies in range[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Thetford Elite Swamp Salamander[/b]	[list]		[*][b]Regular ability[/b]: sheds its skin to cleanse any negative effects[/*]		[*][b]Faction ability – Reptile Agility[/b]: grants attack speed and damage bonuses to nearby allies[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Fort Sterling Elite Direbear[/b]	[list]		[*][b]Regular ability[/b]: passive that stacks with each attack, followed up with "Winter Call" ability that boosts move speed and slows enemies based on the stacks[/*]		[*][b]Faction ability – Frozen Defense[/b]: dismount and grant a defense bonus to allies in range[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
NOTE: These abilities are still in testing at the time of this recording and their functionality may change.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/748700128b9355b878c086a2ff0d50f17f9cb0cb.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Maximizing Faction Points[/h3]
In addition to earning points by fighting for your Faction, you can also see which Factions offer the most points. Factions that aren't doing as well offer [b]much higher rates of Faction Point gains[/b], and will even allow you to retain part of your [b]rank[/b] if you enlist with them. Successful Factions, however, have less reason to pay high rates of points and won’t be so welcoming to new recruits, so you’ll have to [b]give up your rank[/b] to join them. These mechanisms ensure Faction Warfare stays balanced and players have strong incentives to join cities in need, while leaving the choice of Faction ultimately up to you.

We covered a lot in this talk, but there’s still more to come. In the next video, we’ll unmask the [b]new Faction[/b], talk about their unique gameplay and rewards, and discuss the recurring [b]red zone event[/b].

Thanks for watching!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Faction Warfare Revamped
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/7fb7051901dd473cccd751aa31ce90303064fcb6.jpg[/img]

In our newest Dev Talk, Albion's Game Director, Robin Henkys, introduces the major changes coming to [b]Faction Warfare[/b] with the [b]Call to Arms[/b] update. (Note: since this is a huge feature with lots to discuss, we'll have multiple videos covering this topic.)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dwTs_R95u_Q
Prefer a written summary? Then read on...

As many of you know, Faction Warfare has been in the game for quite a while now. In this system players can sign up for one City Faction and go fight on behalf of their city against enemy Faction NPC and players. They can capture Outposts and earn Faction Points to spend on Faction rewards.

Key goals of the rework:
[list]	[*][b]Accessible and inclusive[/b] for all players on the Royal Continent[/*]	[*]Meaningful incentives for [b]loyalty to a city[/b][/*]	[*][b]Exciting large-scale battles[/b] that are easy to join and reward participation[/*]	[*][b]Supporting existing Faction Warfare players[/b] and ensuring their current full-loot system is continued and improved[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1f54142b25e66aa50ffced08d8957b46f91501de.jpeg[/img]

So how will these goals be met?

[b]1. Accessible and inclusive:[/b]
[list]	[*]Faction Warfare in yellow and blue regions is now [b]non-lethal[/b], so new players can engage with this feature without losing their gear[/*]	[*]Faction Warfare in the red zones remains [b]lethal[/b][/*]	[*][b]Increased number of red zones[/b] in the world[/*]	[*]Red zones have [b]higher value Faction Point targets[/b] for advanced players[/*][/list]
[b]2. Faction loyalty:[/b]
[list]	[*]Enlistment and flagging up is now a [b]two-step process: [/b]	[list]		[*]Step 1: [b]enlist [/b]with a Faction to become a [b]permanent member[/b][/*]		[*]Step 2: [b]actively flag up[/b] to actually fight on their behalf[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]If you choose to un-flag, you will still remain enlisted[/*]	[*]As long as you remain enlisted, you will keep your rank and other advantages, encouraging loyalty to a chosen Faction[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/622099046cf8e00154df92eda43b901b60d821f5.jpeg[/img]

[b]3. Large-scale battles:[/b]
[list]	[*]Lets new players gain their first experience in open-world warfare, while veteran players can participate during periods of low guild activity[/*]	[*]Focuses on bringing opposing Factions into conflict via a “[b]front line[/b]”, where large battles occur frequently and players can easily join[/*]	[*]To achieve this, we made regions of the world map [b]conquerable[/b][/*]	[*]To conquer a region, a Faction needs to control and hold the majority of [b]Outposts [/b]within it[/*]	[*]Controlling a region allows you to push the front line further towards the enemy while protecting your own regions[/*]	[*]In yellow and blue regions, players knocked out can rejoin the battle from a nearby friendly Outpost, so retaining control of Outposts is critical[/*]	[*]Should a region get separated from the rest of your regions, you will no longer be able to respawn there, cutting you off from reinforcements[/*]	[*]Players can use this to their advantage by capturing regions strategically and breaking an enemy’s supply line[/*][/list]
[b]4. Faction rewards:[/b]
[list]	[*]Players will still be rewarded in [b]Faction Points[/b], which they can spend at their Faction stores[/*]	[*]Earn points by capturing [b]Outposts[/b] and [b]whole zones[/b][/*]	[*]The value of capturable objectives [b]increases over time[/b], offering an incentive to push behind enemy lines[/*]	[*]Players are also rewarded for [b]defense[/b], as regions generate more points the longer they are held[/*]	[*]In addition to immediate rewards, a [b]weekly report[/b] sums up your performance and rewards additional points based on personal and overall Faction success[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b7aaeca205de812479df79ce01d520d79ae094d6.jpeg[/img]

[b]Notes on red zone play:[/b]
[list]	[*]Red zones give the same rewards, but in [b]much greater amounts[/b][/*]	[*]With no [b]respawning [/b]at Outposts, red-zone players will have to maneuver carefully and strategically[/*]	[*]In addition to generating much higher rewards, the red zones will have [b]a new enemy[/b] to be announced soon[/*][/list]
The Faction Warfare rework is so large we’ve split it into multiple videos – join us next time where we’ll discuss Faction Rewards, ranks, balancing, and the all new Faction Seasons.

Thanks for watching!

tags.feature: Faction Warfare in yellow and blue regions is now non-lethal, so new players can engage with this feature without losing their gear
Faction Warfare in the red zones remains lethal
Increased number of red zones in the world
Red zones have higher value Faction Point targets for advanced players
Enlistment and flagging up is now a two-step process: Step 1: enlist with a Faction to become a permanent member
Step 2: actively flag up to actually fight on their behalf
If you choose to un-flag, you will still remain enlisted
As long as you remain enlisted, you will keep your rank and other advantages, encouraging loyalty to a chosen Faction
Lets new players gain their first experience in open-world warfare, while veteran players can participate during periods of low guild activity
Focuses on bringing opposing Factions into conflict via a "front line", where large battles occur frequently and players can easily join
To achieve this, we made regions of the world map conquerable
To conquer a region, a Faction needs to control and hold the majority of Outposts within it
Controlling a region allows you to push the front line further towards the enemy while protecting your own regions
In yellow and blue regions, players knocked out can rejoin the battle from a nearby friendly Outpost, so retaining control of Outposts is critical
Should a region get separated from the rest of your regions, you will no longer be able to respawn there, cutting you off from reinforcements
Players can use this to their advantage by capturing regions strategically and breaking an enemy’s supply line
Players will still be rewarded in Faction Points, which they can spend at their Faction stores
Earn points by capturing Outposts and whole zones
The value of capturable objectives increases over time, offering an incentive to push behind enemy lines
Players are also rewarded for defense, as regions generate more points the longer they are held
In addition to immediate rewards, a weekly report sums up your performance and rewards additional points based on personal and overall Faction success
Red zones give the same rewards, but in much greater amounts
With no respawning at Outposts, red-zone players will have to maneuver carefully and strategically
In addition to generating much higher rewards, the red zones will have a new enemy to be announced soon

notes.title: Patch 13 is Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/dae55ab0fe0b3255e68e5de9b8ca7cf9534669ab.jpeg[/img]

Patch 13, AKA the [b]Rise of Avalon Balance Patch[/b], is now live! This patch brings numerous changes to Avalonian mobs, big meta changes to combat balancing, a long-awaited quality of life improvement, and more. Here's what's new:
[h3]Updated Avalonian Mobs[/h3]
Patch 13 improves the overall experience of [b]Elite Dungeons[/b], offering a more streamlined combat experience while fighting Avalonians while retaining the challenge of these high-level enemies. Most high-damage Avalonian spells can no longer be reflected, the Construct's "blind spot" has been removed, and the skills of the [b]High Priestess[/b], [b]Crystal Basilisk[/b], and [b]Sir Bedivere[/b] have been updated to keep you on your toes.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/911dc1ec75af35c531494c2ad247bc73d29b11d3.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Keeping the Meta Fresh[/h3]
This patch contains numerous changes to combat abilities across a wide range of weapons, armor, and equipment, with the primary goal of addressing the meta in[b] small-scale PvP[/b] and [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b]. A new Mace ability, [b]Guard Rune[/b], has been added, the Guardian Helmet's Emergency Heal has been reworked as [b]Emergency Shield[/b], and several [b]Battle Mounts[/b] have reduced cooldowns to keep them competitive in open-world combat.
[h3]Rejoice: The Use-All Button is Here[/h3]
Free yourself from the tyranny of endless clicking, and use all your Silver Bags and Tomes with [b]a single button click[/b]. Patch 13 introduces the [b]Use All Button[/b], perhaps Albion's most-requested feature of all time. If you missed the teaser trailer, you can watch it in all its glory here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S5h8XjI9O0c
[h3]Additional Changes[/h3][list]	[*][b]Political View[/b] is once again available on the World Map[/*]	[*]Updates to setting a [b]Hideout [/b]as Home - details [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/143364][b]here[/b][/url][/*]	[*]Fixes to the [b]Estimated Market Value[/b] display[/*]	[*]Improvements and optimizations to the [b]mobile version[/b][/*]	[*]...and much more[/*][/list]
As always, you can read the full list of changes in the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/changelog/RISE%20OF%20AVALON%20PATCH%2013][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Dev Talk: Call to Arms Introduction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/5887867e198df438435c22af79de2f886481ccd2.jpg[/img]

We've been hinting at the next major update for Albion Online for some time now... and in our latest Dev Talk, Game Director Robin Henkys finally makes it official!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aAZ3D-p1M-8
Prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]First Up: Patch 13[/h3]
The next Balance Patch in early February adjusts combat balance values, adds a new ability for Maces, and updates some combat abilities. These changes address the meta in [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b], improving the balance of different builds in 1v1 and small-group PvP.

In addition, this patch will bring the long awaited [url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/the-button-is-coming][b]“Use All” button[/b][/url] for bags and Tomes, improvements to Avalonian enemies, and limiting the ability to set a "Home" at [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/143364][b]Hideouts[/b][/url] to those owned by your guild, or Level 3 Hideouts owned by your alliance.
[h3]Next Update: Call to Arms[/h3]
As the Season builds up to its finale, we’re preparing to release the next big content update for Albion Online: [b]Call to Arms[/b]. Public playtesting is expected to begin in mid-February, and in the coming weeks we'll release more Dev Talks.

Here's an overview of what this update will bring:

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/68bc3c5810e4b67fc22137adfb61f6e5b7b97ac3.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Faction Warfare 2.0[/h3]
Call to Arms will focus on introducing the next stage of [b]City Faction Warfare[/b], including:
[list]	[*]Ability to control [b]entire regions[/b][/*]	[*]A [b]front-line battle system[/b] that encourages competing Factions to fight in the same regions[/*]	[*]Rewards for [b]loyalty[/b] to a city, with points for both attacking enemies and defending owned regions[/*]	[*]Monthly [b]Faction Campaigns[/b] with valuable rewards[/*]	[*]Powerful new [b]Faction Mounts[/b][/*]	[*]A [b]new Faction[/b] offering a unique playstyle for advanced players, including its own [b]Faction cape [/b]and [b]mount[/b][/*][/list]
Alongside these changes, we’re [b]expanding the Royal Continent[/b] and adding a [b]recurring Faction Warfare event[/b] in the center of the continent to encourage high-stakes conflict. In our next Dev Talks, we’ll go in-depth with this system, and explore the opportunities it offers veteran players and beginners alike.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d9d80a6c1a6c0d88179a35ae3372982d1597ac85.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Hellgates Re-Envisioned[/h3]
The second major gameplay feature in Call to Arms is a massive improvement of [b]Hellgates[/b], including:
[list]	[*][b]10v10 Hellgates[/b] for mid-sized PvP at any time[/*]	[*]Significant improvements to [b]Hellgate graphics and gameplay[/b][/*]	[*]A large variety of new Hellgate [b]layouts[/b][/*]	[*]A new and improved [b]matchmaking [/b]system[/*]	[*]A [b]“rising lava”[/b] mechanic to prevent stalling strategies[/*]	[*]Inclusion of many of the demonic creatures introduced with [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b][/*]	[*]A [b]Hellgate Infamy system[/b], allowing players to improve their rewards and measure their success against others[/*][/list]
This overhaul of Hellgates aims to address gameplay concerns brought to us by longtime players, as well as open one of Albion’s most exciting PvP features to more players. We'll have a full Dev Talk on the new Hellgates soon.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/22ec68b6231de4a283e73b5e4ddedc0ad17a241b.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Additional Features[/h3]
Call to Arms will also include a [b]moving-vegetation[/b] graphics upgrade to bring plants to life, plus two major convenience improvements: [b]improved Ability Tooltips[/b] and [b]Loadouts[/b].

The new [b]Tooltips [/b]make understanding and comparing different spells and abilities much easier, as all spells will have [b]colored tags[/b] and [b]reworked descriptions[/b] to improve readability.

[b]Loadouts[/b] will let players save equipment sets to quick-equip from [b]bank chests and battle vaults[/b]. Loadouts can be shared with other players via chat or ingame mail, and made available to guilds to help recruit new players into specific roles. The feature can also be used to strategize about builds via a preview of the [b]stats and estimated cost[/b] of a Loadout. We’re also working on [b]quick-buy of saved Loadouts[/b], which we hope to release in a patch shortly after the update.

We'll explore all these features in-depth in more Dev Talks over the coming weeks, so stay tuned!

notes.title: 2020: Albion's Year in Review
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/72140ef436e0121f99bda78720a02f3b99f8c9ce.jpeg[/img]

2020 has been... something else. It has been a year of unexpected challenges. Challenges for our own team, and challenges for the entire Albion community as a whole. Despite the adverse conditions, we've seen an incredible community-wide outpouring of creativity and resilience, which has given us a great deal of inspiration and strength as we head into the new year.

Join us as we take a look back at the highlights of this terrible, wonderful year of 2020...
[h3]The Queen Update: A New Era for Albion[/h3]
2020 began with the massive [url=https://albiononline.com/en/update/Queen][b]Queen update[/b][/url], Albion's biggest content update since the game's launch in 2017. Six months in the making, Queen was nothing less than a complete re-envisioning of Albion's endgame, as well as a chance to introduce a host of quality-of-life improvements and far-reaching optimizations.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/16b7aec4c97ea3ec5a7841121d77c2109d4b6d35.jpeg[/img]

How did the Queen update revolutionize Albion Online?
[list]	[*][b]New Outlands:[/b] A completely reworked continent with higher-value zones at the center, giving guilds the option of living completely in the Outlands[/*]	[*][b]Hideouts: [/b]Autonomous homes for guilds, upgradeable with Marketplaces, Artifact Forges, Energy Manipulators, and Guild Halls[/*]	[*][b]Open-World Territory Battles:[/b] A new opportunity for large-scale combat supported by zerg balancing and the Smart Cluster Queue, allowing guilds of all sizes to compete in the open world[/*]	[*][b]The Crystal League:[/b] A new realm of high-level 5v5 fights, with the added ability to upgrade your guild's territories[/*]	[*][b]Elite Dungeons and Avalonian Armor:[/b] Face Albion's newest faction in 20-player dungeons with incredible rewards and a new armor line[/*]	[*][b]Wardrobe Skins:[/b] A long-requested way to use costume items in the open world without losing them or giving up combat readiness[/*][/list][h3]COVID-19: The Albion Community Responds[/h3]
By Spring 2020, much of the world was in partial or total quarantine. While these lockdowns would bring [url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/population-update-may-2020][b]increased player numbers[/b][/url] to the game, they also created tremendous challenges for the development process as the team adjusted to working from home.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f4122e7bf98463f0442433203225ff29957493d8.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Staff of Hermes[/b] fundraiser launched in early April. This unique charity bundle included a limited-time vanity staff and matching avatar ring, with 100% of the proceeds going to the [b]COVID Solidarity Fund[/b]. The community came through in force, raising an incredible[b] €42,644.94[/b] for those in need and [url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/over-40000-raised-for-charity][b]looking great[/b][/url] in the process.
[h3]Summer 2020: Anniversaries, Updates, and a New Tournament[/h3]
On July 17, Albion celebrated its [url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/in-game-anniversary-events-and-fame-boost][b]third anniversary[/b][/url]. (Can you believe it's been three years already? The time just flies...) You celebrated this anniversary alongside us with a week-long Fame Boost and the ultimate throwback: the return of a classic Keeper dungeon from Albion's beta, [b]Defenders of the Past.[/b]

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/233351cc2504a09032e9d2ec94bf341d95ff9dc7.jpeg[/img]

In August, the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/update/rise-of-avalon][b]Rise of Avalon[/b][/url] update, the second massive update of 2020, went live. It brought with it a gigantic set of new features like the vast [b]Roads of Avalon[/b],[b] Corrupted Dungeons[/b] for challenging PvE and intense single-player PvP, and a new line of [b]Avalonian Weapons [/b]alongside improvements to UI, crafting, and cooking. In addition to bringing new depth and complexity to the world of Albion, the update introduced [b]Chinese and Korean[/b] language support, further expanding Albion's worldwide community.

The following week, Albion saw its first-ever Crystal League tournament, soon to be known as the [b]Crystal League Championship[/b]. Over two action-packed days, the greatest 5v5 teams in the game competed for incredible prizes including the ultra-rare [b]Sabertooth Rex[/b] Swiftclaw skin, with a final showdown that came down to the last seconds:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MJ81SchJaaU
[h3]Fall 2020: Brimstone & Mist, Mobile Improvements, and an Ever-Growing Population[/h3]
In October, the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/brimstone-and-mist-is-here][b]Brimstone & Mist Midseason Update[/b][/url] went live, bringing new enemies and traps in Corrupted Dungeons, increased fishing opportunities and new fish in the Roads of Avalon, updates to Disarray and the Smart Cluster Queue, crafting and butchery improvements, and much more. This update also brought [b]delta patching[/b] to Android, allowing players to update the game without a full download - a crucial step toward the full launch of the mobile version, which was further advanced by November's [b]Play Store beta[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9d4b9ee4db192d0ca324329c41249c10d273f339.png[/img]

Meanwhile, the ingame population continued to grow and grow, reaching an unprecedented [b]125,000 daily average users[/b]. This increase occurred in spite of the overall easing of worldwide lockdowns, and was due in large part to the large number of players who joined the game with the [b]Rise of Avalon[/b] update.
[h3]Looking Ahead to 2021[/h3]
2021 will bring massive updates to Albion, starting with the next major content update. [b]Faction Warfare[/b] will be completely reworked, offering new activities, rewards, and fair and challenging large-scale battles for beginner and veteran players alike. [b]Hellgates[/b] will also be completely re-envisioned, with varied layouts, challenging PvE, rebalanced PvP, and a new 10-versus-10 mode, while [b]Loadouts[/b] will allow players to save their favorite gear combinations for re-gearing and Marketplace purchases.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b5b473dd1c222367bf61256a809554dbbd9b6b86.jpeg[/img]

In addition, 2021 will also bring the long-awaited official launch of the [b]mobile version[/b] for the iOS/Google Play stores. This launch is the culmination of years of iteration and optimization for handheld devices, from combat to crafting to menu displays, and will fulfill our goal of making Albion Online the first truly cross-platform Sandbox MMORPG.

If you missed it, you can check out our final Dev Talk of 2020 here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LxosGPJl3f4
We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to the entire Albion Online community for making what we do possible, particularly during such a challenging and difficult year. We're very excited for what 2021 will bring to the world of Albion – Happy New Year, and we'll see you ingame!

- Your Albion Online Team

notes.title: Dev Talk: Year-End Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/8808deb994af79fa655a1e7d65c89a6d71ba6f71.jpg[/img]

2020 was Albion's biggest year yet, with numerous patches and updates, a host of major new features, and an ever-growing player population. In the final Dev Talk of the year, Game Director Robin Henkys looks back at the past year in the world of Albion before looking ahead to what's coming in 2021.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LxosGPJl3f4&feature=emb_logo
To take the year-end survey mentioned in the video, [url=https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/AlbionOnlineRoadmap2021Survey][b]click here[/b][/url].

No time to watch the video, or prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]2020: Albion's Biggest Year Yet[/h3]
The past year brought some major changes, improvements, and new features to the world of Albion:
[list]	[*]Complete Outlands overhaul[/*]	[*]Introduction of Hideouts[/*]	[*]Open-World Territory Battles[/*]	[*]Avalonians and Elite dungeons[/*]	[*]Crystal League[/*]	[*]Avalonian Weapons and Armor[/*]	[*]Roads of Avalon[/*]	[*]Wardrobe Skins[/*]	[*]Corrupted Dungeons[/*]	[*]Outlands Banks[/*]	[*]Updated UIs[/*]	[*]2 new languages[/*]	[*]Combat Balance Improvements[/*]	[*]Mobile improvements: New mobile HUD and control scheme, auto-updating, beta of the Google Play Store version[/*]	[*]20v20 Crystal League battles and other Season 11 adjustments[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/83b4d8b415a591fd50b7f8a7d9ca11d3420efcfd.jpeg[/img]

In total we released 29 updates and patches with the majority happening out of our homes. Albion now consistently has over 500,000 active players every month, and player numbers are still growing.
[h3]Looking Forward to 2021[/h3]
Major changes coming in the next year include:
[list]	[*]A complete [b]Faction Warfare[/b] rework to bring open-world warfare to every player[/*]	[*]Improving [b]Hellgates [/b]to make fair, smaller-scale PvP widely accessible and rewarding[/*]	[*][b]Loadouts[/b], which allow you to save, share and quick-equip item sets on your character[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d559527583eda16bafbefe4c38b43c0157279951.jpeg[/img]

Improvements to the [b]open world[/b] and [b]world design[/b] of Albion:
[list]	[*]Reworking the fundamental building blocks of the world[/*]	[*]Improving visual quality while reducing dead ends and nonsensical layouts[/*]	[*]Improving open-world locations like large static dungeons, making them high-value hotspots[/*]	[*]Making treasures appear less predictably to trigger smaller-scale fights as intended[/*]	[*]Improving the world map with more information about ongoing activities[/*][/list]
[b]Quality-of-Life [/b]Improvements:
[list]	[*]Loadouts for quick-equipping items[/*]	[*]Additional functionality to quick-buy Loadouts from Marketplaces[/*]	[*]Adding better information about actual costs to crafting UIs[/*]	[*]Tackling long-standing convenience issues like a “Use All” functionality for Tomes and Silver bags[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/63388b2d0406fe8ce20b6ac4460051ce4a35ad50.jpeg[/img]

[b]Combat [/b]improvements:
[list]	[*]Giving each type of mount, even non-rare mounts, their own spells and abilities[/*]	[*]Further expansion of equipment choices available to players[/*][/list]
[b]Mobile [/b]version:
[list]	[*]2021 will be the year Albion Online officially releases for phones and tablets[/*]	[*]Will launch on both iOS and the Google Play Store[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d0bf470efa02870fbe4a827e37c173c3636bdf66.jpeg[/img]

Additional goals:
[list]	[*]Long-needed Castle improvements[/*]	[*]Siege equipment and defensive structures[/*]	[*]Roaming mob improvements[/*]	[*]Additional content and exploration goals for the Roads of Avalon[/*][/list]
Game systems:
[list]	[*]Expansion of options and visual improvements for Destiny Board[/*]	[*]Trade contracts allowing players to offer Silver for item delivery[/*]	[*]Revisiting the role of laborers and offering additional features and variety on player islands[/*]	[*]Legendary item crafting to leave a permanent mark in the world of Albion[/*]	[*]New mounts and equipment (gathering mounts, potential new resource tier)[/*][/list]
Goals for PvE, guild leaders, and data enthusiasts:
[list]	[*]More lore and quests[/*]	[*]Special collectible rewards for completing quests[/*]	[*]Increased capabilities for guild management[/*]	[*]Improved Web API[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/817348698287c66736db119ef15733a27550e389.jpeg[/img]

For guilds in general, we want to expand on Hideouts with additional open-world buildings guilds could use to protect territories, collect resources or provide combat support in the open world. And for beginning players, we want to introduce a mentoring program called the Albion Academy.
[h3]We Need You![/h3]
As usual at the end of the year, we’re looking for your opinions about Albion Online. What are we doing well? What do we need to improve? And what features would you like to see? You can tell us in our [b]end-of-year survey[/b] which we’ll be sending to active players who have opted-in to receive the newsletter in the coming weeks, or fill out our Roadmap Survey [url=https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/AlbionOnlineRoadmap2021Survey][b]here[/b][/url].

Your feedback will help us decide which features to prioritize as we continue our journey to make Albion Online the best Sandbox MMORPG in the world.

Thank you for your continued support, and we'll see you in 2021!

notes.title: Uncle Frost is Back - and a Fame Boost is Coming
notes.content:
Decorations fill the cities, the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/yuletide-challenge-returns][b]Yuletide Challenge[/b][/url] is in full swing, and the mysterious [b]Uncle Frost[/b] can be found lurking in Albion's dungeons. And for one week, the [b]Mists of Albion[/b] will return, granting an additional [b]25% Fame[/b]! Read on for details...

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fa4f043304d331e5a08e9d07c636c3c06e2f2a85.png[/img]
[h3]Uncle Frost Returns[/h3]
The mysterious spirit known as [b]Uncle Frost[/b] – sometimes benevolent, sometimes evil – has returned to Albion. Last year he was only in Keeper dungeons, but now he can appear in [b]Solo and Group Randomized Dungeons[/b] of [b]all factions[/b]. Watch for Christmas trees near the dungeon's end, and defeat him for a chance at special loot including Snowballs, Yule-themed items, and even the rare [b]Yule Stag[/b] mount skin!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/810b92b4ef9296276a932ccccc48125d6059d505.png[/img]
[h3]Celebrate the Season[/h3]
To help celebrate (and show there are no hard feelings), Uncle Frost has sent [b]fireworks[/b] [b]and snowballs[/b] to all players. To claim them, log into the game before [b]December 30, 2020 at 10:00 UTC[/b]. Details:
[list]	[*]Rewards will be attached to an in-game mail, and consist of:	[list]		[*][b]Fireworks [/b](3 colors)[/*]		[*][b]Snowballs[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Reward will be sent to all characters who log in during this period and have completed the tutorial[/*][/list]
Claim your rewards, then hit the streets of Albion to launch some fireworks or start a snowball fight!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7637238d533cfddb74aade728704aaab304fd77e.png[/img]
[h3]Holiday Fame Boost[/h3]
Finally, we're rounding out the year with a [b]week-long Fame Boost[/b]. Log in between [b]December 23 10:00 UTC[/b] and [b]December 30 10:00 UTC[/b] for the automatic Mists of Albion buff, which grants an additional 25% Fame for all activities. It's the perfect time to unlock another gathering tier or max out a weapon line! (Note: Fame Boosts do not apply to Fame from Tomes, and do not accelerate Adventurer or Guild Challenge progress.)

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e69097e59b9235c73e6348c2cd8a69f63f7f509a.png[/img]

As the year winds down, we want to thank the Albion community for making the world of Albion more vibrant than ever. Stay tuned for a year-end wrapup covering the major events of 2020!

notes.title: New Vanity Skins are Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c9c28b3fd830d907e03d070a388f61c28363a297.png[/img]

Albion's third premier costume set, the [b]Mage Adventurer Bundle[/b], is now available! This newest bundle includes [b]ten vanity unlocks [/b]to give your character the look of a shrewd, battle-hardened mage. All the included items can be used on male or female characters, with unique looks (and even unique voices) for each.

Like the Rogue and Knight Bundles, this new bundle also includes an [b]Armored Horse Mount Skin[/b] with a matching theme. On top of that, it also includes [b]guild versions[/b] of the Mage Adventurer hat, armor, cape, and mount skin that allow you to show off your currently active guild logo and colors.

The centerpiece of the Mage Adventurer Bundle is the [b]Spellbook[/b], a main-hand costume weapon. The Spellbook uses the primary weapon slot, and like all other vanity weapon items with unique spells, its spells can be toggled on or off with a special button next to the spell icons.

[b]Magical Fireworks:[/b]
[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5e37ff96a0161ad2dc302e479ad3aed8f55b48ef.mp4[/video]

[b]Wings of Magic:[/b]
[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bef2611c49f76df49da1f49ad02efbaef258c193.mp4[/video]
[h3]How to Get the Mage Adventurer Bundle[/h3]
The full bundle is available in the ingame store and includes all Mage Adventurer regular and guild skin options:
[list]	[*]Mage Adventurer's Hat, Armor, Boots, and Cape[/*]	[*]Mage Adventurer's Spellbook with 2 Premium Emotes[/*]	[*]Mage Adventurer's Armored Horse Skin[/*]	[*]Mage Adventurer's Guild Hat[/*]	[*]Mage Adventurer's Guild Armor[/*]	[*]Mage Adventurer's Guild Cape[/*]	[*]Mage Adventurer's Guild Armored Horse Skin[/*][/list]
This option offers the best value for those who want all Mage Adventurer items.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/abd64d93dab0a49097175a546c71015b74f3ad9a.jpeg[/img]
[h3]New Swiftclaw Skin: The Miststalker[/h3]
A brand-new Swiftclaw mount skin, the [b]Miststalker[/b], is now available in the ingame store. Inspired by the ancient beasts found in the Roads of Avalon, the Miststalker turns your Swiftclaw mount into a mystical, mist-hued creature with glowing blue eyes.

Swiftclaws have long been a favorite mount of both group and solo players looking to cover large distances quickly, with large battles seeing dozens of them in use at once. The Miststalker is the perfect option for those looking to upgrade their Swiftclaw's appearance and stand out from the pack.

Like all mount skins, once the Miststalker is unlocked it can be used by all characters on your account forever. Pick it up today and ride out into the wilds of Albion!

notes.title: Season 11 Starts Saturday
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ff71c48c9409f56b854790ded675c45a7ea3990b.jpeg[/img]

Saturday marks the beginning of Albion's [b]eleventh Guild Season[/b], which brings the new [b]20v20 Crystal League[/b], as well as [b]Point Balancing and Daily Limits[/b] for Crystal League matches, major updates to [b]World Boss Zones[/b] and [b]Castle Scoring[/b], and an incredible new battle mount, the [b]Roving Bastion[/b], as a season reward for ranking guilds.

Guilds that reach a high enough rank can claim fantastic rewards including an [b]avatar,[/b] [b]avatar ring,[/b] and the mighty [b]Roving Bastion [/b]mount. While the final stats are subject to change, it will be a [b]support battle mount[/b] with a powerful push ability that knocks back enemy forces away, allowing armies to break through enemy lines. It will also have a [b]shield aura[/b] ability that offers protection against damage and displacement effects to allies. This mount will be awarded to guilds who reach [b]Silver Rank or higher[/b] during Season 11, with increasingly higher stats and epic appearance with each successive tier.

The winning guild will receive a statue among the past Guild Season winners in Conquerors' Hall, accessible via all major cities. Qualifying guilds will also receive a Fame Bonus and furniture items, as listed in the tables below:

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/222ed4e25f14deda3798acccd7472f473b30b380.jpeg[/img]

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8f5213d2bc09379bad42cafd9bfbc7eb6cd013d4.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Big Changes for Season 11[/h3]
This Season introduces the [b]20v20 Crystal League[/b], allowing all players to join fair and exciting 20v20 battles. Match rules are similar to the 5v5 League, but with an entirely new map similar to the old city fight map. As in the 5v5 League, Level 1 matches are [b]knockdown only[/b] and offer perfect training for newcomers; risks and rewards increase greatly with each subsequent level, culminating in a final [b]Level 6[/b] match at the end of the season.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/75bd6102a0d901452c118f6f164dff76ba7669ca.jpeg[/img]

Alongside the new 20v20 league, Crystal League Season Points have been rebalanced, and a new Daily Point Limit for the Crystal League has been implemented.

Season 11 also brings other far-reaching changes and improvements to open-world guild warfare in Albion:
[list]	[*][b]World Boss Zone Improvements[/b] to make these zones into valuable Fame Farming hotspots and lead to more midsize open-world fights[/*]	[*][b]Castle Scoring Changes and Minimum Distance Increase[/b] to split large forces and reduce overcrowded clusters[/*]	[*][b]Ability to Skip Overcrowded Clusters[/b] and jump directly to an adjoining cluster to join the fight[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0f2c16953bc6a630a6f750cb75ed9fc52022f112.jpeg[/img]

Last but not least, this season will also include numerous [b]combat balance changes[/b] launched with Patch 10. For more details on these changes, [url=https://albiononline.com/en/changelog/RISE%20OF%20AVALON%20PATCH%2010][b]click here[/b][/url].
[h3]Watch the Season Kickoff Live[/h3]
The action kicks off on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] this [b]Saturday, December 5 at 17:30 UTC[/b], when hosts [b]Shozenwon, Lewpac [/b]and[b] Bogul[/b] bring you full coverage of Invasion Day.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8dbc205d07064988c93d207c5860d8c0b0847424.jpeg[/img]

At [b]18:00 UTC[/b], guilds can claim territories and launch attacks. Those in the North and South American time zones can also tune in for the second round of territory resets on [b]Sunday, December 6 at 00:30 UTC[/b] with hosts [b]Shozenwon, Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Bogul[/b] covering the next round of claimable territories starting at [b]01:00 UTC[/b]. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

For the complete Season 11 schedule, check out [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/140696][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

notes.title: Rise of Avalon Patch 10 is Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/947cb7027ae6bc9a3ae0cab562dbb17383ad40a5.jpeg[/img]

Rise of Avalon Patch 10, AKA the [b]Season 11 Patch[/b], is now live. This patch brings major changes and improvements to guild warfare in Albion, starting with the Season 11 kickoff on [b]Saturday, December 5[/b].

Here's an overview of what's new:
[h3]20v20 Crystal League Battles[/h3]
[b]20v20 Crystal League battles[/b] allow players of all levels to participate in thrilling 20v20 battles. Level 1 battles are knockdown only, providing the perfect training ground for newer players, while higher-level fights are full loot, with correspondingly higher rewards. The 20v20 league has 6 levels, with the final Level 6 match taking place at the end of the season.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bd6c5c344ed9ea485189f2d4aaa67f19b1b26391.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Crystal League Point Adjustments[/h3]
Season Points for midlevel Crystal League matches have been rebalanced, and there is now a [b]daily limit for Season Points earned from the Crystal League[/b]. This limit makes it less desirable to accumulate elite Crystal League teams in one guild and instead creates an incentive for top teams to spread across various guilds.
[h3]Smart Cluster Queue Changes[/h3]
When a cluster is overcrowded and the Smart Cluster Queue activates, players can now either [b]join the queue[/b] or [b]skip the overcrowded cluster entirely[/b]. Additionally, the distance players can move from the entrance before being kicked from the queue has been greatly increased.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ea19b7ec31fb01f6f29d799212929e008ec74b2a.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Castle Scoring and Minimum Distance Changes[/h3]
Castle scoring now starts at 00:00 UTC regardless of a zone's prime time, and Castles and Castle Outposts give points every 6 and 3 hours respectively. Additionally, Castles are now at least 4 zones apart, making it harder for larger guilds to defend numerous objectives simultaneously.
[h3]World Boss and Raid Zone Changes[/h3]
Fame for all Elite mobs in World Boss Raid Zones, including World Bosses themselves, has been massively increased. World Bosses now spawn once per hour instead of once per day, and killing them gives a 20% Fame buff within the same cluster. Elite mobs in these zones also respawn much faster, and their distribution within the zones has been updated.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/45cccb9763319dac86816dfde10efeb56e8ebe88.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes and More[/h3][list]	[*]Axes get a new Q-slot ability, Rending Rage, to improve mobility and crowd control[/*]	[*]Various buffs for Axes, Spears, and Arcane Staffs[/*]	[*]Cooldown reductions for Royal Robe and Royal Armor[/*]	[*]Timers for point scoring and treasures in Castles and Castle Outposts now display as both countdowns and fixed UTC time[/*]	[*]Numerous bug fixes[/*][/list]
For the full list of changes, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/changelog/RISE%20OF%20AVALON%20PATCH%2010][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Dev Talk: Season 11 Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/fd5ada97ea2fc81763481c336f87edc35e9cd468.jpg[/img]

Albion Online's 11th Guild Season starts on [b]Saturday, December 5[/b]. This season will bring major new features along with changes to existing systems. In our newest Dev Talk, Combat Designer Michael Schwahn discusses these changes and how they will affect guild warfare in Albion.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Do-WTEBSQw
No time to watch or prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]20v20 Crystal League[/h3]
This Season introduces the [b]20v20 Crystal League,[/b] allowing all players to join fair and exciting 20v20 battles.
[list]	[*]Tokens can be bought at the Energy Manipulator and used for one of [b]3 slots each day[/b][/*]	[*]Match rules are similar to the 5v5 League, where both teams need to control and hold more orbs than the enemy[/*]	[*]20v20 matches will use an [b]entirely new map[/b] with a layout similar to the old city fight map[/*]	[*][b]As in the 5v5 League, Level 1 matches are knockdown only [/b]and offer perfect training for newcomers[/*]	[*][b]High-stakes, full-loot[/b] matches are also available, increasing toward the end of the season[/*][/list][h3]Crystal League Point Limit[/h3]
To make sure the Crystal League doesn't dominate the entire season at the expense of other activities, we're rebalancing its [b]Season Point rewards[/b] and introducing a [b]daily limit[/b] for Season Points gained via Crystal League. The limits are separate for 5v5 and 20v20 matches, and vary based on the amount of points available on a given day. This keeps high-level matches rewarding while ensuring seasons can’t be won solely via elite Crystal League squads.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9c4a363d95435364b9af2c12b18aa6e22588168c.png[/img]
[h3]World Boss Raid Zones[/h3]
To add high-value open world objectives, we have overhauled World Boss Raid Zones:
[list]	[*]World Bosses now spawn [b]every hour[/b][/*]	[*]Defeating a World Boss gives every team member a [b]PvE Fame buff[/b] while remaining in the zone, as an additional incentive for groups to stand their ground when they meet an enemy group[/*]	[*]To further make these areas into Fame Farming hotspots, their [b]Elite mobs[/b] are now much stronger, but also way more rewarding, and they respawn much faster[/*]	[*]These spots are limited, which should lead to more [b]small and midsized open-world fights[/b][/*][/list][h3][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5459ecec3f2143cc95fa2e2c75645618a08f01e2.png[/img][/b]Castles[/h3]
With Season 11, Castle and Castle Outpost timers will be the same for all clusters in the game. This means treasure spawning and scoring now occur independently of the cluster prime time.
[list]	[*]Castles score [b]every 6 hours[/b][/*]	[*]Castle Outposts score [b]every 3 hours[/b][/*]	[*][b]Castle Chests[/b] appear on Saturdays at 12:00 and 18:00 UTC and Sundays at 00:00 UTC[/*]	[*][b]Castle Outpost Chests[/b] appear [b]every 6 hours[/b][/*][/list]
We've also increased distances between Castles by removing tunnels and cluster connections to ensure they are always at least four zones apart.

These changes will put pressure on bigger power blocks to split their forces if they want to contest more than one objective. This will hopefully lead to fewer overcrowded cluster battles.
[h3]Skip Overcrowded Clusters[/h3]
The Cluster Queue was originally designed as a tool to handle edge cases with too many players, but queued battles have become more and more frequent and many battles now revolve around this system. This is especially frustrating for players who might not get a chance to participate in the fight at all.

To improve this, players can now [b]skip overcrowded clusters[/b]. You can now select any connected entrance to jump to, and find new battles instead of waiting outside as a potential backup. This essentially allows two battles at once: one in the overcrowded cluster, and another between queued players.

The queue entrance range will also increase, letting players travel further without leaving the queue. And if two clusters in a row are overcrowded, you can skip through both.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/db818bb7e71d2dd660f10c5e919b912ef07c63e5.png[/img]
[h3]Combat Balancing[/h3]
Finally, for Season 11 we will also roll out a [b]combat balance update[/b]. This includes the new Axe ability [b]Rending Rage[/b], a combo where you swing your blade and then leap forward and root the enemy. This gives Axes a Q-slot option for mobility and crowd control. This patch also contains buffs for Axes, Spears and Arcane Staffs along with various adjustments to other abilities.

There are quite a lot of changes in Season 11, and we are excited to see how players interact with them. Hopefully we'll see some fierce competition for the top spots this season.

Thanks for watching!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Development Update, November 2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/6b31a5976a0a03456f2a023e89d5926f5e88b709.jpg[/img]

[url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/brimstone-and-mist-is-here][b]Brimstone and Mist[/b][/url] launched on October 21, bringing significant improvements to Corrupted Dungeons, the Roads of Avalon, and large-scale combat. In our newest Dev Talk, Game Director Robin Henkys discusses major improvements coming to [b]Faction Warfare[/b] and [b]Hellgates [/b]with the next content update.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LOiprC3H1Cc
No time to watch the video, or prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]1. Faction Warfare[/h3]
We’ve long wanted to expand [b]Faction Warfare[/b] into a major activity for players of all levels. We want players without large guilds to experience the excitement of massive battles, while also allowing maintaining Faction Warfare as a valuable and rewarding activity for experienced players.

To achieve this, we’re changing the following:
[list]	[*][b]Faction Conquest:[/b] In addition to Outposts, factions will be able to conquer [b]entire zones[/b]. To provoke large-scale battles, Factions will only be able to attack Outposts and zones that border another Faction.[/*]	[*][b]Faction Points:[/b] Points will be awarded not only for taking Outposts and zones, but also for [b]killing enemy defenders[/b]. Loyalty to a faction will become more important via [b]Faction ranks[/b] and weekly/monthly [b]Faction Campaigns[/b] with valuable rewards.[/*]	[*][b]Core System Changes:[/b] To encourage beginning and mid-level players to participate, Faction Warfare in blue/yellow zones will be [b]non-lethal[/b], instead allowing knocked-out players to rejoin the fight from their nearest Outpost. At the same time, the [b]red zones[/b] will contain the highest-value Faction Warfare areas, and will offer a unique [b]red zone battle event[/b] to encourage high-value, full-loot Faction Warfare.[/*][/list]
With these changes, we think Faction Warfare will become the perfect way for new Albion players to get their first experience of large-scale warfare, while offering a deep and interesting activity for veteran players who don’t have an Outlands guild or want to enjoy large-scale warfare even when their guild is not currently fighting.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b5b473dd1c222367bf61256a809554dbbd9b6b86.jpeg[/img]
[h3]2. Hellgates[/h3]
[b]Hellgates[/b] are an integral feature of Albion Online, letting players participate in high-stakes PvP in a challenging but balanced battleground. Hellgates were developed during the Alpha phase of Albion Online, and it's finally time to give them the attention they deserve.
Goals of the new Hellgates:
[list]	[*][b]Make them more accessible[/b] by adding [b]Hellgate maps[/b], which lead to a Hellgate in the open world (similar to Dungeon Maps) whenever your group is ready.[/*]	[*][b]Make them more rewarding[/b] by adding a [b]ranking system[/b] and an [b]Infamy-like[/b] system that boost your rewards as your ranking increases.[/*]	[*][b]Make them more competitive[/b] by reworking the matchmaking system, ensuring you get matched with challenging opponents and don't receive rewards without fighting. We’re also adding all-new [b]10v10 Hellgates[/b].[/*]	[*][b]Make them more polished[/b] via a complete rework of their [b]visuals[/b] and their [b]PvE experience[/b]. The new Hellgates will offer varied PvE challenges and rewards while waiting for an enemy team, as well as a variety of different Hellgate layouts.[/*][/list]
I hope you’re as excited about these major improvements to Faction Warfare and Hellgates as we are – we’ll share more details as development continues.

In the meantime, you can look forward to our upcoming [b]Play Store beta[/b] as well as major changes for [b]Season 11[/b] (including updates to [b]Season Point scoring[/b] and the [b]Outlands map[/b]) which we’ll cover in an upcoming Dev Talk.

Thanks for watching!

Allhallows is in full swing, and the [b]Grim Challenge[/b] is back! notes.title: Start Allhallows With a Fame Boost
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/86c5efc76b7227035ffad2c6e310cff4b039b0ae.png[/img]

[b]Allhallows[/b] is back! Enjoy a week-long Fame Boost and two weeks of special dungeons with valuable, spooky loot. Read on for all the gory details...
[h3]The Mists of Albion Are Back[/h3]
From now until [b]November 4 at 10:00 UTC[/b], you'll automatically receive an [b]extra 25% Fame for all activities[/b].
[list]	[*][b]Mists of Albion[/b] buff automatically activates after maintenance on [b]Wednesday, October 28[/b][/*]	[*]Grants [b]an additional 25% Fame[/b] for all activities[/*]	[*]Excludes Fame earned via PvP kills and Tomes of Insight[/*]	[*]Ends at [b]10:00 UTC[/b] on [b]Wednesday, November 4[/b][/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e69097e59b9235c73e6348c2cd8a69f63f7f509a.png[/img]

Log in today to max out your masteries and unlock new nodes and abilities!
[h3]New Solo Dungeon: Hallowed Ground[/h3]
The [b]Hallowed Ground[/b] dungeon, introduced during last year's Allhallows event as a group dungeon, now also appears in a [b]new solo version[/b]. Both versions appear at random throughout all T4-T8 zones as a pumpkin-themed portal. Once inside you'll find eerie pumpkin-lined corridors, creepy-crawly monsters, and the mysterious final boss known only as [b]Bob[/b].

notes.title: Brimstone & Mist is Live!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e7d66ddbcdc9fab3ff8f2d6c732fd64563dc9a19.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Brimstone & Mist Midseason Update[/b] is here! This major patch brings new enemies and traps in [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b], increased fishing opportunities and new fish in the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b], [b]Disarray and Smart Cluster Queue[/b] improvements, [b]combat balancing[/b], a new [b]Premier Vanity Bundle[/b], new recipes, crafting and butchery improvements, and much more.

[b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b] get a horde of fearsome new foes, including a new boss, the [b]Demonic Harbinger[/b], with a range of powerful melee and magic attacks. Face new lesser demons, corrupted Heretics, and Hellhounds, and watch out for new spike traps that ignore armor and unpredictable lava traps. Numerous existing mobs including the [b]Demonic Warlock[/b] and [b]Demonic Underlord [/b]have been updated, and attackable hazards have improved effects and readability.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d03e60db33496ccb1eaf125ecc2900f359cc337d.jpeg[/img]

Anglers rejoice! [b]Fishing[/b] is now available in every Roads of Avalon zone, and three new fish species exclusive to the Roads have been introduced. These can be cooked into recipes via a new line of [b]roasts[/b], which also include chicken, goose, and pork.

Brimstone & Mist brings numerous updates to group PvP combat of all sizes that will keep Albion's combat meta fresh and fair. These include [b]balance changes[/b] to numerous weapons and armor, changes to the [b]Smart Cluster Queue[/b] to keep parties together, and updates to [b]Disarray[/b] to reinstate the importance of healers and damage dealers.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7f794a5c12429f35c96f3f8f909891f0b8424b5a.jpeg[/img]

This update also brings a new premiere vanity set, the [b]Knight Adventurer Bundle[/b]. This set includes [b]ten vanity unlocks [/b]with a vivid blue crystal theme. The centerpiece is the [b]Warbanner[/b], a main-hand costume weapon that includes two premium animated emotes. The bundle also includes [b]guild versions[/b] of the helmet, armor, cape, and armored horse skin.

Other changes include:
[list]	[*]Keep quality when crafting Faction Capes and Royal Armors[/*]	[*]Three additional levels of [b]Hardcore Expeditions[/b][/*]	[*][b]Improved minimap[/b] readability in numerous locations[/*]	[*]Numerous further optimizations to the [b]mobile version[/b][/*]	[*][b]...and much more[/b][/*][/list]
For the complete list of changes, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/changelog/RISE%20OF%20AVALON%20PATCH%207][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: First Look: The Knight Adventurer Bundle
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/21262877def13a67dbc3e5a7a1055edd15805c27.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Brimstone & Mist Midseason Update[/b] arrives October 21, bringing numerous additions and improvements. The update will also introduce Albion's second premier costume set: the [b]Knight Adventurer Bundle[/b].

This newest bundle includes [b]ten vanity unlocks [/b]with a vivid blue crystal theme that will transform your character into a powerful and mysterious warrior. All the included items can be used on male or female characters, with unique looks (and even unique voices) for each.

Like the Rogue Bundle, this new bundle also includes an [b]Armored Horse Mount Skin[/b] with a matching blue crystal theme. On top of that, it also includes [b]guild versions[/b] of the Knight Adventurer helmet, armor, cape, and mount skin that allow you to show off your currently active guild logo and colors without dimming the costume's impressive visual effects.
[h3]Premium Animated Emotes[/h3]
The centerpiece of the Knight Adventurer Bundle is the [b]Warbanner[/b], a main-hand costume weapon. The Warbanner includes two premium animated emotes activated by spells, [b]Honor the Flag[/b] and [b]Rally the Troops:[/b]

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/de0b42312a1c8668a5ee373a93a2e6d2d6cdee14.mp4[/video]

The Warbanner uses the primary weapon slot, and like all other vanity weapon items with unique spells, its spells can be toggled on or off with a special button next to the spell icons.

When the Brimstone & Mist Midseason Update goes live on October 21, this complete bundle will be available in the ingame store for [b]USD $29.95[/b]. This bundle includes [b]all[/b] currently available Knight Adventurer and Knight Adventurer Guild skin options:

This option offers the best value for those who want all Knight Adventurer items.

notes.title: Dev Talk: Development Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EkYI74z.png[/img]

The [b]Rise of Avalon[/b] update went live on August 12, 2020, bringing the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b], [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b], and much more to the world of Albion. In this Dev Talk, Game Director Robin Henkys gives an update about the current state of the game as well as a preview of what's coming next.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4QqL7GoYDVI
No time to watch, or prefer a written summary? Read on...
[h3]2020 in Albion[/h3]
2020 brought [b]two major updates[/b] and massive growth in player numbers. The last update was developed with [b]almost our entire team working from home[/b], and since then we’ve been busy dealing with the challenges of distributed production, increased player numbers, and staying on top of patches and future content.

Today we want to give you an update on what's coming next. [b]Two exciting developments[/b] are coming soon:

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6bd1a0350ad1ace4274d9936c53891a208173bce.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Midseason Update: Brimstone & Mist[/h3]
The first of these is the [b]Brimstone & Mist Midseason Update[/b], which expands on the Rise of Avalon update launched this past summer:
[list]	[*][b]New Mobs and Traps in Corrupted Dungeons[/b], including Hellhounds, new Heretics and demons, deadly spike and lava traps, and an all-new final boss, the [b]Demonic Harbinger[/b][/*]	[*][b]Rebalanced existing mobs[/b] and [b]increased Demonic Shard health[/b] in Slayer difficulty[/*]	[*]Added numerous [b]fishing areas[/b] to Roads of Avalon[/*]	[*]Added an exclusive [b]rare fish[/b] that can only be caught in the Roads of Avalon, plus a new line of food and corresponding rare fish recipe[/*]	[*]Changes to [b]Disarray[/b] (zerg debuff):	[list]		[*]Disarray will now depend on [b]the relative difference in Disarray levels between you and your target[/b][/*]		[*]This will boost the importance of [b]damage dealers and healers[/b] while ensuring each role stays impactful no matter the size of the battle[/*]		[*]Disarray will still [b]protect smaller groups[/b] from being overwhelmed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Changes to the [b]Smart Cluster Queue[/b]:	[list]		[*]Now keeps[b] existing parties together[/b] when possible[/*]		[*]Party leaders can now assign [b]party as well as player priorities[/b][/*]		[*]Improved the way the system deals with allied players, ensuring players don't displace allies[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]...and much more[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5c6a3fb7a4e4eae07d9d67aedaa6c60c53eab94f.jpeg[/img]

Brimstone and Mist goes live on October 21 - read more about it [url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/brimstone-mist-arrives-october-21][b]here[/b][/url].
[h3]Android Updating + Google Play Open Beta[/h3][list]	[*]Improved [b]Android updating[/b]:	[list]		[*]I[b]n-app updating[/b] will [b]dramatically reduce the size[/b] of the .apk download[/*]		[*]Downloads [b]changed content only[/b], which should result in much faster patching[/*]		[*]Introduced with Brimstone and Mist, but will mostly affect [b]future patches[/b], since this update contains significant structural changes that need to be downloaded[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Google Play Store Beta:[/b]	[list]		[*]Happening in [b]early [/b][b]November[/b][/*]		[*]Install and update Albion Online via the [b]Google Play Store[/b], making it easy and convenient to keep the game updated[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][h3]Looking to the Future[/h3]
Of course, the Midseason Update and the mobile version aren’t all we’ve been working on. With Rise of Avalon we concluded much of the work we set out to do in the Queen Update: we added [b]interconnectivity [/b]to the world, added a space for [b]mid-level guilds to play and live in[/b], and we added an [b]all-new solo activity[/b] with its own competitive metagame.

At this time, work has already begun on our next update, in which we finally want to fulfill our vision for a new and massively improved [b]Faction Warfare[/b] system. On top of that, we've got some exciting changes for [b]Hellgates[/b] planned as well. We'll be releasing more Dev Talks on these subjects after the release of Brimstone and Mist on October 21.

That's all for today - thanks for watching!

notes.title: Brimstone & Mist Arrives October 21
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3ad3aca6b7325fc257ec6368a446bbc287b147af.jpeg[/img]

On October 21, Rise of Avalon Patch 7, AKA the [b]Brimstone & Mist Midseason Update[/b], goes live. This patch brings far-reaching gameplay improvements, including new enemies and traps in [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b], increased fishing opportunities and new fish in the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b], [b]Disarray and Smart Cluster Queue[/b] improvements, combat balance changes, new recipes, crafting and butchery improvements, and much more.
[h3]New Corrupted Foes Emerge[/h3]
A wide range of new enemies and traps will be added to [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b]. Face off against a fearsome new boss, the [b]Demonic Harbinger[/b], a sword-wielding demonic general. Fight new lesser demons, corrupted Heretics, and Hellhounds, and watch out for new spike and lava traps. The behavior of numerous existing mobs, including the [b]Demonic Warlock [/b]and [b]Demon Lord[/b], will also be updated, and attackable [b]Mephit hazards[/b] will have improved effects and readability.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ea8c78bccee730db7806ecb0d9bed4b24a665097.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Roads of Avalon: Anglers Rejoice![/h3]
[b]Fishing[/b] will be fully integrated into the Roads of Avalon, with fishable waters found in [b]every Roads of Avalon zone[/b]. In addition, three new fish species exclusive to the Roads are being introduced: the [b]Whitefog Snapper, Clearhaze Snapper,[/b] and [b]Puremist Snapper[/b]. These fish can be eaten on their own or turned into Chopped Fish as normal, or cooked into recipes via the new line of [b]Roasts[/b] (see "Additional Changes" below).

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/acc39108365cce7f52da3137554553dbfba8d029.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Combat Balancing and Zerg Mechanic Changes[/h3]
In addition to the changes above, this patch will bring new [b]combat balance changes[/b] that mainly affect [b]group PvP[/b]. Combat Designer Michael Schwahn describes them as follows: "This balance patch mainly focuses on Crystal League and ZvZ fights, and especially on improving various abilities and items which have been underperforming recently. Other changes include adding the Harpoon ability to all spears via the W-slot and giving the Spirithunter a new E-ability."

Changes to the [b]Smart Cluster Queue[/b] will give players more control over how they set up their armies for large fights, as sorting in the queue is now done on a [b]per-party level[/b] to keep existing parties together. And [b]Disarray[/b] (AKA the "zerg debuff") has been updated to ensure the ZvZ meta plays out in a similar way across a wide range of fight sizes, while still providing smaller groups with the same protection from large armies.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cff1ed74346af6eb8c7032e9e161e8606ddddaae.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Additional Changes[/h3][list]	[*]A new line of [b]roasts[/b] will be craftable at the cook, using raw chicken, goose, pork, and the three new fish species[/*]	[*]Faction Capes and Royal Armors will [b]retain the quality of the Cape and Armor used to create them[/b][/*]	[*]Three additional levels of [b]Hardcore Expeditions[/b] will be added[/*]	[*][b]Minimap[/b] will be reworked for improved readability in numerous city and island locations[/*]	[*]Focus will be usable when [b]butchering[/b] to get more meat[/*]	[*]Numerous further optimizations to the [b]mobile version[/b][/*]	[*][b]...and much more[/b][/*][/list]

notes.title: Refer One Friend and Claim a Panda Mount Skin
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e830823a2f36f11bccf730a3a0b3206dec605882.jpeg[/img]

A new referral season is here! From now until December 1, refer your friends and claim your very own [b]Panda[/b] mount skin. This skin transforms your Direbear base mount into a fuzzy, ferocious Giant Panda – and once you've unlocked it, it can be used by [b]all characters[/b] on your account forever.

On top of that, you can earn huge amounts of Fame for your third and fifth referrals: three referrals scores you a [b]T7 Pile of Tomes[/b] worth 100,000 Fame, and five referrals gets you a [b]T8 Pile of Tomes[/b] granting a colossal 200,000 Fame. And as always, your first-ever referral grants [b]an additional T8 Pile of Tomes[/b] along with the mount skin.

The current referral season lasts until maintenance on [b]December 1[/b], so you've got until then to refer your friends and claim your rewards.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c5b0fb6416df2d711ee856733c132ef6f093dc8a.png[/img]
[h3]How to Earn Seasonal Referral Rewards[/h3][list]	[*]Send your referral link, which you can find [url=https://albiononline.com/en/profile/referral/overview][b]here[/b][/url], to a friend. (You must be logged into your account on the website to view this page.)[/*]	[*]Your friend registers an account and starts playing Albion Online (preferably along with you!).[/*]	[*]The first time your friend purchases at least 30 days of Premium, they will trigger a reward for you.[/*]	[*]On top of that, for your very first referral ever, you'll receive a [b]T8 Recruiter's Pile of Tomes[/b], worth a whopping [b]200,000 Fame[/b].[/*][/list]

On top of that, you can earn huge amounts of Fame for your third and fifth referrals: three referrals scores you a [b]T7 Pile of Tomes[/b] worth 100,000 Fame, and five referrals gets you a [b]T8 Pile of Tomes[/b] granting a colossal 200,000 Fame. And as always, your first-ever referral grants [b]an additional T8 Pile of Tomes[/b] along with the mount skin.
On top of that, for your very first referral ever, you'll receive a [b]T8 Recruiter's Pile of Tomes[/b], worth a whopping [b]200,000 Fame[/b].

notes.title: The Harvest Challenge is Back!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/06a4dcc5d3f6aacfeed5797945b98b539aa30661.jpeg[/img]

Fall has come to the world of Albion... the shadows are growing longer... and the [b]Harvest Challenge[/b] is back! For the entire month of October, earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get spooky loot, and claim your very own [b]Spectral Bat[/b]. This time around, in addition to the mount and avatar ring, you can also claim up to six new [b]Halloween-themed furniture items[/b] that have a chance to appear in weekly chests.
[h3][b]A Time to Sow, a Time to Reap[/b][/h3]
[img]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/5a9e734d7a37c596bd8f341dbc3a91df18612d68.png[/img]
[b]SPECTRAL BAT:[/b] This month's Challenge offers another chance to claim the amazing [b]Spectral Bat[/b]. In addition to its spooky appearance, this winged menace comes with a powerful [b]Blink[/b] spell that allows you to jump to a target location in the blink of an eye. (Note: like all mounts, the Spectral Bat cannot fly over obstacles or gaps.)

[img]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/19075c42b2f6083a97620356e3a682f66f0a4774.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Harvest Challenge avatar ring[/b], featuring a pair of eerie, grinning skeletons. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Vanity Token.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2c7ba7c8b9fff4083306b993696b33ec95415878.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly point totals to unlock [b]Harvest Challenge Chests[/b]. Along with valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver, resources, and other loot, you'll also have a chance to unlock six brand-new eerie furniture items: the [b]Scary Pumpkin Lantern, Friendly Pumpkin Lantern, Halloween Lantern, Halloween Cauldron, Halloween Scarecrow,[/b] and [b]Halloween Pyre[/b].

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!
